job.title: 1207 - QA Automation
job.description:
We Make Remote Work Remarkable • TopTalent from LatAm

Hello! We are GoFasti, a Talent-as-a-Service. GoFasti bridges the gap between world-class developers and designers from LatAm and first-class companies around the globe.

We need an English-fluent QA Automation, based in Latin America, available to work remotely.

We are looking for someone with exceptional communication and relationship-building skills, who embraces changes while maintaining strong attention to detail. An interested and proactive person, who's constantly learning and improving their skills.

Are you the one we are looking for?

Responsibilities:

  • Contribute towards enhancing and developing scalable automation frameworks for web, mobile, API, and backend services.

  • Design a modular "pluggable" architecture that allows for easy addition of new test cases without modifying core framework logic.

  • Collaborate with developers, QA engineers, DevOps, and product managers to integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines.

  • Work with the assigned project team members to understand the system under test and its underlying architecture to identify the right testing strategy and automation solutions.

  • Understand or help identify non-functional requirements for the system under test.

  • Design and develop performance and load tests for the system under test by identifying the right tools and frameworks.

  • Work in close communication with the Quality Assurance Manager, proactively collaborating and communicating through video calls and other channels.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience in QA automation or SDET roles, including at least 2–3 years designing and building test automation frameworks.

  • Knowledge of test automation framework design, architecture, and development, used primarily for testing backend services and integrations.

  • Experience with automation frameworks and testing tools: Playwright for UI, Postman/Newman for API integration, and JMeter for load and performance testing.

  • Proficiency in programming languages: JavaScript, Java, Python.

  • Experience with API testing using Postman (REST API).

  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools: Jenkins and AWS CodePipeline.

  • Knowledge of cloud platforms: AWS, including AWS CodePipeline, CodeBuild, Lambda functions, Step Functions, etc.

  • Experience with containerization tools: Docker, Kubernetes.

  • Proficiency in bug tracking and reporting tools: qTest and Kibana.

  • Experience with monitoring tools: Kibana.

  • Ability to write and execute SQL queries.

It's a plus:

  • Experience working in the Insurance domain.

  • Familiarity with AI tools: Claude, Copilot, Kiro CLI.

Compensation:

  • The salary range offered for this position varies from (USD) $2,300 - $2,800 per month, depending on seniority and skillset.

  • This position is for a full time contract, through a payroll platform.

  • The talent will work remotely allocated at our client.

Here are the steps for this process:

Application review/approval > Screening interview with GoFasti's team > We build and send your profile to our client > Profile review/approval by client > Interview with the client > Hiring and onboarding.

Once you apply for the job, our team will review your resume. If it meets the requirements, we will contact you and move forward in the process. 

Note for Candidates Approached Directly:
If you were contacted directly by a member of our team and are interested in this opportunity, please do not apply through this link. Instead, reach out to the person who contacted you to coordinate a meeting.

Thank you!

job.title: ETL Developer
job.description:
T-Rex Solutions is looking to select an ETL Developer to support our Internal Revenue Service (IRS) EDOS program. The overall mission of this program is to modernize the IRS legacy Tax processing systems and is critical to the overall modernization of the IRS to improve taxpayer experience, increase voluntary compliance, and reduce the IRS’s reliance on costly and unsustainable legacy technology. This role will play a pivotal role in designing, developing, and implementing robust solutions for a variety of programs and applications.

Responsibilities:

  • As an ETL Developer, you will be responsible for designing, building, and configuring applications that align with specific business processes and requirements. Your day-to-day tasks will involve collaborating with stakeholders to understand data needs, translating those needs into technical specifications, and developing efficient Informatica solutions to support business objectives.
  • You will play a key role in ensuring data is accurately extracted, transformed, and loaded into target systems, maintaining data integrity and optimizing workflows throughout the process.
  • Exposure to Informatica tools, data integration platforms, and workflow automation processes will be highly beneficial in this role. Familiarity with data mapping, data cleansing, and performance tuning techniques will help you excel as you work to streamline application functionality.
  • Experience with, debugging, and optimizing Informatica jobs, as well as working within agile development environments, will further support your success in meeting evolving business and application requirements

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's Degree and 10+ years of experience
  • US Citizenship required
  • Must possess an active IRS MBI Clearance and have current GFE
  • Prior experience working on Agile teams
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills with client stakeholders at all organizational and technical levels

Desired Skills:

  • Mainframe and DB2
  • Knowledge of data warehousing concepts
  • Familiarity with SQL and database management
  • Understanding of data integration best practices

T-Rex Overview

Established in 1999, T-Rex Solutions, LLC is a proven mid-tier business providing data-centric mission services to the Federal government as it increasingly tries to secure and leverage the power of data. We design, integrate, secure, and deploy advanced technical solutions for our customers so they can efficiently fulfill their critical objectives. T-Rex offers both IT and professional services to numerous Federal agencies and is a leader in providing high quality and innovative solutions in the areas of Cloud and Infrastructure Services, Cyber Security, and Big Data Engineering.

T-Rex is constantly seeking qualified people to join our growing team. We have built a broad client base through our devotion to delivering quality products and customer service, and to do that we need quality individuals. But more than that, we at T-Rex are committed to creating a culture that supports the development of every employee's personal and professional lives. T-Rex has made a commitment to maintain the status of an industry leader in compensation packages and benefits which includes competitive salaries, performance bonuses, training and educational reimbursement, Transamerica 401(k) and Cigna healthcare benefits.

T-Rex is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex (including pregnancy and sexual orientation), parental status, national origin, age, disability, family medical history or genetic information, political affiliation, military service, or other non-merit based factors.

In compliance with pay transparency guidelines, the annual base salary range for this position is $125,000 - $195,000. Please note that the salary information is a general guideline only. T-Rex considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate’s work experience, education/training, key skills, internal peer equity, as well as market and business considerations when extending an offer.

T-Rex offers a diverse and collaborative work environment, exciting opportunities for professional growth, and generous benefits, including: PTO available to use immediately upon joining (prorated based on start date), paid parental leave, individual and family health, vision, and dental benefits, annual budget for training, professional development and tuition reimbursement, and a 401(k) plan with company match fully vested after 60 days of employment among other benefits.

job.title: Tech Lead/Software Engineer III - PDC
job.description:
Attention: Kapitus is aware that individuals posing as recruiters may be communicating with job seekers about supposed positions with Kapitus. Kapitus has received reports that the content and method of communication can vary, but messages may contain requests for payment (e.g., fees for equipment or training) and/or for sensitive financial information.

Kapitus will never ask a candidate for employment for payment or financial information during the initial application or interview process. All open positions are posted in location specific employment portals available at www.kapitus.com/careers All legitimate Kapitus job postings on employment sites will direct candidates to complete an application through these portals before completion of the hiring process.

Candidates with additional questions or concerns regarding any recruiting communications or Kapitus’ recruiting process in general should email [email removed]

As a Tech Lead/Software Engineer III at Kapitus, you will be responsible for leading a dynamic service development team with the design, development, and implementation of scalable and efficient cloud native services in alignment with Kapitus business goals. Your contributions will empower Kapitus to continue helping small business owners find lending options so they can make payroll during tough times, scale to meet market demands, and make large purchases to scale their operations.

The ideal candidate would have deep expertise in PHP, CakePHP and legacy application architecture, and experience maintaining, troubleshooting, and modernizing older PHP applications (PHP 5.6), & leading major framework and PHP version upgrades. This individual must demonstrate strong technical ownership, architectural expertise, and independent problem solving skills, serving as the primary technical owner of a mission-critical enterprise platform while providing reliable support during US business hours and driving its long-term stability, performance, and modernization. 

What you will do:

Lead Service Development:

  • Take ownership of the end-to-end service development lifecycle, from conceptualization to deployment, ensuring high-quality deliverables within specified timelines.

Architectural Design:

  • Collaborate with product and business stakeholders to design scalable and resilient service architectures that meet business requirements while adhering to best practices and industry standards.

Technical Leadership:

  • Provide guidance and mentorship to a team of developers, fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Code Review and Quality Assurance:

  •  Conduct thorough code reviews to ensure adherence to coding standards, performance optimization, and maintainability. Implement robust testing strategies to uphold product quality.

AWS Expertise:

  • Utilize your extensive experience with AWS services to architect, deploy, and maintain cloud-based solutions, leveraging services such as ECS, S3, Lambda, and others as appropriate.

Financial Industry Integration:

  • Apply your understanding of financial industry requirements to tailor solutions that address integration needs and comply with regulatory standards.
  • Build a deep understanding of our current infrastructure and identify improvements to keep Kapitus on the forefront of FinTech

Agile Methodologies:

  •  Drive agile development practices within the team, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog grooming, and retrospectives, to ensure efficient delivery and continuous improvement.

Collaboration and Communication:

  • Work closely with cross-functional teams, including product management, QA, and operations, to ensure alignment of development efforts with overall business objectives.

What we’re looking for:

  • Bachelor or Master’s degree in computer science.
  • Minimum of 6+ years of experience in software development as tech lead or senior/staff developer, with a focus on backend service development.
  • Strong proficiency in AWS cloud services development and infrastructure management.
  • Experience with relational databases (MSSQL and MySQL) and NoSQL DB.
  • Proven experience in designing and architecting scalable, high-performance systems.
  • Experience in the financial industry is highly preferred.
  • Experience with PHP is highly preferred.
  • In-depth understanding of agile methodologies and experience leading agile teams.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with diverse teams.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and adapt to changing priorities.

Kapitus Total Rewards Package Includes: 

  • Competitive Base Salary Range of $117,800-$189,000. Kapitus is providing this as a good faith salary range to comply with applicable law. The applicant’s final salary will depend on a number of factors including the applicant’s geographic location, skills, and experience.
  • Annual Incentive Compensation Eligibility –Up to 10% annually

  • Health Insurance: Comprehensive medical, dental, and employer-paid vision plans through UnitedHealthcare (UHC), with various coverage levels available to meet the needs of our employees and their families. Additional perks through UHC include: Sweat Equity, free subscription to the Calm App, UHC rewards, Real Appeal, and Quit For Life.
  • Flexible Spending Account: Set aside pre-tax dollars from your paycheck to pay for qualified out-of-pocket medical, dental, vision, pharmacy or dependent care expenses. 
  • Lifestyle Spending Account: Employer sponsored post-tax benefits that allow reimbursement for expenses related to physical, mental and financial well-being. 
  • 100% Company Paid Insurances: Kapitus fully covers the cost of basic short-term and long-term disability insurance, as well as vision insurance, ensuring our employees have comprehensive protection without any personal expense.
  • Voluntary Insurance: Supplemental life insurance as well as enhanced short- and long-term disability coverage are available through Mutual of Omaha, providing additional security for our employees. Additionally, Colonial Accident and Hospitalization insurances are also available, offering further protection against unforeseen events.
  • Paid Maternity and Parental Leave: Beyond state-mandated leave policies, Kapitus provides company-paid maternity and parental leave, supporting our employees during important family milestones.
  • Commuter Benefits: We offer pre-tax benefits on parking and commuter expenses to cover travel to and from work.
  • LifeBalance Program: Enhance your lifestyle with our LifeBalance membership, which offers discounts on outdoor activities, the arts, health, and fitness. Additional benefits include: 
    • Pet and car insurance discounts.
    • Financial services such as LegalShield.
    • Relaxation and stress management tools.
  • Plum Benefits Discount Program: Access exclusive discounts on shows, travel, car rentals, and more, enriching your personal and family life.
  • Tuition Reimbursement: Pursue further education with up to $5,000 annually in tuition reimbursement, plus opportunities to attend relevant conferences and career development events. Managed through our LSA plan, Kapitus Academy. 
  • Travel Reimbursement: We also offer travel reimbursement for all work-related travel, supporting your involvement in career and personal development activities.
  • Paid Time Off and Sick Time.
  • Retirement Benefits: Our 401K plan is managed through Fidelity. To support your long-term financial goals, the company provides a 25% match on your contributions, up to 6% of your annual salary.

About Kapitus:

Kapitus is one of the most reliable and respected names in small business financing. As both a direct lender and a marketplace built with a trusted network of lending partners, we can provide small businesses with the financing they need when, and how it is needed. We have spent our entire existence building a culture that makes us excited to come to work in the morning. Our company is fast paced, teammates need to be self-directed and have an internal motivation to do the right thing, even when the right thing takes a lot of hard work. We show our teammates our appreciation by offering great benefits, competitive pay and solid opportunity for growth.

Company Mission: At Kapitus, our mission is to help small business owners grow their organizations by providing tailored, transparent, and ethical financing solutions. We invest in every business owner’s story and we are dedicated to building lasting relationships to champion their goals. We promise to keep the best interests of our clients at the center of the financing process by operating with transparency, fairness, and integrity.

Consideration will be given to qualified remote candidates residing in states where Kapitus and/or one of its subsidiaries has an established physical presence.

job.title: Associate Director of Bioinformatics (Oncology Algorithms)
job.description:
Natera is seeking an Associate Director to lead a team in the Oncology R&D organization. You will oversee the planning and execution of development of AI-based diagnostic algorithms, taking them  through the development phase, analytical validation and into commercial launch. You will hire and manage the team, support its professional growth, and set the development strategy for new products.

The role calls for extensive experience in algorithm development, NGS data processing across DNA, RNA and methylation, H&E image processing, and the full life cycle of diagnostic product development in a regulated  setting. You will implement methods to optimize performance and help define the product profile from a computational perspective, with input from cross-functional teams.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Team Leadership and Development: Lead, hire and mentor a team of Bioinformatics Scientists. Own their professional growth, their responsibilities, and build a culture of scientific rigor.
  • Development Strategy: Own the development strategy behind new products, from scoping through execution. Work with cross-functional stakeholders on what the team takes on and in what order.
  • Development To Launch: Lead algorithms through the development phase to CLIA readiness. This includes locking the algorithm and its intended use, supporting analytical validation studies by setting performance targets and acceptance criteria in collaboration with the biostatistics team. You will also support clinical validation and produce the documentation that quality, regulatory, and laboratory directors need to release the test.
  • Model Robustness and Performance: Develop and improve biomarker models and classifiers across modalities. Establish strategies for quality control, generalization across sites, scanners, and sequencing runs, and ongoing performance monitoring.
  • Production Readiness and Handoff: Move research prototypes into stable, validated production workflows. Hold the team to software engineering practice, including version control, testing, and containerization, and reproducibility under change control. Automate the routine parts of research data management, and reporting so the team's time goes to science.
  • Ways of Working: AI is a routine part of the work here. As the leader of this team, you set what correct use looks like: what an agent may conclude on its own, and what requires a scientist to sign off. 
  • Cross-functional Partnership: Work with data science, molecular biology, pipeline engineering, biostatistics, quality assurance, and laboratory operations on new products and on the transition of research work into production. Act as the subject-matter expert those groups come to, and explain findings and the roadmap clearly at every level of the company.

Qualifications:

  • Ph.D. in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, Biostatistics, or a related field. (An M.S. with equivalent experience considered).
  • 7+ years in bioinformatics, including 3+ years leading scientists and working across functions.
  • Demonstrated experience developing algorithms from multimodal data including, DNA, RNA and/or methylation sequencing data, digital pathology for clinical diagnostic use.
  • Demonstrated ownership of a team that took an algorithm from research into real clinical use, including a successful CLIA or comparable regulated release, not only to a result.
  • Working knowledge of analytical validation for algorithms, including accuracy, precision, sensitivity, limit of detection, and reproducibility.

Preferred:

  • Deep expertise in next-generation sequencing analysis: hybrid-capture or amplicon-based target enrichment designs, sequencing quality control, secondary analysis, and variant calling.
  • Experience integrating multimodal data (DNA, RNA, histology and other omics data), into a single predictive model or classifier. 
  • Working knowledge of how a diagnostic product moves through development in a regulated, accredited setting, including the practices and standards that apply (CLIA, CAP, design controls, and software validation and change control).
  • Strong Python, programming, and data analysis skills, with experience in machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow
  • Cloud computing (AWS, GCP) and workflow orchestration (WDL, Nextflow).
  • Containerization (Docker) for reproducible, production-grade analyses.
  • Clear communication of technical detail to people who do not share your background.
  • The ability to run several objectives and timelines at once without close supervision.
  • A desire to work in a fast-paced environment where a small team has high impact.

The pay range is listed and actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, certifications and specific office location. This may differ in other locations due to cost of labor considerations.

Remote USA

$177,800—$222,800 USD

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program!

For more information, visit www.natera.com.

Natera is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace environment, and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. Inclusive collaboration benefits our employees, our community and our patients, and is critical to our mission of changing the management of disease worldwide.

All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply, and will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, age, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws.

job.title: Senior Bioinformatics Scientist (Oncology Product Development)
job.description:
Natera is currently seeking a Senior Bioinformatics Scientist to join the Bioinformatics team focused on Oncology Product Development. The individual will participate in the design and prototyping of cutting-edge algorithms for analysis of genetic data and the development and validation of ctDNA-based diagnostic tests, interacting closely with colleagues in our molecular biology and biostatistics teams to guide and analyze experiments. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in bioinformatics and data science, optimally with experience in the analysis or modeling of DNA methylation data.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Develop and improve analysis pipelines for diagnostic tests, including detection of cancer-associated variants or methylation patterns and implementation of evidence-based quality control thresholds.
  • Leverage accurate statistical or probabilistic models to build the next round of algorithms and products.
  • Move products through the full development process, from research through commercial launch.
  • Help design and interpret molecular biology experiments.
  • Contribute to our intellectual property portfolio.
  • Drive rigorous data analysis efforts and support group efforts in the production of high-quality documentation.

QUALIFICATIONS:

Requirements:

  • Ph.D. in a quantitative discipline (bioinformatics, engineering, applied mathematics, statistics, or similar). Master’s degree with 4+ years of relevant experience will be considered.
  • 1-3 years of post-graduate experience in a data science and/or bioinformatics role.

Desirable, but not required:

  • Prior experience analyzing or modeling DNA methylation data.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

  • Experience using Python or R for scientific data analysis and visualization.
  • Strong foundation in statistical modeling/machine learning, including probability theory and estimation/classification methods.
  • Experience with analysis of next-generation sequencing data, preferably including algorithm development or optimization.
  • Proven ability to apply mathematical principles to solve real estimation problems and implement practical solutions.
  • Experience writing code in a production environment and using version control and cloud computing infrastructure.
  • Excellent communication skills and the desire to work in a dynamic and collaborative environment.

job.title: Senior Salesforce Developer
job.companyindustry: retail, food product, delivery, food delivery
job.location: Canada - Remote (ON, AB, BC, or NS Only)
job.description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

We are hiring a Senior Salesforce Developer to join the IT Business Systems team, which owns the CRM platform that every business unit at Instacart depends on. You will design, build, and ship solutions across Sales Cloud, Salesforce CPQ, Service Cloud, and Contact Center, with an immediate focus on the CPQ Phase 2 migration, the HighRadius integration, and the migration of our contact center to Agentforce Contact Center. These are multi-million dollar initiatives touching Sales, Finance, and Customer Experience, and you will present your work to VP-level stakeholders. You will also use AI-assisted tooling such as Claude Code and Cursor to deliver faster and at higher quality, and to raise the engineering bar for the team.

About the Job

  • Deliver the HighRadius integration and CPQ Phase 2 implementation, and get the Contact Center migration to Agentforce ready for testing and launch without P0 incidents
  • Design and build scalable solutions on Sales Cloud, including lead-to-opportunity flows, forecasting, territory and account management, and sales process automation
  • Configure and extend Salesforce CPQ: product and price rules, bundles, discount schedules, approval workflows, quote templates, contract and renewal flows, and integration with billing and ERP systems
  • Build Service Cloud capabilities such as case management, omni-channel routing, entitlements and SLAs, and knowledge
  • Implement and optimize Contact Center solutions, including Agentforce Contact Center, Service Cloud Voice, telephony and CTI integration, Omni-Channel, and agent productivity tooling
  • Write production-grade Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, triggers, and asynchronous processes that follow governor limits and platform best practices
  • Use Claude Code and Cursor daily for development, refactoring, test generation, code review, and documentation, and share effective AI-assisted workflows with the team
  • Build and manage integrations using REST and SOAP APIs, Platform Events, middleware, and external systems
  • Own the delivery pipeline: source control, Salesforce DX, scratch orgs, CI/CD with Copado or a similar tool, automated tests (90%+ coverage on critical code), and release management
  • Mentor developers, lead code reviews, and set standards for architecture, security, and performance across orgs
  • Partner with the Business Systems TPM, the Systems and Tools team, and the Technology Governance team to troubleshoot production issues and reduce technical debt

About You

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience on the Salesforce platform, including 5+ years as a hands-on Salesforce developer and 2+ years at the Senior Developer level
  • Current, active Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I and Platform Developer II certifications
  • Strong command of Apex, SOQL/SOSL, Lightning Web Components, Flows, and the Salesforce security and sharing model

job.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer, AI Productivity
job.companyindustry: retail, food product, delivery, food delivery
job.description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

Instacart's AI Productivity team builds the AI-powered platforms and tools that help our engineers and the broader R&D organization move faster, reduce toil, and deliver higher-quality experiences for customers, shoppers, retailers, and brand partners. We have been at the forefront of applied AI for years, and we move quickly: we prototype, ship, learn, and retire what is no longer the best answer.

As a Senior Staff Software Engineer, you will set the direction for how AI changes the way Instacart builds products and software, and you will drive that change across the whole company. You will stay close to where the AI industry is heading, anticipate where the industry and Instacart will be 18 to 36 months from now, and turn that view into strategy, pilots, and adoption at scale. That means more work handled in the background by orchestrated, cost-efficient, and compliant agents, so people can focus on the work that needs human judgment.

This is a hands-on, high-visibility role. You will write code, partner with senior engineering and finance leadership, evaluate vendors and prototypes, and lead organizational change, including the cultural and people side of adoption. This position is remote-friendly within North America.

About the Job

  • Define and drive the company-wide strategy for AI-assisted software and product development, anticipating where the industry and Instacart are headed over the next 18 to 36 months.
  • Lead adoption of AI tools and agentic workflows across engineering and R&D, including company-wide rollouts, and own the organizational change that comes with them: culture, learning, communication, and working through resistance.
  • Increase engineering throughput by growing the volume of background and parallel agentic work each person can handle, with high quality, strong safeguards, and clear cost controls.
  • Build and prototype hands-on: lead large features, pilots, and proofs of concept that change how work gets done, and scale the ones that prove their value.
  • Define how we measure impact, moving beyond "are people using it?" to "are they using it effectively?", and report outcomes clearly to executive audiences.
  • Partner with engineering leaders, Security, Legal, and Finance to manage AI cost, security, and compliance as usage grows.
  • Evaluate vendors and emerging tools, deciding what to buy, what to build, and what to retire.
  • Mentor and influence senior engineers across all pillars, and represent AI productivity across the company through forums such as lunch-and-learns and brown bags.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

  • 10+ years of professional software engineering experience building and operating production systems at scale.
  • Production experience with large language models at the frontier: you have shipped LLM-powered capabilities in real products and understand what good inference engineering looks like. Using AI tools alone is not enough.
  • A track record of scaling AI beyond yourself to an entire organization, with measurable outcomes and a candid account of the organizational challenges you faced.
  • Experience navigating the business side of AI, including cost management, security and compliance, and vendor evaluation and procurement.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Track record of building and driving adoption of AI tools or platforms across an engineering organization of 500+ engineers, not just a single team.
  • Experience measuring and communicating the impact of AI on developer productivity and throughput (for example, DORA/SPACE metrics, agent task volume, cycle time) to executive audiences.
  • Experience managing AI spend at scale, including cost modeling, budgeting, and optimization across models and vendors.
  • Hands-on experience with agentic systems, including orchestrating background and parallel agents with strong safeguards.
  • Deep knowledge of AI safety, security, privacy, and compliance practices (for example, guardrails, PII handling, and data governance), and experience partnering with Security and Legal on them.
  • Experience fine-tuning or adapting foundation models, and building retrieval and evaluation systems around them.
  • Demonstrated technical leadership and mentorship across multiple organizations, including influencing senior staff engineers, VPs, and C-level leaders.

#LI-Remote

Instacart provides highly market-competitive compensation and benefits in each location where our employees work. This role is remote and the base pay range for a successful candidate is dependent on their permanent work location. Please review our Flex First remote work policy here.

Offers may vary based on many factors, such as candidate experience and skills required for the role. Additionally, this role is eligible for a new hire equity grant as well as annual refresh grants. Please read more about our benefits offerings here.

job.title: Data Engineer (Databricks & AWS)
job.description:
We are looking for a Data Engineer who wants to utilize their expertise in modern data platforms, microservices architectures, application programming interfaces, data pipeline development/support and analytical reporting skills by joining our Data Services team. This role is responsible for gathering and analyzing data from several internal and external sources, designing a cloud-focused data platform for analytics and business intelligence, reliably providing data to our analysts.

Location: LATAM, 100% Remote. Working hours are based on US Central Time.

About Us:

Abstra is a fast-growing, Nearshore Tech Talent services company, providing top Latin American tech talent to U.S. companies and beyond. Founded by U.S.-bred engineers with over 15 years of experience, Abstra specializes in sourcing skilled professionals across a wide range of technologies to meet our clients’ needs, driving innovation and efficiency.

Key Responsabilities:

  • Develop & Maintain Scalable Data Pipelines: Build, optimize, and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines using Databricks, Apache Spark, and Delta Lake.
  • Optimize Data Processing: Implement performance tuning techniques to improve Spark-based workloads.
  • Cloud Data Engineering: Work with AWS services (S3, ECS, Lambda, Glue, etc.) to design and implement robust data architectures.
  • Real-time & Streaming Data: Develop streaming solutions using Kafka and Databricks Structured Streaming.
  • Data Quality & Governance: Implement data validation, observability, and governance best practices using Unity Catalog or other tools.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner with analysts, data scientists, and application engineers to ensure data meets business needs.
  • Automation & CI/CD: Implement infrastructure-as-code (IaC) and CI/CD best practices for data pipelines using tools like Terraform, and GitHub Actions.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, data science or related technical field, or equivalent practical experience
  • 2-4 years of experience in data engineering, with a focus on cloud-based platforms.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Databricks (including Spark, Delta Lake, and MLflow).
  • Experience building and maintaining AWS based data pipelines: currently utilizing AWS Lambda, Docker / ECS, MSK, Airflow, Databricks, Unity Catalog.
  • Development experience utilizing one or more of the following: Git ecosystem (GitHub, GitLab, etc.),Python and Kafka and the Kafka Connect ecosystem (Schema Registry,Avro, etc.)
  • Familiarity with CI/CD for data pipelines and infrastructure as code (GitHub Actions, Terraform)
  • Strong SQL skills for data transformation and performance tuning.
  • Understanding of data security and governance best practices.
  • Enthusiasm for working directly with customer teams (Business units and internal IT)

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Proven experience with relational and NoSQL databases (e.g. Postgres, Microsoft SQL Server, MongoDB, etc.)
  • Familiarity with data lakehouse architectures and optimization strategies.
  • Familiarity with API architectures such as FastAPI, AWS API Gateways, and OpenAPI Specifications
  • Familiarity with data visualization techniques using tools such as Databricks Dashboards, Grafana, PowerBI, and Excel.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive compensation paid in USD.
  • 20 days of paid time off (PTO) per year.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and career development.
  • Company-provided equipment.
  • A collaborative, inclusive, and multicultural work environment.
  • The opportunity to contribute to meaningful projects alongside a talented and supportive team.

Pre-Employment Verification
As part of our standard onboarding process, candidates who successfully complete the interview process and accept an employment offer will be required to complete an employment verification check, and background check. This process will confirm job titles and dates of employment with two previous employers and is a standard requirement for all new employees joining the company.

job.title: Software Developer
job.description:
Full Stack Software Developer

📍 Remote (Canada) │ Hybrid Available – Kitchener, ON

🧑‍💼 Reports to: SW Development Manager

💼 Job type: Full-Time

Salary range: $125,000 - $140,000(CAD)

🏢 About Encircle

Encircle is leading the $2 trillion property insurance industry out of the dark ages of pen and paper processes, into the digital age of transparency and empowerment. Our easy-to-use software platform enables thousands of restoration contractors and insurance professionals around the world to process claims faster.

We're a remote-first company with a collaboration hub in the heart of downtown Kitchener. We're looking to add new members to our all-star team as we continue to grow and scale!

📋 About the Role

As a Full Stack Software Developer, you'll be joining a diverse and highly talented team of developers working across the stack. Applying your previous experience, you will have an immediate impact in one of our cross-functional Agile teams. We deploy code to production often, so your ability to thrive in a continuous integration environment will be a key asset as you work with:

  • Server development: TypeScript (NestJS), Python, PostgreSQL
  • Front-end development: TypeScript, React
  • Infrastructure: Azure, Kubernetes

🔧 What You'll Be Doing

  • Solution: Work cross-functionally with our product and UX design team to understand the problem to be solved and lead efforts to define how to solve that problem, including translating UX designs into functional, high-quality user interfaces.
  • Code: Join a results-driven Agile team to implement full-stack features, fix bugs, and refactor code where necessary. While you will build and integrate frontend components, your primary focus and impact will be driving our backend architecture. We use tools such as Jira, GitHub, Confluence, and Slack to help get work done.
  • Test: Understand how our product works and how to test it. Design and implement automated tests in our CI pipeline to ensure your code is safe to run in production across both frontend and backend systems.
  • Learn: We focus on continuous improvement and encourage everyone to utilize their professional development budget. You will have ample opportunities to investigate custom components, and optimize our code to help us scale our product for long-term growth.
  • Coach: Mentor junior developers by working alongside them and providing regular feedback while leading by example.
  • Grow: Continue to broaden your skills in areas of our product that are critical to our rapidly growing customer base.

✅ What You'll Bring

  • A Computer Science, Software Engineering, or Computer Engineering degree or equivalent experience.
  • 7+ years of experience as a developer with a strong focus and expertise in back-end technologies, complemented by solid experience building front-end applications.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate with UX teams and accurately implement provided designs on the frontend.
  • A passion for learning and continuous improvement, but also a bias towards action and driving to achieve results.
  • A demonstrated understanding of how large complex systems work. You can clearly describe previous systems and which components you worked on.
  • Ability to understand and balance business requirements and technical prerequisites to achieve product and architecture goals.
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills.
  • Experience working in an Agile environment using relevant ticket and source control tools.
  • Working knowledge of AI tools and technologies for coding.

🤝 Why Encircle?

We VALUE the team we're building:

  • ⚖️ Define your own BALANCE: We want our team to take the time they need with flexible work arrangements and self-managed vacation time, so they're well-rested and energized.
  • 🏠 Work where you WORK BEST: We invest in creating a comfortable work-from-home environment, with the flexibility to join us in our collaboration hub in downtown Kitchener.
  • 🤝 We are PEOPLE-FOCUSED: Our success is achieved through a culture of collaboration, trust, and transparency.
  • 🌱 Choose your path: We'll support your continued GROWTH along the way.
  • 💪 Your personal WELL-BEING: It is important to us, and we'll provide the support you need to bring your best self to work every day.

Encircle is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply. In accordance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act, 2005, accommodation will be provided throughout the recruitment, selection and/or assessment process to applicants with disabilities.

A Note on Authenticity: We value genuine interest and authentic interaction. Please be aware that we reserve the right to disqualify candidates if it is determined that application materials or interview responses are excessively generated by AI tools or misrepresent your personal skills or experience.

job.title: Forestry New Graduate, Timber Development and Silviculture
job.description:
Job Opportunity: Forestry New Graduate, Timber Development and Silviculture

Employee type: Full-Time, Permanent or Full-Time, Seasonal

Location: Prince George, 100 Mile House, Kamloops, Salmon Arm, or Nelson, BC (field-based)

Compensation: $22 to $28 hourly

Start Date: Late April or May 2027

Come Grow with Us! Forsite is actively looking for recent forestry graduates to join our forestry operations teams. At Forsite, we don't just work together – we support, challenge, and grow together. We believe in flexibility, collaboration, and fostering an environment where everyone can thrive.

WHO WE ARE

Forsite Consultants Ltd. is a leading provider of integrated forest land development and management services. Our staff are industry leaders in forestry, technology, analytics, strategic planning, resource and land management/stewardship and professional forestry. We are a company that is committed to innovation and is constantly growing with clients across North America and abroad in multiple sectors.

We take pride in our team culture, where supporting one another is second nature. We are a dynamic, people-focused business that thrives by delivering value to our customers, creating opportunities for our employees, and drawing on our expertise for sustainable solutions that balance economic, environmental and social goals. We will apply our skills, knowledge and technologies to be the best forest management company.

We foster and sustain a safe and respectful environment of diversity and inclusion where everyone can reach their full potential. If you’re looking for a workplace that values collaboration, innovation and having fun while making a meaningful impact, you’ll fit right in.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Recent graduates gain hands-on experience, develop their skills, and grow their careers alongside experienced forestry professionals in one of two streams:

Timber Development

  • Cutblock and road layout
  • Timber cruising and reconnaissance
  • GPS traversing and digital field data collection
  • Operational planning and forest assessments

Silviculture

  • Regeneration and free-growing surveys
  • Planting inspections and quality assessments
  • Forest health and stand monitoring
  • Reforestation and silviculture projects

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

Forsite welcomes applicants from all backgrounds and is looking for the right person to join our team. If you don’t meet every requirement but bring relevant skills, experience and a great attitude, we encourage you to apply!


Must Have:

  • Diploma or degree in forestry, forest technology, or a related natural resource program (completed or completing by spring 2027)
  • Valid driver's licence and safe driving record
  • A safety conscious attitude

WHO YOU ARE

  • Someone who enjoys working outdoors in all kinds of field conditions
  • A team player who is reliable, accountable, and contributes to a positive team environment
  • Curious and eager to learn, with a strong work ethic
  • Able to work both independently under limited direct supervision as well as in a dynamic team environment

WHAT WE PROVIDE

We offer a flexible and rewarding work environment, including:

  • Competitive wages
  • Hands-on operational forestry experience
  • Mentorship from experienced forest professionals
  • Exposure to LiDAR, GIS, and digital field tools
  • A solid benefits package (for eligible positions)
  • Supported professional development (for eligible positions)
  • A company matched pension program (for eligible positions)

DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION

At Forsite, we are committed to fostering a work environment where everyone feels valued, respected and empowered to succeed. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our team. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, identities and experiences, including but not limited to Indigenous peoples, racialized individuals, persons with disabilities, LGBTQ2+individuals, and veterans. If you require accommodation during the hiring process, please let us know – we are happy to support you.

We thank all applicants for their interest; however, only candidates selected for interviews will be contacted.

job.title: Full-Stack Software Developer, Senior/Intermediate (multiple roles) (hybrid, multiple locations)
job.description:
Our Business: Engineered Intelligence Inc. (EII) is a power infrastructure technology company with headquarters in Calgary and offices in Toronto. We built a cloud-based software product, ENGIN™, that is focused on helping our clients manage their transmission and distribution assets. ENGIN™, enables our clients to monitor and maintain the condition of their assets and networks. ENGIN™, is analytics-driven, with machine learning workloads and a vision of AI assisted planning.

With our intensive knowledge of grid-level assets, we provide our clients with the white glove experience. From software implementation, maintenance, and assistance with regulatory matters to ensure their grids are managed safely and with optimal cost efficiency.

If you would like to learn more, please visit our website at https://www.engineeredintelligence.com/

Who we are: We are a lean, fully remote team of professionals spanning across Canada who truly enjoy working together. We are alight with passion over building this remarkable business from the ground up. Everything we do matters. We are all experts in our field working together to build a strong company and achieve exceptional career milestones.

  • We value Teamwork as we believe great people do great things. We invest in our people and work together to achieve both individual and shared goals.
  • We are Committed to our Customers as our customers were our inspiration, now they are our focus.
  • We value Innovation & Diversity. We explore how to do what has yet to be done; We celebrate the limitless value diverse teams bring to innovation.
  • We take Ownership. This means we take initiative to exceed expectations and exercise accountability every step of the way.

The Position: Do our values align with you? Are you an experienced Full-Stack Software Developer (Senior or Intermediate level)
looking to join a dedicated team working together to build rewarding careers and an incredible business? If so, please read on for more information!

This is a full-time role reporting to a Development Lead. This role will contribute to all stages of the software development life cycle: from participating in design and requirements breakdown, architecture and technical solutioning, analyzing / refactoring code, application development, and creating documentation. Strong full-stack capabilities are desired for this role, but developers with particularly strong experience either on the front-end or back-end and desire to do full-stack are most welcome to apply.

The ideal candidate will have:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science or equivalent
  • 4+ years (Intermediate), 6+ years (Senior) developing dynamic web-based applications in a professional environment
  • Experience with front-end development including:
    • Strong knowledge of typescript and it’s best practices
    • Front-end development using common frameworks – Angular/React
      • Experience with recent versions of Angular or desire to work with Angular
    • Experience with back-end development including
      • Knowledge of and recent experience with Java
      • Experience with frameworks like Spring / Spring Boot
      • Experience with relational databases and ORMs
    • Strong focus on quality including code quality, unit testing, and general advocacy for continuous improvement
    • Experience and good understanding of AI assisted development
    • Ability to work independently and as part of a team; a self-starter, comfortable working with complex systems, eager to take on a wide range of responsibilities.

It would be great if you also have:

  • Exposure to AWS or other cloud providers
  • Experience working for startups and scaleups
  • Any familiarity with electrical engineering concepts and terminology.
  • Interest or exposure to machine learning tools and workloads.
  • Experience building/maintaining multi-tenant product environments, data management for multi-tenant environments, database migrations for multi-tenant environments.

As a Full-Stack Software Developer you will:

  • Be involved throughout the software development life cycle:
    • Offer suggestions and opinions towards technical solutioning for new development tasks.
    • Complete software development tasks across the application with an emphasis on high-quality code.
    • Identify and quantify (i.e. priority, time estimate) “tech debt” within the codebase(s).
  • Produce high-quality, effective, and sustainable code; ensure code is functional, testable, maintainable, and meets business requirements; ensure code is tested with test cases.
  • Understand the ins-and-outs of the company’s software products from a technical perspective (i.e., architecture, design patterns, code structure).
  • Proficient in core aspects of business logic and user interactions with the company’s software products.
  • Accept and produce feedback with the software development team:
    • Perform peer-reviews, review of pull requests for code style, design patterns, and best practices.
    • Perform code reviews and documentation when required to share knowledge with other team members.
    • Contribute towards best practices and technical resources within the development team.
  • Peer within the development team, and mentor to intermediate, junior, and student developers

What we offer:

  • Fully remote work.
  • Flexible work hours (Core working hours 10:00AM to 3:00PM in your local time zone).
  • Autonomy, meaningful responsibility, and opportunities to grow with a scaling enterprise software company.
  • Competitive base salary plus performance incentives.
  • Stock options so you can realize the value created with your work in the organization.
  • Comprehensive benefits, including health and dental.
  • The opportunity to work at the intersection of utility engineering, analytics, and AI, helping customers make better decisions about critical energy infrastructure.

job.title: Learning & Development (L&D) Specialist - EMEA
job.description:
About us

Founded in 1996, Argos Multilingual is a global provider of technology-enabled language, AI and data solutions. We combine human expertise, technology and AI to help organisations communicate, operate and grow across markets.

We work with some of the world’s most recognised companies, from global technology leaders and e-commerce innovators to major organisations in life sciences and manufacturing. Our clients operate at significant scale, giving our people the opportunity to work on complex, high-impact projects.

With 400+ people across 42 countries, cultures and time zones, we are a truly international organisation. We are continuing to expand our capabilities in AI and data alongside our established language and localisation expertise, building on a strong foundation while embracing the opportunities created by new technology.

About the role

Few L&D roles give you the chance to reimagine an entire training library with AI and modern tools. This one does. As our L&D Specialist, you’ll turn fresh ideas into courses people actually want to take, creating learning faster and, above all, building real capability across our workforce. You’ll be one of a two-person L&D team reporting directly to our SVP HR (Head of HR), with real independence and the backing to try new approaches. What you build will shape how hundreds of colleagues learn and grow.

What you'll do

  • Rebuild and modernise our training library with innovative content, recommending what to update, redesign or retire, and drive continuous improvement by tracking industry trends and internal metrics and testing new formats and tools.
  • Plan, organise and deliver training of all kinds, including technical training: build e-learning courses, live sessions, workshops, manuals and knowledge resources in line with the annual L&D plan, and keep them up to date as our tools and processes change.
  • Manage the day-to-day administration of our LMS (currently TalentLMS) and maintain the compliance training matrix, tracking completion and keeping evidence ready for internal and external ISO audits.
  • Coordinate and deliver onboarding training for new hires, and keep improving how we bring people up to speed.
  • Measure impact using models such as Kirkpatrick, run training needs and satisfaction surveys, track L&D KPIs and report clearly to the SVP HR and stakeholders.
  • Manage several training projects at once, building strong working relationships with product owners, managers and subject-matter experts, and coaching internal experts to deliver training well (train-the-trainer).
  • Work closely with the HR team on wider initiatives, such as system implementations and documentation, and take on other related duties as assigned to support HR, L&D and organisational goals.

Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years of hands-on L&D experience in a global organisation, in any industry (technology preferred).
  • Strong experience administering an LMS, LXP or similar platform.
  • Proven experience building e-learning and delivering live training, grounded in learning design principles.
  • Hands-on experience using AI and modern authoring tools to build learning content (for example Articulate 360, Synthesia, Vyond or Camtasia).
  • Comfortable turning learning data into clear reports and insights.
  • Excellent written and spoken English.
  • Nice to have: TalentLMS, ISO compliance training, train-the-trainer programmes or evaluation models such as Kirkpatrick.
  • No localisation experience needed.

Who You Are

  • Dynamic and solutions-driven: you spot what isn’t working, fix it and get things moving.
  • A strong critical thinker who questions how things are done today, learns fast and takes initiative.
  • An owner who takes accountability for your work from start to finish.
  • Great at prioritising: you focus on what matters most and stay organised and detail-minded when plans change.

Location

Why Join Us

job.title: Enterprise Solutions Architect

job.title: M1S Principal Control System Software Engineer
job.description:
Title: M1S Principal Control System Software Engineer

Element: Primary Mirror Subsystem (M1S)

Manager: Primary Mirror Subsystem Element Manager

Type: Full-Time

Location: Tucson, AZ, Hybrid (preferred) or Remote

Job Summary

The Giant Magellan Telescope primary mirror (M1) comprises seven 8.4-meter mirror segments, which must be positioned and controlled to function as a 25-meter aperture telescope. The M1 Subsystem (M1S) consists of an active optics control system and a thermal control system. The active optics control system supports the individual mirror segments providing the means to actively adjust the positions of the mirrors, deform their reflective surfaces to the desired shapes, and protect the mirrors during a seismic event. The thermal control system stabilizes the temperatures of the mirror substrates. M1 Subsystem components are integrated into steel weldments delivered by the Telescope Structures Element. The M1 glass mirror segments are delivered by the Optics and Opto-Mechanics Element. Together, the weldments, mirror segments and the M1 Subsystem comprise the M1 mirror cells.

The M1S Principal Control System Software Engineer will be responsible for development of the GMT M1S active optics and thermal control system control algorithm and software implementation including support actuator control performance tuning, hardware and device control interface development and testing, troubleshooting and resolving challenges, updating documentation, and presenting at peer and gate reviews. This role is also a leadership position responsible for interface development and collaboration with the Observatory Software team. This candidate must be able to exchange ideas and reach consensus from different points of view. This role is considered the bridge between the hardware and software environments which requires a deep understanding of the active support control system and the device control software to implement solutions to interface challenges while working within the frameworks governed by the Observatory Software team. This requires close collaboration within the M1S and the Observatory Software teams developing and testing a design that meets requirements.

Job Duties

  • Lead, develop, maintain, and extend the GMT M1 Device Control Systems.
  • Integrate software with support actuators, hardpoints, thermal-control hardware, calibration systems, and custom electronics.
  • Collaborate with mechanical, electrical, optical and systems engineers.
  • Participate in subsystem integration, laboratory testing, and commissioning activities.
  • Diagnose and resolve hardware, firmware, networking, and software issues.
  • Develop and maintain engineering tools, simulations, and automated test frameworks.
  • Produce documentation, procedures, and operational support materials.
  • Present control system software implementation in formal design reviews.

Qualifications (Required):

  • Bachelor’s, Master’s, or Ph.D. degree in computer engineering, electrical engineering, computer science, physics, mechatronics, or related field.
  • Demonstrated leadership, collaboration, and communication skills especially in reaching consensus to different ideas
  • Demonstrated experience developing software for complex electromechanical systems.
  • Strong proficiency in modern C++ development.
  • Experience with object-oriented software design.
  • Experience developing software for Linux environments.
  • Experience with multithreaded, concurrent and real-time software systems.
  • Experience implementing fault detection, error handling, state machines, and interlock systems.
  • Experience interfacing with custom embedded hardware.
  • Experience working with sensors, motors, encoders, valves, analog I/O, digital I/O, and data acquisition hardware.
  • Experience developing software for precision motion-control systems.
  • Familiarity with closed-loop control systems, particularly for position, velocity, force, and thermal-control loops.
  • Experience using source control systems such as Git.
  • Experience developing automated tests.
  • Experience preparing engineering documentation and participating in formal design reviews.

Qualifications (Preferred):

Real-time control:

  • Experience with the development of deterministic, low-latency software systems.
  • Experience with the implementation of finite-state machines and sequence logic.
  • Knowledge of control theory, including PID control, filtering, feed-forward control, calibration and system identification.
  • Experience supporting systems operating at kilohertz update rates.

Industrial automation:

  • Experience working with Beckhoff hardware.
  • Familiarity with distributed control systems architectures.
  • Experience integrating software with industrial field busses, particularly EtherCAT.
  • TwinCAT development.
  • EtherLab development.
  • EtherCAT development.
  • Modbus development.
  • OPC UA, TCP/IP, and other industrial communications protocols.

Embedded systems:

  • Experience with software development for microcontrollers and custom electronics.
  • Familiarity with serial communications protocols such as RS-232, RS-485, SPI, I2C and CAN.
  • Experience troubleshooting hardware/software integration issues.

Scientific and engineering computing:

  • Experience with MATLAB and Python.
  • Experience processing large engineering data sets.
  • Familiarity with numerical methods, calibration procedures, and statistical analysis.

Software engineering practices:

  • Agile development methodologies.
  • Requirements management.
  • Risk management and configuration management.
  • Hardware-in-the-loop and system-level integration testing.

Domain-specific experience:

  • Telescope control systems.
  • Astronomical active optics.
  • Electromechanical control systems.
  • Thermal management systems.
  • Vibration analysis and mitigation.
  • Pneumatic control systems.
  • Safety-critical or mission-critical systems.

Working Conditions:

  • Normal office environment
  • Lab environment
  • Position located in Tucson, AZ, (relocation assistance available)
  • Pasadena or remote with regular travel to Tucson and Pasadena may be considered
  • Domestic and International travel to visit supplier and M1S integration sites

Physical Requirements

  • No special requirements

Direct Reports

None

Featured Benefits

  • Medical Insurance
  • Vision Insurance
  • 401(k)
  • Dental Insurance
  • Disability Insurance

Hiring Range

$150,000- $190,000

The salary for this role will be set based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to, internal equity, experience, education, and training.

We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you have the right to request an accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access our career center as a result of your disability. To request an accommodation, contact a Giant Magellan Telescope Corporation Human Resources Representative.

job.title: AI Security & Emerging Trends Portfolio Manager
job.description:
About SANS

Founded in 1989, SANS Institute (SANS) began as a cooperative research and education organization. Over the next 25 years, it grew to become the most trusted and widely recognized provider of information security training and certification in the world. Today, SANS has served more than 300,000 cybersecurity professionals around the world, with more than 60,000 earning Global Information Assurance Certification (GIAC) security certifications—the leading certification that provides assurance to employers that their people and prospective hires can do the job.

At the heart of SANS is a community of practitioners, from auditors and network administrators to CISOs, who share their lessons learned and collaborate on solutions to the challenges they face. These experts, working across corporations, government agencies, and universities, come together to support and strengthen the global information security community.

Why SANS?

At SANS, our culture is defined by three pillars: Mission, Brand, and People.

  • Our Mission is to hire people who understand the importance fighting against cybersecurity threats.
  • Our Brand reflects a commitment to delivering the highest quality training.
  • Our People are grounded in a culture of fairness, honesty, customer focus, and a pragmatic approach.

What You’ll Achieve at SANS

We are seeking an AI Security & Emerging Trends Portfolio Manager to join our Curriculum team. This role will help translate the vision and ideas of SANS thought leaders into structured, executable projects and programs. This role sits at the intersection of strategy, marketing, product, and sales, bringing rigor, prioritization, and action to a fast-moving thought leadership and go-to-market effort for AI and emerging trends. The ideal candidate has a program management background and experience in thought leadership or marketing and is equally comfortable managing internal communication and evaluating whether new ideas are worth pursuing as they are managing execution from concept to launch.

As a AI Security & Emerging Trends Portfolio Manager, you will:

AI Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Lead the SANS AI cross-functional leadership group
  • Run recurring group meetings
  • Manage tasks from the call and follow up with owners for execution
  • Facilitate and coordinate follow-up conversations and projects, serving as the orchestrator to align key stakeholders and drive outcomes.

Strategic Intake & Prioritization

  • Serve as the front door for new ideas from key SANS thought leaders on AI and emerging topics, capturing and structuring them before they enter the execution pipeline.
  • Develop and apply a prioritization framework that weighs viability, measurability, and community impact against existing commitments in SANS relevant business unit plans.
  • Bring structure to a fast-moving idea environment, helping leadership distinguish true priorities from the many ideas competing for attention.

Program & Partnership Orchestration and Communication

  • Translate high-level vision and broad ideas into scoped, executable projects with clear owners, timelines, and deliverables.
  • Serve as the connective tissue between broad ideas on the front end and the operational teams responsible for delivering ideas that are approved for action.
  • Coordinate projects for thought leadership partnerships with cybersecurity, technology, and AI industry, nonprofit, and governmental organizations.

Thought Leadership Strategy / AI Security Strategy

  • Collaborate with key business unit leaders (e.g., Sales, Curriculum, Marketing, Product) to develop a long-term, central AI strategy for SANS. Incorporate other emerging trends (e.g., quantum) or high-octane topics as required.
  • Strategy will incorporate feedback from customers, students, Sales, etc.
  • Strategy will inform future campaigns and marketing efforts, thought leadership, community engagement, partnerships, GTM messaging, product approach, etc.
  • Brief the executive team and technical advisory group on this strategy. Take feedback and work with key partners (e.g., VP, Curriculum) to finalize and then communicate strategy to key audiences across SANS.
  • Tied into this strategy, develop a cohesive AI and emerging trends thought leadership plan that balances executive visibility, original research, education, industry needs, and community engagement.
  • Partner with Marketing and relevant stakeholders to align output with broader strategy and ensure SANS amplification of thought leadership projects.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

What We’re Looking For

Every SANS employee brings something unique. For this role, we’re looking for candidates with:

  • Signifcant experience (10+ years) leading cross-functional program management within cybersecurity or professional services organizations.
  • Proven track record building executive thought leadership programs and signature content platforms that establish external credibility and drive brand visibility.
  • Experience building and operationalizing expert or speaker networks, including intake processes, governance frameworks, and development pathways for a bench of subject matter experts.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate deep technical or subject-matter expertise into executive-ready content, presentations, and enablement materials.
  • Successful experience leading internal business collaboration, coordinated projects, strategy development, and implementation
  • Familiarity with AI-enabled workflows and/or knowledge systems
  • Track record of developing and leading marketing, communications, or program functions from the ground up in fast-growing or evolving organization.
  • Experience collaborating with public relations and other internal partners in service of executive visibility and brand credibility.
  • Strong executive relationship management and cross-functional leadership skills; able to operate effectively across myriad functions without a direct reporting line to all of them.
  • Excellent written, interpersonal, and verbal communication skills.
  • Unrestricted authorization to work in the USA; visa sponsorship is not available.

Benefits and Perks of Working at SANS

We’re committed to fair and equitable compensation. The expected salary range for this position is $225,000–$240,000 OTE, depending on geographic location, skills, and experience. At SANS, pay equity and transparency are priorities.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package that supports your total well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:

  • Financial Benefits: Competitive base salary, bonus opportunities, and a 401(k) plan with company match.
  • Health & Wellness: Robust medical, dental, and vision plans; company-provided short term disability; optional long-term disability, supplemental life and AD&D insurance for employees and dependents; voluntary benefits including accident insurance and identity theft protection; fitness and wellness programs; and a company paid employee assistance program (EAP).
  • Time Off & Flexibility: Generous paid time off, including volunteer time.
  • Learning & Development: Access to professional development and SANS training opportunities.

Flexibility and Balance at SANS

We support our colleagues with the tools and flexibility they need to thrive, both professionally and personally. As a primarily remote work environment, we are committed to maintaining strong connections, collaboration, and a vibrant culture across virtual teams. While most roles operate remotely, some positions may require occasional in-person presence depending on role-specific or business needs.
