job.title: Full Stack Developer (AI-First)
job.description:
Location: This role is fully remote and open only to candidates based in Latin America. We're not able to consider candidates based in the US or other regions for this position. Our dev team works on Eastern Time (ET).

How we build

We don't type code. Our engineers work through agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) and most of what ships is agent-written. You describe the outcome, the agent plans and implements, the agent reviews its own work, and then you review it.

The first and the last steps are the job. You set the shape before the agent builds, and you're the first human to read what comes back. You own every line that lands in production. Whole-team PR review sits on top of that, not instead of it. "The agent wrote it" never explains a bug here.

Company accounts for Claude, Codex and Cursor are provided and you're expected to use them hard. No token budget to ration.

What you'll do

  • Ship merchant-facing features end to end, from data model to API to UI, directing agents through the whole path
  • Decide the shape before the agent builds it: where a boundary goes, what's sync vs. queued, what the contract is, what gets denormalized
  • Catch what the agent got wrong: the plausible-looking query that doesn't scale, the missing failure path, the abstraction that will cost us in six months
  • Make agent output verifiable with tests that define done, contracts that hold, and changes that can be rolled back
  • Bring new tooling and workflows into the team when you find something better

What we're looking for

Web development and web services architecture. That's the bar, not a specific language.

  • 3+ years building and running production web applications
  • You reason fluently about client-server, sync vs. async, scheduling and background work, caching, and failure modes, and you can explain a decision to an agent well enough that it builds the right thing
  • Architectural patterns are working tools for you, not vocabulary: MVC, layered, hexagonal, DDD, and the code-level patterns underneath. You know when each is worth it and when it's overhead
  • Strong SQL and relational data modeling. Non-negotiable
  • You instrument what you ship. Production observability and performance tooling (Datadog, New Relic, Sentry or similar) is how you find out the agent's code actually works
  • Daily production use of coding agents. You ship with them, you're not evaluating them
  • You can take a codebase you didn't write and an agent's plan for changing it, and tell whether the plan is right

Any language. PHP/Laravel and JavaScript/Vue are a plus. That's our current stack and you'll be in it week one, with agents to get you there.

Also a plus: LLM APIs in production, e-commerce platforms (Shopify, fulfillment), queues and event-driven work, MCP servers or custom agent skills.

Interview process

  1. Intro with our HR Manager
  2. Technical conversation with a Tech Lead and the CTO. Expect to review real agent-generated code and defend architectural calls
  3. Conversation with the CTO of our parent company

job.title: Developer – Digital Products, AI & Innovation (Freelance Contract)
job.description:
Help us build the next chapter of Greenhouse

Over the past two years, we’ve built a clear AI and product innovation roadmap, expanded our in-house development capability and partnered with clients to design and deliver websites, digital products, tools and AI-enabled solutions that drive measurable impact.

We’re looking for an experienced developer to join us – initially on a three-month contract but with strong potential to extend, to help scale and accelerate this next stage of our product and technology capability.

This is not a conventional agency development role.

You’ll work alongside a highly experienced team of strategists, product thinkers and developers to build client products, internal systems and AI-enabled services that support meaningful, real-world outcomes. The role combines hands-on development with the opportunity to shape how technology, automation and AI are integrated across the business and our client work.

We’re looking for someone entrepreneurial, highly capable and excited by innovation. Someone who enjoys building, experimenting and solving complex challenges in a fast-moving environment with genuine purpose behind the work.

Why Greenhouse?

At Greenhouse, we work with organisations tackling some of the world’s biggest challenges, from sustainability and climate to social impact, behaviour change and purpose-driven transformation.

We believe technology and AI should be used responsibly, ethically and intentionally — not simply for automation’s sake, but to unlock better thinking, better experiences and better outcomes for people and planet.

We’re building a different kind of agency:
• one that moves fast
• experiments boldly
• embraces AI thoughtfully
• develops products and services that create measurable impact for clients

This role will play a central part in that evolution.

The opportunity

You’ll work across three areas


Building high-quality digital experiences

You’ll support the development and evolution of client websites and digital platforms, helping us improve quality, scalability and technical performance across projects.

This includes:
• building and improving websites
• working across Webflow, WordPress and modern CMS platforms
• integrating APIs and third-party services
• improving development workflows and handovers
• introducing scalable technical approaches where appropriate
• supporting experimentation with headless and component-driven systems
• helping raise technical standards across the agency

Building AI-powered products and services

A major focus of this role is helping Greenhouse create and develop new digital products, AI tools and scalable services that we can offer clients.

We want to create innovative products and capabilities that:
• help clients accelerate impact
• unlock new value and insight
• improve engagement and performance
• create new revenue opportunities for Greenhouse

You’ll help turn ambitious ideas into real, usable products via prototyping, testing and evolving solutions that combine strong technical foundations with practical client value.

This could include:
• AI-powered audience tools
• insight and intelligence platforms
• campaign and engagement tools
• automation systems
• API-driven digital services
• internal IP and productised offerings

We’re looking for someone excited by experimentation, product thinking and building things from the ground up.

Helping transform Greenhouse through AI

Alongside client-facing innovation, you’ll help Greenhouse evolve its own digital business and operational workflows.

We’re embedding AI across the agency to help us:
• work smarter
• reduce manual overhead
• improve delivery quality and speed
• strengthen collaboration
• optimise internal systems and workflows
• create better outcomes for clients

You’ll work closely with leadership and the Impact Lab team to identify opportunities where AI, automation and better systems can fundamentally improve how we operate.

This is about meaningful transformation, not superficial AI adoption.

We care deeply about:
• ethical AI use
• transparency
• responsible implementation
• human-centred design
• protecting creativity and critical thinking
• ensuring technology supports people rather than replacing them

We want someone who shares those values.

What we’re looking for

We’re less interested in rigid job titles and more interested in mindset, capability and ambition.

You might be a strong midweight developer ready for something bigger, or a more experienced developer looking for meaningful work with greater autonomy and influence.

You’ll likely have:
• strong JavaScript fundamentals
• experience building digital products, websites or applications
• confidence working with APIs and integrations
• backend experience with Node, Python or similar
• experience shipping real-world projects end-to-end
• curiosity about AI and emerging technologies
• comfort working in ambiguity and moving quickly

Bonus points for:
• experience integrating AI into products or workflows
• no/low-code experience (Webflow etc.)
• agency experience
• product-thinking mindset
• experience with AI coding tools such as Claude Code or Codex
• strong opinions on where custom development adds value versus off-the-shelf tools

Who you are

This role is for someone who:
• loves building new things
• is entrepreneurial and proactive
• wants ownership and influence
• enjoys solving complex problems
• cares about ethics and impact
• is excited by the possibilities of AI
• wants to help shape the future of a growing business

You’ll thrive if you’re motivated by purpose as much as technical challenge.

Contract details

  • Initial three-month freelance contract
    • Strong potential to extend
    • Opportunity to shape long-term technical direction at Greenhouse
  • UK based

Why this matters

We believe agencies need to evolve.

The combination of AI, product thinking and communications strategy is creating entirely new opportunities to help organisations create change.

We want Greenhouse to be at the forefront of that shift.

This role is an opportunity to help build what comes next.

job.title: Intermediate Azure Software Developer
job.description:
Overview

Quest Software is seeking an intermediate Azure SaaS Software Developer to help define and advance AI-first software development practices for our industry-leading On Demand Migration product on the Microsoft Azure platform. This role is intended for an experienced developer who combines strong C#/.NET, Azure, cloud architecture, and backend engineering skills with proven hands-on experience using AI coding agents, AI-assisted development platforms, and agentic development workflows in production software engineering.

We are looking for a Back-End Developer to work on our market-leading On Demand Migration SaaS offering. This team member will be responsible for designing and implementing new features in the Microsoft stack of technologies. If you are eager to work with new technologies to design and develop software solutions used for local, networked, and internet-related programs, Quest is the place to be.

Responsibilities

  • Contribute to the adoption of AI-first software development practices across the project team.
  • Use AI coding agents and AI-assisted development platforms extensively in day-to-day product engineering, including solution design, implementation, automated testing, debugging, troubleshooting, refactoring, code reviews, and technical documentation.
  • Design reusable prompts, agent instructions, development workflows, validation steps, and guardrails that enable consistent and responsible AI-assisted software development.
  • Design, build, test, and maintain scalable, serverless, cloud-native SaaS capabilities using C#/.NET and Microsoft Azure technologies, including Azure Functions, Microsoft Graph API, AKS (Azure Kubernetes Service), ACA (Azure Container Apps), and Event Hubs.
  • Contribute to architecture, technical decision-making, code reviews, CI/CD, release readiness, and ownership of critical product components in an Agile SCRUM environment.

Qualifications

Required: 

  • Microsoft SharePoint and/or Microsoft Teams development experience
  • Completion of a computer science undergraduate degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • three or more years of professional software development experience, including strong hands-on C# and .NET experience.
  • Demonstrated professional experience using AI coding agents, AI-assisted development tools, or agentic development workflows as a substantial part of real software development work.
  • Advanced practical experience with GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Windsurf, or comparable AI-powered development platforms.
  • Demonstrated ability to apply AI coding tools to improve software design, implementation productivity, code quality, automated testing, debugging, troubleshooting, refactoring, code review, or technical documentation.
  • Experience building Azure cloud applications using event-driven, service-based, or microservice architectures.
  • Experience building scalable backend services and distributed systems.

Nice to Have:

  • SharePoint development or administration experience.
  • Experience with O365, CSOM, Microsoft SharePoint Migration API, or Microsoft Graph API.
  • Experience with Microsoft 365, CSOM, or Microsoft Graph API is a strong advantage.
  • Asynchronous programming
  • Experience developing and maintaining YAML CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or similar systems.
  • Experience with Azure OpenAI Service, large language model APIs, evaluation frameworks, observability, or AI application security.
  • Experience with Angular or React and TypeScript.

Company Overview

Quest Software builds the foundation for enterprise AI with solutions in data governance, cybersecurity, and platform modernization. More than 45,000 companies — including 90% of the Fortune 500 — trust Quest to solve their most critical IT challenges. job.title: Senior Engineering Manager, Fabric
job.description:
About Ditto:

Ditto is redefining how data moves at the edge. Our mission is to make it seamless for developers to build resilient, real-time applications, regardless of network conditions. Whether you're in a stadium, airplane, or remote military base, Ditto's peer-to-peer sync engine ensures devices stay connected and data stays consistent, even without internet. With more than $145 million in funding and trusted by organizations like Chick-fil-A, Delta Airlines, and the U.S. military, Ditto powers mission-critical experiences across aviation, retail, travel, hospitality, defense, and more. As a globally distributed, fast-growing startup, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team that reflects the wide range of perspectives needed to solve the world’s hardest connectivity problems.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead the Fabric engineering organization.

Fabric is an important product for Ditto and is at an exciting stage. We have an existing product and customer base, and we are now focused on scaling the product, expanding its capabilities, and building the engineering foundation needed for the next stage of growth.

This role is both a people leadership and product engineering role. You will lead a team of engineers, work closely with Product and Design, engage with customers and customer-facing teams, and partner with other engineering organizations across Ditto.

You will help turn customer and business needs into a clear engineering roadmap while maintaining a high bar for quality, reliability, and execution.

What You'll Do

Lead and grow the engineering team

  • Build, grow, and retain a high-performing engineering team.

  • Hire and develop strong senior engineers and technical leaders.

  • Set clear expectations for engineering execution, quality, and ownership.

  • Coach engineers and managers and help create clear career growth opportunities.

  • Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Drive product execution

  • Own engineering delivery for Fabric and MaintainOps.

  • Partner closely with Product and Design to define priorities, scope, and sequencing.

  • Turn customer problems and business goals into clear engineering plans.

  • Help the team move quickly while making thoughtful tradeoffs around quality, reliability, and technical debt.

  • Create predictable execution and surface risks early rather than allowing surprises late in the process.

Build a scalable product

  • Lead the engineering evolution of Fabric as the product and customer base grow.

  • Ensure the platform can scale across customers, users, data, and integrations.

  • Improve reliability, observability, security, and operational maturity.

  • Make pragmatic architectural decisions while working closely with senior technical engineers.

  • Balance near-term customer needs with investments that create a strong long-term foundation.

Work across Ditto

Fabric touches many parts of Ditto, so this role will work closely with:

  • Product and Design

  • Platform Engineering

  • SDK Engineering

  • Data and Sync Engineering

  • Portal Engineering

  • Solutions and Customer Success

  • Support and other customer-facing teams

You will help make sure Fabric works well as part of the broader Ditto product ecosystem.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of engineering management experience.

  • Experience building and leading strong engineering teams, including hiring, coaching, performance management, and career development.

  • Experience leading engineering for a customer-facing SaaS or enterprise software product.

  • A track record of delivering products in a growth-stage or fast-moving environment.

  • Strong product sense and the ability to work closely with Product and customers.

  • Ability to understand technical tradeoffs and have productive conversations with senior engineers.

  • Strong execution skills and a bias toward solving problems rather than adding process.

  • Experience balancing speed, quality, reliability, and technical debt.

  • Comfortable operating with ambiguity and changing priorities.

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively across engineering, product, and customer-facing teams.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with workflow, operations, field service, asset management, maintenance, or other enterprise operational software.

  • Experience building products used by distributed or frontline teams.

  • Experience with mobile or offline-capable applications.

  • Experience with multi-tenant SaaS platforms.

  • Experience with data platforms, integrations, APIs, authentication, or authorization.

  • Experience scaling an engineering organization through a significant growth phase.

What Success Looks Like

In your first year, you will:

  • Build a strong and high-performing Fabric engineering organization.

  • Establish clear ownership and predictable execution.

  • Deliver key Fabric and MaintainOps product commitments.

  • Improve engineering quality, reliability, and operational maturity.

  • Hire and develop additional senior engineering talent.

  • Establish a clear technical and product direction for scaling Fabric.

  • Build strong working relationships across Product, Engineering, and customer-facing teams.

  • Help Fabric become a scalable product and an important part of Ditto's growth.

The Benefits of Building with Us

We offer competitive salaries and meaningful equity. We believe everyone on the team should have a stake in what we’re building. Benefits vary by region to make sure you're covered in the ways that matter most. In the US, that includes health, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance, plus a 401(k) and flexible spending accounts.

Regardless of where you live, everyone at Ditto can utilize flexible time off. And while we work remotely, our Atlanta office is always open if you ever want a place to work or meet up with teammates.

Apply Anyway

At Ditto, we know game-changers don’t always come wrapped in a “perfect” resume. Years of experience? Every single bullet point checked? Meh. That’s not what drives us.

What does matter?

  • Grit.

  • Curiosity.

  • Adaptability.

  • And a genuine spark for what we’re building.

So if you’re fired up about our mission but not sure you tick every box - hit that apply button anyway. Use your application to show us how you’ll make an impact here.

We’re always on the lookout for exceptional humans who want to grow, stretch, and build something meaningful with us.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Ditto is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. Ditto is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let us know.

job.title: Developer
job.description:
Company Description

Job Description

What you'll bring

You bring developing hands-on experience with cloud platforms, CI/CD pipelines, and automation tooling, and can contribute to real-world DevOps workflows from day one.

  • Experience with CI/CD tooling such as Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, or GitHub Actions to build and maintain automated delivery pipelines
  • Hands-on with Docker, Kubernetes, or Cloud Foundry and Kyma runtimes
  • Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python or Bash for automation tasks
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or Ansible
  • Understanding of platform security concepts, including identity and access management and secret management
  • A degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field — or equivalent experience

We also look for people who build trust naturally, communicate with clarity, keep the customer at the centre of what they do, and bring emotional intelligence and genuine problem-solving ability to the challenges they face.

In addition to the skills and experience specific to this role, all positions at SAP require candidates who are comfortable using AI tools — including agentic AI — in their day-to-day work, from crafting effective inputs and automating routine tasks, to evaluating AI-generated outputs for quality and driving adoption of AI practices within their teams.

What you'll build

You will help design, automate, and operate the cloud engineering infrastructure that powers SAP Ariba's procurement landscapes — from delivery pipelines to multi-tenant platform environments.

  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) applications, including SAP Project "Piper"
  • Administer multi-tenant setups, subaccounts, and environments across Cloud Foundry and Kyma runtimes
  • Provision and configure SAP BTP services using Infrastructure as Code tooling
  • Manage platform security, including identity and access management configuration, certificate rotation, and vulnerability scanning
  • Contribute to automation tools that simplify landscape provisioning and accelerate customer adoption

Where you belong

You will join the Procurement Engineering Services team within SAP Ariba — a team working at the intersection of cloud engineering, DevOps, integration, and automation to build procurement landscapes that help customers realize value faster. You will partner with product engineering, Cloud Operations, consulting teams, and ecosystem partners. This role is based at SAP Labs in São Leopoldo, one of SAP's key engineering hubs in Latin America.

Qualifications

job.title: Founding AI/ML Engineer
job.description:
About the Role

Join an early-stage AI team developing reliable, transparent foundation models for high-stakes domains. As a founding engineer, you will own major workstreams from research through enterprise deployment.

What You'll Do

  • Design and implement novel neural architectures in PyTorch, balancing accuracy, latency, and hardware constraints.

  • Build models that extract information from unstructured data and support transparent reasoning through constrained decoding, inference-time search, and principled abstention.

  • Develop pre-training, fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning pipelines for multi-node GPU clusters, including evaluation and hyperparameter sweeps.

  • Evaluate hallucinations using judge models, blinded holdouts, and regression gates, and create synthetic data verified by model critics.

  • Optimize low-latency inference and large-scale structured knowledge lookup, integrating domain terminology and enterprise data.

  • Contribute to technical roadmaps and help grow the engineering team.

What We're Looking For

  • An MS, MTech, or PhD in computer science, electrical engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent research record.

  • Research experience designing, training, and evaluating neural models end to end, demonstrated through publications, a thesis, or significant open-source work.

  • Hands-on individual contributor experience building foundation models and novel architectures from scratch in PyTorch.

  • Experience across model development, including pre-training, fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and model evaluation.

  • Familiarity with distributed training tools such as FSDP or DeepSpeed, inference engines such as vLLM or SGLang, and areas such as knowledge graphs, information extraction, or structured decoding.

  • Experience with biomedical data standards or partner-facing enterprise deployments in mission-critical settings.

Compensation & Benefits

Base salary: $200,000 to $400,000 annually, adjusted for location. Equity: 0.5% to 2%. Visa sponsorship is available, including O-1A, H-1B transfer, and TN support.

Location

Hybrid in San Jose, California.

job.title: Senior Data Engineer / Technical Lead
job.description:
Going helps more than 2 million members travel more for less. We find exceptional flight deals, from mistake fares to deep discounts, and get them to members before they disappear. Our membership has grown on one promise: we save you money on the trips you actually want to take.

We are a small, fully remote team with outsized reach. Every engineer's work lands in front of millions of travelers, often the same week it ships. Now we're rebuilding how we build: simplifying our platform, raising our quality bar, and using AI where it measurably makes a small team faster.

We're hiring a Senior Data Engineer / Technical Lead for our flight data platform: streaming ingestion with Kafka, normalizing and merging flight offers across providers, an S3 data lake (Parquet, Iceberg), and the Elasticsearch cache that serves the prices and deals members see. You'll also own our current deal-detection system until the new platform replaces it.

This role is half technical lead, half business owner. You'll own the platform's technical strategy and know what's being worked on, why it matters, and who's doing it. You'll also own its outcomes with the business: setting goals, reporting what moved and why, and deciding what we do next alongside Product, Marketing, Operations and Analytics.

  • Reports to: Director of Engineering

  • Location: Remote (US time zones)

What you'll do

  • Own the platform end to end. Own the architecture, reliability and roadmap of our data platform, from Kafka ingestion through the lakehouse to the services that consume it. Make the key technical calls, know which to delegate, and keep the platform's contributors and the other team leads aligned through design docs and code review.

  • Be the business's data partner. Own your team's goals. Plan initiatives anyone in the company can understand, report progress and learnings at our cross-functional metrics meeting, and bring a cause and a proposed path when something is off track.

  • Use AI with judgment. Use coding agents and LLM tools where they make you and the platform's contributors faster, verify what they produce, and help set the review and testing standards for AI-generated pipeline code and SQL.

  • Make the data trustworthy. Build the validation, monitoring and alerting that catch bad data before members do, and lead the response when something slips through.

  • Design for change. Build source-agnostic models so we can add or replace data providers without breaking consumers, and make replay and backfill routine instead of risky. Know what the platform costs, where it's slow, and what we can remove. Start simple and earn complexity.

  • Partner with Data Science and Analytics. Make it easy for them to build on reliable data, from dashboards and models to AI-powered member features.

What you know

Required:

  • You’re legally authorized to work in the United States and able to work US-hours.

  • An experienced data engineer. 6+ years in data engineering, including 2+ years as the technical lead for a production data system: owning its technical direction and driving decisions with the engineers around it.

  • A technical lead, not a manager. You stay hands-on in the code and drive technical decisions without needing to make all of them yourself.

  • An owner of outcomes. You want to own goals with the business, explain why numbers moved, and propose what to do next.

  • A systems thinker. You reason clearly about trade-offs between scalability, reliability, cost, and complexity, and you can explain them to people who aren't data engineers.

  • AI-pragmatic in practice. You use coding agents and LLM tools daily, know where they help and where they fail, and verify their output. You've helped other team members adopt them.

  • A strong data modeler. You design models that are source-agnostic and evolve without breaking their consumers.

  • Fluent in streaming. You understand Kafka (or similar), delivery semantics, idempotency, and how to replay and backfill safely.

  • Lakehouse-literate. You understand Iceberg (or Delta/Hudi), catalogs, and distributed query engines, and how they behave at scale.

  • Join Going as a Senior Data Engineer / Technical Lead (remote) and own the flight data platform behind the deals and prices 2M+ members see.Strong in Python and SQL. Python is the primary language of our data platform.

  • A clear remote communicator. You write well, work async effectively, and can turn a technical incident into a plain-English update.

Preferred:

  • Experience in flights or travel: airfare data, GDSs, NDC, metasearch, OTAs, or airline retailing

  • Experience with pricing, alerting, or real-time data pipelines

  • Subscription or membership business experience, including experimentation and A/B testing

  • Hands-on experience with some of our stack: AWS (S3, Glue Data Catalog, EKS), Confluent Cloud (Kafka, Schema Registry, Avro), Apache Iceberg and Parquet, Starburst (Trino), Elasticsearch, Postgres and Redis, Kubernetes, Terraform, Datadog, and Ruby on Rails (our primary backend framework)

  • Experience supporting data science, ML, or LLM-powered features, including building or operating LLM-powered pipeline steps (e.g., enrichment, matching, or data-quality checks) and evaluating their output

  • Took a data platform through a major migration or simplification (e.g., consolidating systems or moving to managed services)

Benefits & perks you'll love

  • The salary for this role is $165,000 + equity

  • 100% remote work environment

  • Annual team retreats, with past destinations including Asheville, Scottsdale, Washington D.C., Vancouver, and Mexico City

  • Open vacation policy, with a 15-day minimum

  • Comprehensive health, vision, dental, and life insurance

  • 401(k) with a 5% match

  • $750/quarter remote work, wellness, and wisdom stipend

  • Up to 12 weeks of paid family leave

  • Meetup stipend when you cross paths with a co-worker

  • Continuing education & development reimbursement

  • Challenging problems to solve and an awesome team to collaborate with every single day

We want you to bring your authentic self to work every single day. We accept you for who you are and consider everyone on an equal opportunity basis without regard to ancestry; age; appearance; color; gender identity and/or expression; genetics; family or parental status; marital, civil union, or domestic partnership status; mental, physical, or sensory disability; national, social or ethnic origin; past or present military service; sexual orientation; socioeconomic status; race; religion or belief; hair length; organ donor status. Going is an E-Verify employer.

‍If you require a reasonable accommodation or assistance for any part of the interview and employment process, please contact us at [email removed] and let us know the nature of your request.

job.title: Account Development Rep, Emerging Brands
job.description:
Company Description

R26_0027973

Eligibility: This is a U.S.-based role. Candidates must be located in the United States at the time of application to be considered.

Job Description

About this job

Olay. Miller Lite. Coca-Cola. Tide. These are brands millions of consumers recognize, but behind every product launch, pricing decision, and place on the shelf is a series of important business decisions. 

That’s where NielsenIQ comes in. 

We help leading manufacturers better understand consumers and the marketplace so they can make smarter decisions about what to sell, how to price it, where to position it, and where to grow next. Our teams bring together industry expertise, powerful data, and NielsenIQ solutions to provide insights and thought leadership that clients can put into action. 

As an Account Development Representative, you’ll be part of that partnership. You’ll build your knowledge of the FMCG industry and NielsenIQ solutions while developing a strong understanding of our clients' business. By asking the right questions and listening closely, you’ll uncover client needs, identify sales opportunities, and connect those needs to NielsenIQ’s unique capabilities. 

You’ll also build a strong network across NielsenIQ and with our clients, collaborating closely with Analytics and other internal partners to identify leads and create new opportunities for growth. 

Responsibilities 

Portfolio & Opportunity Management 

  • Own and grow a defined portfolio of small accounts or sub-segments within larger strategic accounts, with accountability for revenue, pipeline, and renewals. 

  • Own and execute sales opportunities end to end. 

  • Conduct early-stage discovery and qualify expansion opportunities within assigned accounts. 

  • Identify emerging upsell and cross-sell opportunities and escalate appropriately. 

Sales Execution & Client Engagement 

  • Coordinate sales processes including proposals, requirements gathering, and internal alignment. 

  • Lead advanced client interactions such as follow-up calls and demo coordination. 

  • Prepare opportunity materials, pricing drafts, and account intelligence summaries. 

  • Develop understanding of markets, products, client needs, portfolio offerings, and sales processes. 

Renewals & Forecasting 

  • Contribute to renewal readiness by supporting account analysis, usage insights, and renewal-related materials. 

  • Maintain accurate CRM updates for leads, opportunities, activities, contacts, and tasks while contributing forecasting inputs. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration 

  • Serve as a liaison between Sales and cross-functional teams for deal support. 

  • Build commercial capabilities toward full-cycle account ownership.

A little bit about you 

Does the idea of working for an established company with a start-up culture excite you? Is being on a diverse team with a focus on work-life balance important to you? Are you a self-starter eager to make a name for yourself in a fast-growing company that rewards good ideas? If you answer yes to these questions, NielsenIQ may be the company for you. 

​​

Qualifications

  • 1–3 years of experience in full-cycle B2B sales, ideally SaaS, data/analytics, consumer insights, or technology. 

  • Demonstrated success in driving new business with a strong hunter mentality and the ability to close high-value deals. 

  • Skilled in building and managing a robust pipeline with visibility into deal stages, conversion rates, and forecast accuracy. 

  • Good relationship-building skills focused on customer success and long-term value creation. 

  • Experience with pipeline generation and qualification. 

  • Experience in outbound prospecting across email, phone, and sales sequences. 

  • Experience running discovery calls and coordinating solution demonstrations. 

  • CRM management experience (Salesforce or equivalent). 

  • Strong time management and prioritization skills. 

  • Understanding of ICPs, market segmentation, competitive positioning, and forecasting fundamentals.

Competencies

  • Account Planning, Pipeline Management, Qualification, Negotiation, Closing Effectiveness, Building Value Propositions, Value Selling, Account Management, Managing Relationships, and Account Expansion.

US Benefits

  • Flexible spending accounts and a Health Savings Account (including company contributions). 
  • Life and AD&D insurance. 
  • 401(k) retirement plan including company matching contributions. 
  • Disability insurance. 
  • Tuition Reimbursement. 
  • Discretionary paid time off program and 11 paid holidays. 
  • Flexible working environment 
  • Volunteer time off 
  • LinkedIn Learning 
  • Employee-Assistance-Program (EAP)

 

Additional Information

This role has a market-competitive salary with an anticipated base compensation of the following range: $50,00.00 – $77,000.00.  Actual salaries will vary depending on a candidate’s experience, qualifications, skills, and location. This role is also eligible for a sales-based incentive or performance-based bonus. Other benefits include flexible working environment, comprehensive health insurance, industry-leading parental leave, life insurance, education support and more.

job.title: Senior Manager, Talent Development
job.location: Toronto | San Francisco | Seattle | New York
job.description:
Who are we?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

About the Role

We are hiring Cohere’s first-ever Senior Manager, Talent Development. This role is a blank canvas — there is no established Talent Development function, no inherited catalogue of programs, and no playbook to follow. You will be the first person in this role, with the opportunity to create something from scratch, experiment, and shape how development works across the company.

We are growing rapidly, and in 2027 we want to invest seriously in developing our managers, leaders, and people. This role is where that investment will take shape. There is already strong internal demand for this work, and you will own the Talent Development function from strategy and roadmap through to budget, design, and delivery.

What You’ll Do

  • Build manager development programs across new managers, experienced managers, and emerging directors. Design, launch, and continuously improve these programs; create engaging cohorts and a community where managers learn from one another.

  • Drive manager effectiveness. Work with HRBPs to identify management challenges and design practical interventions that improve how managers lead, develop, and support their teams.

  • Establish career and competency frameworks across broad role families. Partner with HRBPs and functional leaders to set consistent expectations for growth and progression.

  • Strengthen talent development processes. Build approaches to talent reviews, succession planning, and high-potential development that create meaningful opportunities for employees.

  • Improve onboarding learning experiences. Partner with HR Ops and functional teams to design engaging learning that helps new employees ramp quickly and become effective.

  • Build for scale. Create simple, effective development tools and approaches suited to a fast-growing orginization, including support for integrating new teams as we expand.

  • Own delivery and impact. Manage the roadmap and budget, make pragmatic build-versus-buy decisions, work with external partners, and measure the effectiveness of your initiatives.

  • Establish the function as a valued capability across the company, with the opportunity to build and lead a small team over time.

What Success Looks Like

  • Launched foundational development programs for managers and leaders with strong engagement and participation.

  • Established clear career development and competency frameworks across prioritized role families.

  • Created a manager development community that people actively value.

  • Demonstrated measurable improvement in manager effectiveness and development outcomes.

  • Established a scalable Talent Development function with clear priorities, strong HRBP partnerships, and effective use of internal and external resources.

Who You Are

  • Proven builder with a track record designing, launching, and delivering manager or leadership development programs with demonstrable impact.

  • 8+ years of experience, including relevant experience in organizational development, career development, competencies, and talent processes.

  • Experience at a fast-growing tech company or scale-up is essential.

  • Practically and commercially minded. You focus on solving real problems rather than introducing unnecessary complexity, and you know when to build, buy, or keep things simple.

  • Exceptional at engagement and facilitation. You can engage demanding or skeptical audiences and create development experiences people genuinely enjoy and value.

  • Strong partner. You build trusted relationships with HRBPs, managers, and leaders, working collaboratively to solve business problems.

  • Able to navigate substantial ambiguity independently. You earn alignment without formal authority and exercise strong judgment on complex decisions.

  • Ambitious to build something lasting. You are excited by the opportunity to establish a capability that scales with the company and grows your impact over time.

Full-Time Employees at Cohere enjoy these Perks:

  • A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

  • Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

  • RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

  • 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

  • Annual enrichment benefits:

    Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.

    Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

  • 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

  • Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.

How and Where We Work:

  • Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

  • For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

  • For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

  • Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply.


We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form, and we will work together to meet your needs.

We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider.

Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers page.

job.title: Senior Java Engineer
job.description:
About Patrianna
Patrianna is a fast-scaling product development company headquartered in Gibraltar, with a dynamic, global team powering our growth. We operate at the intersection of technology and entertainment, building innovative solutions that shape the future of social gaming and deliver outstanding experiences to millions of players worldwide.

We're driven by speed, ambition, and bold ideas. At our core, we're product creators and problem-solvers who thrive in a high-performance environment. We're looking for exceptional talent-smart, adaptable, and motivated individuals eager to make an impact, scale business functions at pace, and continuously improve.

AI-Driven Engineering Culture

We are actively building an AI-driven engineering organization with a clear and deliberate stance: artificial intelligence is a core part of how we build and deliver software — not an experiment, not a trend, and not an optional add-on.

AI is embedded into our engineering workflows, from system design and prototyping to refactoring, testing, and code review. We rely on AI to significantly influence how work is done and to accelerate delivery, while maintaining a high bar for code quality, system reliability, and architectural clarity.

We expect engineers to be fully comfortable working in AI-driven environments and to treat AI as a primary productivity multiplier. Preference for AI-free workflows or resistance to AI-assisted development is NOT aligned with how we operate.

Strong engineering judgment, architectural ownership, and accountability remain essential. AI amplifies our engineers — it does not replace responsibility for technical decisions.

What you will be doing
• Design and deliver clean, scalable, and testable Java-based backend systems with minimal supervision
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams including backend, web, mobile, QA, and product teams
• Take ownership of specific services or functional areas within our large-scale architecture
• Leverage AI tools and assistants as integral parts of your development workflow—from system design to code review
• Contribute to maintaining high test coverage, predictable production behavior, and seamless scalability
• Drive engineering excellence through modern practices and continuous improvement


What we are looking for
• Extensive production experience with Java and its ecosystem
• Solid understanding of relational database principles (preferably PostgreSQL) and messaging concepts (preferably Kafka)
• Strong system design, troubleshooting, and debugging capabilities
• Comfortable and proactive in using AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, etc.) as productivity multipliers
• Practical experience validating, refining, and taking ownership of AI-generated output
• Upper-intermediate or higher level of English

Why you will love it
You'll be at the forefront of AI-driven engineering in a fast-scaling environment where your code directly impacts millions of users. Work with cutting-edge technology (latest Java, Spring Boot, GCP, Kubernetes) while enjoying full remote flexibility, generous leave, and real opportunities for growth. Join a team that treats AI as a core engineering tool—not an experiment—and where engineering excellence, speed, and meaningful impact are part of everyday work.

job.title: Senior QA Automation Engineer, Data Visualization and Platform
job.location: Mexico | Brazil | India | Costa Rica | Honduras | Peru
job.description:
About Sift

Sift is the data infrastructure platform for hardware engineering teams. Sift turns high-frequency telemetry into engineering insights for mission-critical systems. Teams use Sift to build and operate rockets, satellites, autonomous vehicles, energy systems, defense platforms, and more.

Founded by former SpaceX engineers who built the tools behind Dragon and Starlink, Sift is building the data infrastructure to herald the AI era for physical systems.

About the Role

Engineers use our data exploration product to plot and investigate live and historical telemetry at high channel counts.

You will own test automation for that product and our GPU-accelerated charting engine, including the move from legacy charts to the new engine. Your job is to catch functional, performance and cross-browser regressions before customers do, and to turn today's partly manual performance testing into repeatable checks in CI. Later, you will also cover our core application layer: access control, navigation, search and the design system. You will report to the Head of Quality Engineering and work embedded with the data visualization team.

In This Role, You'll:

  • Own the end-to-end suite. Extend and maintain our Playwright tests for panels, annotations, data sources, sharing and plotting. Keep them fast, stable and trusted.

  • Make E2E a merge gate. Get smoke and critical-path tests running on every pull request, cut flakiness and define what blocks a release.

  • Expand browser coverage. Add Microsoft Edge and Firefox alongside Chrome, with a focus on Windows, where many of our customers work.

  • Automate performance testing. Turn our browser and hardware performance study into repeatable tests with frame-time and lag thresholds, driven by our telemetry simulator at realistic channel counts and data rates.

  • Introduce visual regression checks for charts and panels where they add signal without flakiness.

  • Prove the chart migrations. Build a parity suite that compares each legacy chart view with its new-engine version, across time-series, scatter, histogram, FFT and 3D charts.

  • Cover the core application layer. Map coverage gaps and build regression tests for access control (RBAC and ABAC), service accounts, folders, navigation, the home page, search and the design system.

  • Train and guide a QE in another time zone. Onboard a QE who runs regression overnight, and review their results.

  • Shape quality before code merges. Review test plans with engineers, push for unit test coverage in the web app, and test features before release.

  • Report on quality. Track pass rates, flaky tests and performance trends, and surface regressions quickly to the team.

Required Skills:

  • 5+ years in QA automation or SDET roles, with at least 2 years building UI test suites for complex web applications.

  • Strong Playwright and TypeScript skills. You have designed suites, not only written tests: fixtures, test data setup, tagging, parallelization and flake control.

  • Experience running E2E tests in CI, ideally GitHub Actions, as a blocking gate on pull requests.

  • Cross-browser testing experience across Chrome, Microsoft Edge and Firefox on Windows and macOS.

  • Hands-on frontend performance testing: browser DevTools, performance traces, frame rate and rendering analysis.

  • Comfort reading React code and writing unit tests with Vitest or Jest.

  • Experience testing authorization (RBAC and ABAC) and backend APIs, ideally Go services over gRPC.

  • Professional working proficiency in written and spoken English (CEFR B2 or above), used daily for design reviews, test plans, risk reports, working with and training teammates.

  • At least 4 hours a day of overlap with US Pacific time.

Bonus Points:

  • Testing data visualization, charting or WebGL and canvas-heavy applications.

  • Experience with real-time or streaming data products.

  • Visual regression testing with Playwright screenshots or a similar tool.

  • Python scripting for test data and load generation.

  • Familiarity with telemetry, time-series data or hardware test workflows.

  • Using AI agents to write and maintain tests.

  • Testing software that customers run in their own cloud or on-prem.

Engineering At Sift:

  • E2E and browser: Playwright, TypeScript

  • Frontend: React, TypeScript, Vitest, Testing Library

  • Backend and API: Go, gRPC, PostgreSQL

  • Integrations and edge: Rust, Python, Protobuf

  • Test data and scripting: Python

  • Streaming: Kafka-compatible event streaming

  • CI: GitHub Actions

Location:

This is a remote, full-time-equivalent independent contractor engagement for candidates based in Latin America or the Caribbean. You will work at least 4 hours a day overlapping with US Pacific time and collaborate closely with engineering teams in California.

Compensation range: $4,000 - $4,500 USD per month (Latin America and the Caribbean)

Candidates who advance will complete a standardized English assessment administered by a third-party provider. We will share how your results are used and stored, and request your consent, before the assessment.

job.title: Cloud Platform Engineer - FlexHub Team (m/f/d)
job.description:
📢 Join our FlexHub team as a Cloud Platform Engineer! 📢

What is FlexHub?

We are Commerzbank's internal delivery capability – a team of engineers, architects, analysts and experts working directly with business units. Unlike external consultancies, we are colleagues who stay. Based in Frankfurt, Sofia, and Łódź, we drive high-priority initiatives while building internal expertise that lasts.

What's in it for you:

Consulting variety meets corporate stability. You join different teams across the bank when your expertise is needed, then move on to the next challenge. This approach helps you build strong internal know-how and gives you the chance to contribute to meaningful work – one initiative at a time – without sales targets or utilization pressure. No selling. Just a consistent focus on engineering solutions that matter.     

The Cloud Platform Engineer designs, builds, automates and supports secure, scalable cloud infrastructure and services across Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Kubernetes/OpenShift. Working closely with cross-functional agile teams, the role enables application delivery through Infrastructure as Code, DevSecOps practices and observability solutions. The role also ensures compliance, drives continuous improvement and designs scalable, resilient cloud architectures.                                                                                                                                     

Your main tasks are:

  • Design, build and run secure, scalable and resilient cloud platforms on Azure, GCP and Kubernetes/OpenShift using the Cloud Zone Model, meeting banking and data protection requirements.
  • Automate cloud setup and management with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform and Ansible.
  • Configure cloud networks, identities and access controls, and connect services through middleware.
  •  Monitor platform availability and performance, and resolve complex cloud infrastructure incidents.
  • Optimize cloud usage and costs without reducing security or service quality.
  • Work with agile teams to automate application delivery through CI/CD and DevSecOps, advise developers and share cloud knowledge.
  • Explore new cloud technologies and continuously improve platform capabilities.                                                                                                                                   

What is important for us? 👌

  • Experience designing cloud solutions on Azure and GCP, including Cloud Architecture and the Cloud Zone Model.
  • Experience with Cloud Automation and Infrastructure as Code, using Terraform and Ansible.
  • Knowledge of Cloud Network Management and Cloud Security for Azure, GCP and container environments.
  • Experience with containerization and Kubernetes, including OpenShift, GKE or AKS.
  • Practical knowledge of CI/CD, DevSecOps and version control, using Git/Bitbucket or Azure DevOps repositories.
  • Programming knowledge for cloud automation, using Python, JavaScript or Node.js.

job.title: Senior Software Engineer, Fiat Payments & Banking Infrastructure
job.description:
About the Job

zerohash is looking for a Senior+ Software Engineer to architect and build our fiat payment systems, scaling our gateway to Finance 2.0. We are a high-performing team looking for an equally ambitious and driven teammate. The right candidate for this position is detail-oriented, deeply technical, and driven by the challenges of complex financial systems. You are eager to build secure, resilient, and highly scalable banking infrastructure. If you are looking to have a massive impact in a high-growth startup bridging the gap between traditional finance and digital assets, you will find this role uniquely challenging and rewarding.

Role Objectives & Focus

This senior-level role focuses intensely on the backbone of our financial infrastructure:

  • Fiat Payments: Building and maintaining robust fiat rails such as ACH, RTP, FedNow, RFP in the US, and SEPA in Europe.
  • Banking Infrastructure: Direct API integrations with top-tier banking partners.
  • Treasury Management: Developing sophisticated software to autonomously manage and reconcile balances across banking networks.
  • Operational Tooling: Creating internal tooling to streamline financial operations and scale our capacity to handle millions of transactions securely.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the architectural design and hands-on development of our global fiat payment rails (ACH, RTP, FedNow, Request for Pay, and SEPA).
  • Architect, implement, and scale seamless API integrations into our banking partners' systems.
  • Design and build robust treasury management software for internal operations, allowing programmatic liquidity management and automated balance transfers between partner banks.
  • Develop robust internal operational tooling to support reconciliation, automated alerts, financial operations, and compliance reporting.
  • Support the company's vital business by contributing to the design and development of software in an event-driven microservices environment.
  • Develop microservices, primarily utilizing Golang.
  • Work closely with platform engineers to set up new services and scale existing infrastructure.
  • Respond to production issues and alerts, ensuring high availability of our payment gateways.
  • When necessary, communicate directly with banking partners and client technical teams to resolve complex integration issues.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience, specifically focused on Payments, FinTech, or Banking-as-a-Service (BaaS) infrastructure.
  • Deep proficiency with Golang in a production environment.
  • Extensive understanding of traditional fiat networks and clearing systems (e.g., ACH, RTP, FedNow, SEPA, Swift).
  • Strong expertise in SQL and complex database schema design for high-throughput, ACID-compliant financial ledgers.
  • Hands-on experience developing, integrating, and maintaining resilient connections with bank APIs and third-party payment processors.
  • A humble and scrappy get-it-done mindset; you're resourceful and in your element going from 0 to 1.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills; you can systematically troubleshoot complex distributed systems.
  • Comfort with ambiguity; the ability to independently lay out and test clear hypotheses, and solve architectural problems without well-defined direction.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelors in Computer Science or equivalent experience.
  • Experience at a banking-as-a-service, brokerage-as-a-service, or payment-as-a-service business.
  • Proven track record of building treasury management or automated ledgering systems from scratch.
  • Experience with digital assets and crypto infrastructure.
  • Experience with distributed systems design and messaging frameworks (e.g., Kafka, ZeroMQ, or NATS) for data distribution and persistence.

Benefits 

  • Healthcare Insurance: zerohash covers roughly 100% of employee premiums as well as a portion of spouse/children (U.S. only)
  • Vision & Dental Insurance (U.S. only)
  • Chance to earn equity
  • Maternity & Paternity leave (after 6 months)
  • WeWork All Access Membership
  • WFH Yearly Stipend
  • L&D Yearly Stipend (after 6 months)

About zerohash

zerohash is the leading crypto and stablecoin infrastructure platform and the operating system for digital money, powering the next generation of financial services. Founded in 2017, zerohash enables banks, brokerages, fintechs, and payment companies to offer crypto trading, stablecoin payments, and tokenized assets without having to build or manage complex blockchain infrastructure on their own.

The zerohash platform supports three core pillars: Trade, Transact, and Tokenize. Through a single integration, customers can launch regulated crypto buy, sell, and custody services; enable 24/7 stablecoin-based funding, payouts, and settlement; and issue and manage tokenized assets with built-in compliance, risk controls, and reporting. By abstracting away technical, regulatory, and operational complexity, zerohash allows partners to treat digital assets as just another financial primitive: fast, programmable, and global.

zerohash is trusted by some of the world’s most recognized financial and consumer brands, including Interactive Brokers, Morgan Stanley, Stripe, Franklin Templeton, BlackRock, DraftKings, Gusto, Worldpay, Kalshi, One Pay, among others. Today, zerohash infrastructure supports millions of end users across brokerage, wealth, payments, and marketplace platforms globally.

The company is deeply regulated and compliance-first, operating across the U.S. and internationally with licenses and approvals that allow partners to enter crypto and stablecoins with confidence. zerohash has become a trusted partner for enterprises seeking to modernize financial products while meeting the highest standards for security, risk management, and regulatory oversight.

To date, zerohash has raised over $280 million in funding from a mix of leading venture firms and strategic investors, including Morgan Stanley, Interactive Brokers, SoFi, Point72 Ventures, Bain Capital Crypto, Lightspeed Venture Partners, and more.

zerohash has been featured in top-tier media outlets such as Bloomberg, CNBC, The Wall Street Journal, Financial Times, Reuters, Forbes, and CoinDesk, and its leadership team regularly contributes to global conversations on the future of payments, investing, and financial infrastructure.

At zerohash, we're building the infrastructure that makes digital money work securely, compliantly, and at global scale.

The zerohash Culture

All zerohash employees are guided by the following characteristics and core principles:

  • Independence/Ownership - An ability to work autonomously. Join zerohash, pitch ideas, and shape the work you do.
  • Passion - We are innovating quickly and challenging the status quo. We want you to think big, be creative and ​make a difference every day.
  • Collaborative - A good attitude and respect for others. We’re teammates, not co-workers. Everything we do is a shared success and equally a shared failure - we talk in terms of “we” not “me”.
  • Initiative - An ability and passion for learning and asking questions. We will champion you, challenge you and push you to achieve your best - and we expect you to do the same.
  • Empathy - An ability to listen, respect, and understand your co-workers, customers, and everyone you interact with no matter how different they are to you.
  • Adaptability - An ability to respond quickly. We are in a fast-paced industry and so we expect you to be creative when solving a new problem and comfortable under pressure.
  • Transparency - We believe that transparency is critical to empowering everyone to make the best decisions, both the company to its people and vice versa.
  • Integrity - Integrity creates trust. As both an organization collectively and as individuals, it is our most valuable asset.

Follow us

Twitter

LinkedIn

Youtube

Blog

For candidates based in Colorado, please contact colorado-wages @zerohash.com to request compensation and benefits information regarding a particular role(s). Please include with your email the city you reside (or intend to reside in Colorado) and the title/link to the roles you're interested in.

**We’ve recently seen an increase in individuals impersonating zerohash recruiters to target job seekers. Please stay vigilant and keep the following in mind to ensure you are communicating with the real zerohash team:

  • Verified Emails Only: Official outreach will only come from a  @zerohash.com email address.
  • No Messaging Apps: We will never contact you via unsolicited text messages, WhatsApp, or Telegram.
  • Official Applications: Only apply directly through our careers webpage (zerohash.com/careers) or zero-hash.breezy.hr.

See something suspicious?
If you want to verify an interview request or report a fake job posting or suspicious communication, please contact us immediately at talent @zerohash.com. This email is for fraud reports only. Candidate application inquiries will not be responded to.

job.title: Power Platform Developer
job.description:
We are seeking an experienced Power Platform Developer with a strong understanding of Microsoft's Power Platform ecosystem. You will be responsible for developing and maintaining business applications, automating processes, integrating systems, and delivering solutions that solve real business challenges.

Working closely with stakeholders, technical teams, and end users, you will translate business requirements into scalable and efficient solutions using Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, and Microsoft Dataverse. 

Job Details

Work set up: Work from home

Schedule: Monday to Friday | 8 AM to 5 PM | UK Time

Holiday: Will follow UK holidays

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and support solutions using the Microsoft Power Platform.
  • Build and maintain Canvas Apps and Model-Driven Apps.
  • Develop automated workflows using Power Automate.
  • Create dashboards and reports using Power BI.
  • Configure and manage Dataverse environments.
  • Gather and analyse business requirements from stakeholders.
  • Translate requirements into technical designs and functional solutions.
  • Integrate Power Platform solutions with Microsoft 365, Azure, SharePoint, Teams, Dynamics 365, and third-party applications.

Essential Skills & Experience
