job.title: Enterprise Platform Engineer, EMEA
job.description:
About the Role

As an Engineer, Enterprise Platforms, you will be a hands-on owner of the collaboration tools our employees use all day. You will administer, automate, and improve them, working alongside identity, endpoints, and the wider SaaS stack.

This is a role for someone who sees a problem, figures out the fix, and ships it. Our team is small and the scope is broad. You will have real ownership early, a lot of autonomy, and few layers between you and the people you support. You will turn policies, runbooks, and employee needs into reliable configurations, scripts, and self-service experiences. We use AI tools where they make us faster or more accurate, and we expect good judgment about when to trust them.

This role reflects Abnormal VOICE values. You move with velocity, design for long-term ownership and governance, use data with intellectual honesty, stay close to customer needs, and aim for excellence in reliability and simplicity.

What You Will Do

  • Administer Google Workspace: users, groups, org units, shared drives, Drive sharing and DLP, Gmail routing and policies, Calendar and room resources, Meet, and audit and security investigation tooling.
  • Administer Slack (Enterprise Grid): workspaces, channels, user groups, permissions, app approvals, Slack Connect, retention, export and eDiscovery, workflows, and audit logs.
  • Build and maintain automation for joiner, mover, and leaver flows, access requests, deprovisioning, and common employee needs, using SCIM, APIs, webhooks, Apps Script, and scripting.
  • Work with identity (Okta SSO, MFA, group-based access) so Google and Slack access follows least privilege and birthright rules.
  • Support endpoints and other SaaS platforms as needed, including macOS device management and long-tail SaaS administration.
  • Create self-service experiences, runbooks, and enablement content so employees can resolve common needs without escalation.
  • Participate in Tier 2/3 incidents, perform root cause analysis, and feed what you learn back into automation, runbooks, and standards.
  • Add logging, dashboards, and reporting so changes are monitored and audit questions can be answered quickly.
  • Use AI tools where they help (documentation, troubleshooting, request triage, analysis), with human review and appropriate access controls.
  • Partner with Security, GRC, Legal, People, Finance, and IT Service Delivery to deliver changes safely.
  • Triage incoming requests and incidents by impact and urgency, route them to the right owner or queue, and resolve or escalate within agreed response targets.
  • Turn vague or incomplete requests into clear requirements: ask clarifying questions, identify stakeholders and constraints, and confirm the desired outcome before building.
  • Set clear expectations with employees and stakeholders about scope, timelines, and tradeoffs. Give status updates proactively, and flag risks or delays early.

Governance and Compliance

  • Define and enforce standards for external sharing, Slack Connect, guest access, and third-party and OAuth app approval in Google Workspace and Slack.
  • Run regular access and license reviews, using systems and audit logs to find unused, orphaned, or over-privileged access.
  • Keep configuration baselines documented, changes tracked in ServiceNow, and evidence ready for SOC 2, ISO 27001, and FedRAMP audits.
  • Review audit logs and investigate suspicious activity with Security.
  • Document requirements, risks, and approvals for changes so they pass change review and can be audited later.

Scripting and Automation

  • Automate first. If a task happens more than a couple of times, you script it, build a workflow, or turn it into self-service.
  • Write scripts and tools (Python, Apps Script, and shell) against the Google Workspace, Slack, and Okta APIs.
  • Build and maintain integrations and workflows in Workato, connecting identity, HR, collaboration, ticketing, and SaaS systems.
  • Use Torii workflows to automate app discovery, onboarding and offboarding, and license reclamation.
  • Build ServiceNow catalog items and flows so requests are routed, approved, and fulfilled with minimal manual touch.
  • Keep scripts and configuration in version control, with logging, error handling, and clear documentation so others can run and maintain them.

Our Tooling

  • Collaboration: Google Workspace, Slack (Enterprise Grid)
  • Identity: Okta
  • Automation and integration: Workato, Torii, Python, Apps Script
  • Service management: ServiceNow
  • Endpoints and other: Jamf, Zoom, and a long tail of SaaS applications

You don't need experience with every tool. Strong experience with comparable platforms, and a record of learning new ones quickly, is what matters.

How We Work

  • Automation-first: We remove repetitive work rather than absorbing it, and we measure success by manual touches eliminated.
  • Customer-first: Employees are our customers. We respond with urgency, communicate clearly, and fix root causes so the same problem doesn't come back. We do what we say we'll do, or we tell people early when that changes.
  • Fast-paced: Priorities shift quickly and requests arrive from every direction. We move fast, ship in small steps, and iterate.
  • Time management and triage: You juggle incidents, requests, and project work. You sort what comes in by impact and urgency, handle what's urgent first, and protect focused time for project work and for the root-cause fixes that prevent tomorrow's tickets.

What We're Looking For

  • You find the problem before someone assigns it, and you follow through to a documented, working fix.
  • You are comfortable with ambiguity: unclear requirements, incomplete documentation, and shifting priorities don't stop you.
  • You prioritize well when everything feels urgent. You set expectations early and honestly: you say no or "not yet" clearly and kindly, and you explain the reason.
  • You learn new platforms quickly and teach what you learn.
  • You ask the right questions up front: who needs this, what problem it solves, what 'done' looks like, and what could go wrong. You propose a recommended approach rather than waiting to be told.
  • You communicate proactively: status updates, change notices, and honest post-incident write-ups.

Must Haves

  • 2+ years of experience in IT engineering, systems administration, or a similar role supporting business-critical technology.
  • Hands-on administration of Google Workspace (Admin console, groups, Drive and sharing controls, Gmail, Calendar).
  • Hands-on administration of Slack (workspace and channel management, user groups, app management, permissions). Enterprise Grid experience is a strong plus.
  • Working knowledge of identity and access concepts: SSO, MFA, least privilege, directory and group management, and SCIM or standards-based provisioning.
  • Ability to script and integrate systems using APIs, webhooks, Apps Script, Python, or similar tooling.
  • Experience with incident and change management, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and documented follow-through.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including documenting technical processes and explaining complex systems to non-technical audiences.
  • A track record of working independently and taking ownership without close direction.
  • Experience writing scripts or building workflows that automate repetitive IT work, and a habit of automating before doing something manually a third time.
  • A customer-first approach to supporting employees: responsive, clear, and focused on fixing root causes.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and manage your time across incidents, requests, and project work, prioritizing by impact.
  • Ability to set and manage expectations with stakeholders, including saying no or negotiating scope and timelines while keeping trust.

Nice to Have

  • Experience at a startup or high-growth company, where you wore multiple hats, built processes from scratch, or scaled IT through rapid headcount growth. 
  • Experience with acquisitions, tenant or domain migrations, or workspace consolidation. 
  • Experience with data governance in collaboration tools: retention, legal hold, eDiscovery, DLP, and audit log analysis. 
  • Google Workspace or Slack administration certifications, or involvement in their admin communities. 
  • Experience with Okta, Jamf, Zoom, or other enterprise SaaS administration.
  • Experience in remote-first, SaaS-first, or zero-trust environments.
  • Familiarity with version control, configuration-as-code, or CI/CD for platform automation.
  • Experience building self-service workflows, or using AI tools to improve support, troubleshooting, and documentation.
  • Awareness of security and compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP) as applied to collaboration and end-user platforms.
  • Experience with Workato or a similar integration platform (Zapier, Tray.io, Boomi, or Okta Workflows).
  • Experience with Torii or another SaaS management platform, such as Zluri or BetterCloud.
  • Experience with ServiceNow (catalog items, flows, incident, request, and change) or a similar ITSM platform.
  • Experience administering Microsoft 365 (Entra ID, Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint/OneDrive, or the M365 admin center), especially in a mixed Google and Microsoft environment.

#LI-AA1

A note on AI in our process: 
Abnormal AI uses AI-assisted tools to help our recruiting team prepare for candidate interviews. These tools analyze resume content and role requirements to suggest interview questions and areas for the interviewer to explore.They do not make hiring decisions or screen candidates automatically. Every decision about a candidacy is made by a person. Further, if your application is successful and Abnormal AI makes a conditional offer of employment, we will carry out pre-employment checks which must be successfully completed to progress to a final offer. All processes and pre-employment checks are in line with prevailing legislation and Abnormal AI's policies relevant to our security and privacy standards.

Abnormal AI is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. For our EEO policy statement please click here. If you would like more information on your EEO rights under the law, please click here.

job.title: Senior Software Engineer
job.description:
About AlphaSense: 

The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content.

The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!

Requirements:

        Must have -

  • 4+ years of experience as a software engineer, primarily with Python
  • Ideally, you possess an advanced degree (Bachelor's / Master's)  in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a relevant field with a focus on Artificial Intelligence, machine learning, but equivalent industry experience may be considered
  • Expertise on core engineering skills - Cloud, microservice architecture, caching, and queuing.
  • Familiarity with concepts/tools as Docker, k8s, VCS, CI/CD
  • Excellent communication, organizational, problem-solving, debugging, and analytical skills.

Great to have 

  • Experience in async processing of data at scale
  • Experience building and deploying applications that use Large Language Models (LLMs), including structured extraction and prompt engineering
  • Familiarity with classic NLP libraries for tasks like NER, text classification, and pre-processing
  • Experience with LLM tracing, debugging, and evaluation platforms such as Langfuse
  • Event-driven or stream processing (Kafka, Pub/Sub, Temporal)

Responsibilities:

  • Solve Engineering challenges that come along with LLM solutions, such as high latency, non-deterministic output, etc.
  • Implement and scale data processing pipelines that can process high volumes of complex documents with high accuracy and efficiency.
  • Integrate and manage LLM Observability to trace, debug, and monitor every extraction
  • Own systems end-to-end, including(but not limited to) designing, coding, monitoring, testing, CI/CD and on-call support.
  • Testing point to be added
  • Solve distributed systems challenges around latency, throughput, reliability, and cost

AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.

In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.

Recruiting Scams and Fraud

We at AlphaSense have been made aware of fraudulent job postings and individuals impersonating AlphaSense recruiters. These scams may involve fake job offers, requests for sensitive personal information, or demands for payment. Please note:

  • AlphaSense never asks candidates to pay for job applications, equipment, or training.
  • All official communications will come from an @alpha-sense.com email address.
  • If you’re unsure about a job posting or recruiter, verify it on our Careers page.

If you believe you’ve been targeted by a scam or have any doubts regarding the authenticity of any job listing purportedly from or on behalf of AlphaSense please contact us. Your security and trust matter to us.

job.title: Full Stack Web & eCommerce Engineer
job.description:
Join the ACI Learning Adventure!

Our Mission

Welcome to a new era of learning, where individuals and organizations come to transform goals into measurable success. At ACI Learning, we believe that anything worth doing is worth leading the way—with innovation, exceptional experiences, and impactful results.

We provide a full ecosystem of learning and development solutions that empower people and businesses to lead with confidence, learn with purpose, and achieve outcomes that matter. Join us, and together, we'll shape the future of skill-building and professional growth.

The ACI Team

Imagine collaborating with over 200 of the brightest minds who are passionate, grounded, and dedicated to shaping the future of eLearning. Together, we're not just a team; we're a movement in one of the most exciting times in tech.

Purpose-Driven Culture

At ACI Learning, work isn’t just a job. It’s a passion we pour into every project, every day. We celebrate creativity, innovation, and the joy of doing what we love.

Your Opportunity

Are you ready to be part of something transformative? Dive into a world of collaboration, growth, and endless potential. Apply now and help lead the change!

Who We Are

ACI Learning is a leading provider of audit, cybersecurity and IT training solutions, empowering individuals and organizations worldwide to improve their technical capabilities and their cybersecurity with compelling and comprehensive training. Our leadership position extends even further to our new SaaS Learning Platform myACI that goes beyond audit, cyber and IT training to provide organizational and individual knowledge assessment, analytics and training delivery with integrated AI to understand capabilities and skill gaps for organizations.

Full Stack Web & eCommerce Engineer

Remote (US) | Full-Time | Exempt

From the first click through checkout, our websites shape how learners and businesses find, evaluate, and buy from ACI Learning. You’ll improve and extend every step of that buyer journey. You’ll work directly with the Director of Web on a small team, and your work ties straight to revenue and to organic and AI-search visibility.

What you’ll do

You’ll be the hands-on engineer behind everything a buyer touches on our sites, from the first search result to the order confirmation. Day to day, that means shipping new features, keeping a growing stack healthy, and building the systems that let a small team do more. The Director of Web sets direction and priorities. You own the technical decisions and the quality of what ships, from Figma through production, across acilearning.com, acitechacademy.com, and our headless BigCommerce store.

Storefront and checkout

  • Lead day-to-day development of our headless ecommerce storefront (Next.js / React on Vercel), including cart and checkout, and contribute to product experiences for Commercial, Consumer, and Academic buyers
  • Build a new Academic checkout channel for ACI Skill Labs with the Director of Web, from design through launch
  • Instrument and test ecommerce analytics, user insights, and conversion improvements

Marketing sites and SEO

  • Develop and maintain our marketing sites (React / Gatsby with a headless CMS), including a new /learn/ knowledge base
  • Implement technical SEO and AI-search readiness: structured data, crawlability, and fixes for errors that hurt rankings

Content automation

  • Build AI-assisted pipelines with the team that pull news and course content, draft into our headless CMS (Strapi v5) for human review, and publish to the site and search
  • Set up on-demand or incremental builds so time-sensitive pages go live without a full site rebuild

Integrations

  • Maintain the Node middleware and APIs that send order, customer, and product data from our storefront to HubSpot, Stripe, and our CRM, and understand what happens downstream in our ERP, provisioning, and learning platform
  • Partner with Product on integrations such as SSO, catalog sync, and provisioning

Platform health and design system

  • Keep the stack current, secure, and lean: framework and dependency upgrades, patching, Core Web Vitals, and tech debt (refactoring legacy code, consolidating duplicate components, removing unused dependencies, and improving build times and bundle size)
  • Design and build UI from concept to Figma to production, and build our design system: design tokens, a shared React component library that matches our Figma components, and documented patterns that keep every site consistent
  • Document what you build so the team isn’t dependent on any one person

How you’ll work

  • Scope and ship work independently, with a weekly check-in with the Director of Web
  • Pair with teammates and take on work outside your lane when the team needs it, from a copy fix to a checkout bug
  • Explain technical trade-offs to marketing, Product, and leadership, in writing and in meetings
  • Track how your work affects conversion, traffic, and checkout completion

How we use AI

We use AI tools like Claude and Cursor every day to build skills and move faster, not to stand in for your own understanding or judgment. In practice, that means you:

  • Can explain every line you ship, whether you wrote it or an AI tool drafted it
  • Review, test, and debug AI-generated code with the same rigor as your own
  • Know when to use an AI tool and when it’s faster or safer to work it through yourself
  • Use AI to learn unfamiliar code and systems and to raise the bar on documentation, testing, and code quality, and help shape how the team uses it

What you’ll need

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Human-Computer Interaction, Design, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, such as a coding bootcamp, relevant certifications, or shipped work you can show us
  • 5+ years of professional full stack web development, with production sites you can walk us through
  • React and TypeScript code you’ve shipped to production, including at least one Next.js site and one other React framework or static site generator (Gatsby or similar)
  • js APIs and third-party integrations you’ve built and run in production (REST / GraphQL, webhooks, auth)
  • Experience integrating a storefront or web app with CRM, ERP, or payment systems (HubSpot, Stripe, or similar)
  • At least one ecommerce cart or checkout flow you’ve shipped, including payments and the edge cases that come with them
  • At least one production site on a headless architecture: headless commerce or a headless CMS (Strapi preferred, Contentful, Sanity or similar), including content models you designed

What we’d like you to have

Design and front end

  • A portfolio of interfaces you designed in Figma and then built in code
  • A design system you’ve built or extended: tokens, a coded component library (Storybook or similar), and documentation that designers and developers both use
  • Technical SEO fixes you’ve shipped: semantic HTML, structured data / schema.org, page speed, or crawlability

Commerce, data, and platforms

  • BigCommerce Catalyst: building on BigCommerce’s headless Next.js storefront and its APIs
  • HubSpot work you’ve shipped: custom objects or properties, forms, workflows, or HubSpot API integrations, such as syncing ecommerce or website data into HubSpot
  • GA4 and Google Tag Manager, ecommerce event tracking, and A/B tests or behavior analysis (such as Microsoft Clarity) that changed what you shipped
  • Owned deployments and environments on modern hosting (Vercel, Netlify, Render, or similar) and Git-based workflows
  • A refactor or cleanup you’ve led in an existing codebase, and what it improved

AI, search, and media

  • A project or experiment where you applied AI to how software gets built or how people find information (AI search, LLM citations)
  • Scheduled jobs or workflows that call LLM APIs (such as the Claude API), with human review built in
  • Algolia or a similar search platform you’ve implemented or tuned
  • Work with video platforms (such as JW Player) and their APIs for clips, captions, and transcripts

Background

  • Time on a marketing-site or growth team, not only application development

At ACI Learning, we offer a competitive, experience-driven salary range that aligns with your qualifications and contributions. To that end, the posted salary range reflects our most reasonable assumption of pay for this position at the time of posting.

Pay range

$105,500—$123,500 USD

Why ACI Learning is Your Next Big Move

For Full-Time, Benefits Eligible Positions

Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage—starting the 1st of the month after your hire date.

Four weeks of paid parental or medical leave, so you can focus on what matters most.

Flexible PTO policy, sick time, and eight paid holidays — because we believe in balance.

401(k) retirement plan so you can invest in your future from day one.

One free course each year after 90 days — advancing your skills is part of the job.

Tuition assistance to support your continued education and professional growth.

job.title: Staff QE, Mobile
job.description:
About AlphaSense: 

AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit www.alpha-sense.com. Come join us.

About the Team:

Our diverse Product & Engineering team values innovation, collaboration, and the continuous improvement of our platform. We offer a dynamic work environment where employees can grow and thrive while working on cutting-edge technology that shapes the future of AI and search.

At AlphaSense, we believe that diverse experiences and perspectives are critical to our success. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all employees feel valued and empowered to be their authentic selves.

About the Role: 

Investors and analysts open our app between meetings, on a train, before a call, and act on what they see. Mobile releases go through app stores and cannot be rolled back, so a problem can stay in customers' hands for days.

Our mobile product is growing fast, with new AI workflows arriving on iPhone, iPad and Android at the pace of the rest of the platform. Our quality practice has real foundations, including Appium and native UI test suites and real-device runs, but our newest features are ahead of our automated coverage, and release confidence still depends too much on individual effort.

As Staff Quality Engineer, you own one question: can we ship mobile with confidence, every release, on all platforms? You decide what we test and what we deliberately leave out, and you turn what you build into a way of working that Mobile Engineering owns with you.

You will report to the head of Quality Engineering and work day to day with the iOS and Android teams, alongside backend, web and platform QE.

What Makes this a Staff role:

  • You set direction, not a task list. Nobody hands you a test plan. You look at the product, the release risk and the team, and decide what matters most and why.
  • You own the outcome across platforms. Your scope is the quality of the product across clients, not one app or one team.
  • You work through influence. You are an individual contributor. Your standards stick because engineers see their value, and success means they write more testable code, make better release calls and need you less over time.

What You’ll Do: 

  • Define mobile quality strategy. Set the long-term strategy built on "Quality by Design" and "Automation by Default": test layers, device and OS matrix, and release criteria for iOS and Android.
  • Set metrics the team can act on. Define quality metrics and coverage standards with Mobile Engineering and Product, so quality is measurable and sustainable without you.
  • Turn release day into a clear call. With no instant rollback, own the quality gates, staged rollouts and evidence behind every go or no-go decision.
  • Connect mobile to the rest of the platform. Mobile shares APIs and services with web, and customers update apps slowly, so changes elsewhere can break mobile after they have shipped. You are accountable for that risk.
  • Make the test platform dependable. Keep real-device and CI runs stable and fast (Bitrise, BrowserStack, GitLab, Allure), including test data and enterprise (Intune/MDM) builds.
  • Use AI where it earns its place. Use tools such as Claude Code, Cursor or Copilot yourself, and help the team decide where they help and where human judgment must lead.
  • Leave the team stronger. Coach engineers and QEs, review designs for testability, and leave behind standards other teams adopt.

What Success looks like:

  • First 90 days: You have audited current coverage, agreed a prioritized plan with Mobile Engineering and delivered your first measurable improvement.
  • By 6 months: Critical mobile journeys are covered in the right layers on both platforms, and release readiness is an evidence-based call.
  • By 12 months: Mobile quality is a practice the team owns, and other portfolios borrow your ideas.

Who You Are:

  • A quality engineer with 8+ years of experience, including 2+ at Staff or Lead level. You have connected quality strategy across web and mobile, not just worked on mobile alone, and set direction across several teams or apps as an individual contributor without people-management authority. You can show what changed because of it.
  • Strong hands-on experience testing native mobile apps on at least one platform (iOS or Android), with working knowledge of the other. You are comfortable with real-device cloud and CI/CD for mobile builds, can work with tools such as XCUITest, Espresso, Compose UI testing or Appium, and code in at least one language such as Kotlin, Java, Swift or Python.
  • Strong debugging skills across the mobile stack, from crash reports to network traces, and a good understanding of how mobile releases move through the app stores.
  • Excellent test design and API testing, and comfortable in the backend: you can read APIs, debug across the client and service boundary, and work with contracts.
  • Strong understanding of continuous delivery and release gating, with experience in test management systems such as Allure TestOps.
  • An active AI tool user, with examples of where it helped and where it fell short.
  • Practical about trade-offs, and able to explain a release call to engineers and to non-technical leaders.

Bonus points:

  • Enterprise mobile experience (MDM/MAM, Intune, SSO, mobile security standards such as OWASP MASVS).
  • Experience building a mobile quality practice from an early stage.
  • Mobile performance testing (app start time, memory, battery) and release monitoring (crash and performance signals, staged rollouts).
  • Experience across both iOS and Android.

What we offer:

  • Playing a part in the story of a fast-growing company
  • Competitive compensation package
  • Lunch and recreational benefits
  • Occupational health care

AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.

In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.

Recruiting Scams and Fraud

We at AlphaSense have been made aware of fraudulent job postings and individuals impersonating AlphaSense recruiters. These scams may involve fake job offers, requests for sensitive personal information, or demands for payment. Please note:

  • AlphaSense never asks candidates to pay for job applications, equipment, or training.
  • All official communications will come from an @alpha-sense.com email address.
  • If you’re unsure about a job posting or recruiter, verify it on our Careers page.

If you believe you’ve been targeted by a scam or have any doubts regarding the authenticity of any job listing purportedly from or on behalf of AlphaSense please contact us. Your security and trust matter to us.

job.title: Solution Architect (Anaplan) m/f/d
job.description:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.

What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.

Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.

Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebratingour wins – big and small.

Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!

Anaplan is seeking a Solution Architect to join our Professional Services team in Germany—a group of expert consultants who are passionate about delivering real, measurable value through Anaplan’s cutting-edge planning platform.

As a key member of our Professional Services team, you won’t just be implementing solutions, you’ll shape the future of enterprise planning for our most strategic customers. This team partners closely with stakeholders across Finance, Supply Chain, and Sales Performance Management to solve complex business challenges with smart, scalable solutions. From the very first engagement, you’ll have the opportunity to lead design, delivery, and strategic advisory work that drives transformation at the enterprise level.

As we drive financial transformation, you will be a key player in architecting the future direction of decision excellence in enterprise grade companies across Germany. You will influence and drive a companies planning direction and play a pivotal role in delivering the outcomes the CFO, CIO and CEO need to take their business to the next level. 

We’re known for collaboration, deep expertise, and ability to unlock the full potential of Anaplan’s powerful connected planning platform. You’ll work with Anaplan’s industry-leading Hyperblock™ technology that delivers real-time data capabilities, and best in class planning and modelling capabilities. Grow your own skills while helping customers outpace disruption and outperform the competition—by planning smarter, faster, and more effectively.

Your Role

As an Architect, you are responsible for the successful delivery of Anaplan planning solutions in some of our most important strategic accounts. 

  • Serve as the Architectural SME for large-scale connected planning solutions.
  • design ownership across engagements, acting as design authority towards customers and partners, and solution review and quality assurance.
  • Work with customer teams to transform and optimise business process through the Anaplan Platform.
  • Translate existing solutions, spreadsheets, and business problems into sophisticated Anaplan multi-dimensional models.
  • Support scoping, estimations and customer presentations as part of a solution sales process.
  • Assist with knowledge management, mentoring and enablement across the Professional Services Teams.

Your Qualifications

We’re looking for smart, consultative professionals who love solving problems, building relationships, and pushing boundaries. We want you to bring your vision, experience, and passion to our team – helping our customers to out-predict, out-plan and outperform their competitors. 

  • 3+ years of experience implementing planning or EPM solutions in a customer-facing context (consulting, Professional Services or partner).
  • Hands-on modeling in a multidimensional planning tool. Anaplan is ideal, but experience with TM1, OneStream, Pigment, Board, Jedox or similar is a valid basis.
  • Solid understanding of planning processes in finance (FP&A), supply chain (e.g. S&OP, demand and supply planning), sales or workforce planning
  • Experience running workshops, gathering requirements, presenting solution design.
  • German (C1 or higher) and fluent business English.
  • Willingness to travel within DACH.
  • Ability to work remote and independently.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)

We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.  

Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer  

It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.

Anaplan does not:  

  • Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.  
  • Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.  

All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to [email removed] before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.  

Privacy & AI Notice

Candidate data processed during our recruitment activities is handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Notice. This may include the use of artificial intelligence or automated tools to assist our team in evaluating qualifications.

job.title: Senior Software Engineer (Python/Data)
job.description:
Fleetworthy offers the only complete technology suite for fleet readiness, uniting safety and compliance, toll management, and weigh station bypass solutions. We help fleets streamline operations, control costs, and operate with confidence. 
 
Trusted by 90% of the top fleets in North America, Fleetworthy offers the most adopted toll management solution and largest weigh station bypass network. Going beyond regulatory requirements, our safety and compliance capabilities strengthen safety programs and enable proactive audit readiness. We support millions of vehicles and drivers and are recognized across the industry for innovation and leadership. 
 
Fleetworthy is shaping the future of fleet readiness with AI-enabled, connected fleet technology that keeps drivers safe, fleets compliant, and operations running at peak efficiency. Learn more at fleetworthy.com.

The role

You'll lead a hands-on team building web applications, APIs, and data pipelines. You'll set technical direction, mentor developers, and work closely with product, while still writing code every week. We want a lead who's in the work, not above it.

How we build

  • AI-native engineering. AI coding agents are part of our daily workflow, not an experiment. We want someone who knows how to direct them well, and who knows when to distrust them.
  • Pair and mob programming. We build together, live. You'll spend real time working alongside teammates, especially in your first weeks.
  • Real problems, real scale. Millions of vehicles and drivers, and customers who depend on us to be right.
  • Remote-first, with purpose. Work from home, and come to Edmonton when it matters most: key team moments.

What you'll do

  • Lead the team and its projects, set technical direction, and mentor junior developers
  • Partner with product to turn ideas into well-scoped, technically sound stories
  • Build scalable ETL and data transformation workflows in Databricks (or similar)
  • Design, build, and maintain applications with Python, Django, and FastAPI
  • Create and integrate RESTful APIs
  • Own PostgreSQL schemas and write SQL you'd be proud to have reviewed
  • Raise the bar on quality through testing and thoughtful code review
  • Debug the hard problems across the stack
  • Explain your thinking clearly to engineers, product managers, and executives alike

What you bring

The essentials:

  • Senior full-stack experience, and you've led a team or project, or regularly mentored other engineers
  • Advanced Python
  • Daily, hands-on experience with AI coding tools (such as Claude Code, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot)
  • Hands-on data pipeline and ETL experience with Databricks or comparable tools (Snowflake, Datalakes)
  • Excellent live communication. You think out loud well, and you're comfortable on screen shares and in pairing sessions
  • Experience with Django, Flask, or FastAPI, and with building REST APIs
  • Working proficiency with React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript
  • Strong SQL and PostgreSQL skills, including schema design and query optimization
  • A testing mindset (pytest, TDD) and strong debugging instincts
  • Comfort with Git, CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps), and ticketing tools like Jira or ServiceNow
  • Ability to travel to Edmonton for on-site interview (if requested)

Bonus points:

  • Redis, GraphQL
  • Docker and Kubernetes
  • Azure or AWS
  • Geospatial data (PostGIS, H3, geocoding APIs)
  • Observability tools (Grafana, Datadog) and comfort working from traces, logs, and metrics

Why Fleetworthy

  • Health benefits
  • A people-first culture
  • Ownership and purpose in your work
  • Unlimited vacation

Ready to lead something that matters?

Apply with your resume. If you've built serious Python data systems and led engineers through them, we want to hear about it, even if your background doesn't match every line above.

Fleetworthy is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture that is respectful and welcoming of individual differences. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief (or lack thereof), sex, nationality, national or ethnic origin, civil status, age, citizenship status, sexual orientation, disability, genetic information, familial status, marital or registered civil partnership status, pregnancy or maternity status, gender identity, gender reassignment, military or veteran status, or any other protected characteristic in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.

job.title: Senior Director, Head of Quality & Responsible Person for Encaleret, International
job.description:
Mavericks Wanted 

When was the last time you achieved the impossible? If that thought feels overwhelming, you might want to pause here, but if it sparks excitement...read on 
 
In 2015, we pioneered a “moneyball for biotech” approach, pooling projects and promising early-stage research from academia together under one financial umbrella to reduce risk and unleash innovation. This model allows science and small teams of experts to lead the way. We build bridges to groundbreaking advancements in rare disease, and develop life-changing medicines for patients with unmet needs as fast as humanly possible.  
 
Together we define white space, push boundaries, and empower people to solve problems. If you're someone who defies convention, join us and work alongside some of the most respected minds in the industry. Together, we'll ask "why not?" and help reengineer the future of biopharma. At BridgeBio, we value curiosity and experimentation—including the ethical & thoughtful use of AI to improve clarity, speed, and quality of work. 

What You’ll Do

The Senior Director, Head of Quality & Responsible Person for Encaleret, International, leads the quality organization of BridgeBio Pharma Europe B.V. and reports to Senior Vice President Quality. As the Responsible Person, the role carries personal accountability under EU GDP for the entity's distribution activities: release for distribution, recalls, and products that are authentic, correctly stored and transported, and traceable. The role is independent of Commercial Operations, Manufacturing and Supply Chain, with an unrestricted right of escalation to the entity's full board. She/he leads and develops the entity's quality team, maintains the entity's quality management system, developed with the affiliate quality leads from existing BridgeBio frameworks, and leads WDA licensing, inspection readiness and subsequent MIA readiness, if needed.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the named Responsible Person on the WDA: release for distribution, recall decisions, and GDP compliance of the entity 
  • Take final disposition decision on returned, rejected, recalled or potentially falsified products (an RP decision under GDP), in consultation with BridgeBio's Global Quality Management
  • Support and coordinate returns, rejections, suspected falsified products and recall operations
  • Approve return to saleable stock
  • Ensure that customers are entitled to receive the products prior to shipment
  • Ensure the WDA registration remains current with the commercial supply chain setup
  • Ensure the accuracy of quality records and that GDP requirements are implemented and maintained in the quality management system, as required for the WDA license
  • Lead the WDA application and IGJ inspection readiness 
  • Ensure data integrity and own the entity's internal audit (self-inspection) program
  • Own the GDP quality agreement matrix: contract service providers, 3PLs, distributors and intercompany interfaces 
  • Review and write standard operating procedures in BridgeBio’s document management system in accordance with the GDP requirements
  • Ensure there is a training program for BridgeBio staff working under GDP and ensure that the relevant staff members are trained on GDP
  • Participate in GDP vendor qualification program
  • Perform quality review of assigned quality events such as deviations, change controls, supplier notifications
  • Perform distribution release for finished goods received from the contract manufacturing organization, which can include review of temperature, shipping and receiving documentation 
  • Be responsible for and be directly involved in product complaints from the EU and ROW markets
  • Provide GDP and QA related support and intelligence
  • Be available and reachable 24/7 

Other QA/Quality Person related responsibilities 

  • Build, lead and develop the entity's quality team: deputy RP, QA compliance/QMS, and QA operations/GDP; and QP, if needed
  • Implement and maintain the entity's GDP-compliant quality management system by adopting existing BridgeBio quality frameworks, adapted to the entity's license requirements
  • Work closely with the affiliate quality leads to resolve quality issues and keep the intercompany interfaces effective
  • Prepare subsequent MIA readiness (QP recruitment, import, API GMP verification, and batch-certification processes), if needed 
  • Assist in updating CMC sections of regulatory and quality documents as needed 
  • Participate in regulatory inspections  
  • Participate in internal and external project team meetings 
  • Write and review governing procedure (e.g., SOPs, WIs, etc.), where necessary  
  • Other duties as assigned 

Where You’ll Work 

This is a Netherlands-based role that will require 30% travel.

Who You Are

  • 10+ years in pharmaceutical quality, including significant GDP / distribution quality experience; prior appointment as (or eligibility to be) a Responsible Person strongly preferred 
  • Experience leading regulatory inspections with EU competent authorities (IGJ preferred) 
  • Prior experience of managing third party vendors (CMOs, CTLs, 3PLs, etc.)
  • Prior relevant knowledge and experience related to the distribution of medical products 
  • Strong understanding of supply chain concepts, supplier management, inventory management 
  • Extensive knowledge of US/EU GMPs /GDPs and associated guidance 
  • Working in a highly regulated environment 
  • Proven leadership of quality teams; experience building quality functions or systems 
  • BS/MS degree preferably in operations, science, pharmacy
  • Documented GDP training and the education and experience to be accepted as Responsible Person by the Dutch authorities (Farmatec/IGJ)

Skills

  • Understanding the EU and particularly IGJ regulations in relation to the wholesale distribution of medicines 
  • Fluent in English language; written/spoken in Dutch language, preferred 
  • Strong planning and time management skills with ability to prioritize workload 
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with keen attention to detail 
  • Basic understanding of data concepts and enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems e.g., SAP 
  • Ready to embrace company core values and diverse corporate culture  

Rewarding Those Who Make the Mission Possible

  • We have high expectations for our team members
  • We make sure those working hard for patients are rewarded and cared for in return
  • Market leading compensationHybrid work model - we value your flexibility in how you work, but encourage time in the office to strengthen our culture, collaboration, and sense of community
  • We provide career development through regular feedback, continuous education and professional development programs
  • We celebrate strong performance with financial rewards, peer-to-peer recognition, and growth opportunities

As a global company, our comprehensive benefits may vary based on location.  We have high expectations for our team members. We make sure those working hard for patients are rewarded and cared for in return.

For BridgeBio Full-Time U.S Based Roles:

Financial & Rewards  

  • Market-leading compensation   
  • 401(k) with employer match   
  • Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP)  
  • Pre-tax commuter benefits (transit and parking)  
  • Referral bonus for hired candidates  
  • Subsidized lunch and parking on in-office days  

Health & Well-Being  

  • 100% employer-paid medical, dental, and vision premiums for you and your dependents  
  • Health Savings Account (HSA) with annual employer contributions, plus Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)  
  • Fertility & family-forming benefits  
  •  Expanded mental health support (therapy and coaching resources)  
  • Hybrid work model with flexibility  
  • Flexible, “take-what-you-need” paid time off and company-paid holidays  
  • Comprehensive paid medical and parental leave to care for yourself and your family  

Skill Development & Career Paths: 

  • People are part of our growth and success story - from discovery to active drug trials and FDA pipelines, there are endless opportunities for skill development and internal mobility 
  • We provide career pathing through regular feedback, continuous education and professional development programs via LinkedIn Learning, LifeLabs, & BetterUp Coaching 
  • We celebrate strong performance with financial rewards, peer-to-peer recognition, and growth opportunities 

By applying, you acknowledge that BridgeBio will process your personal information as described in our Global Candidate Privacy Notice.

job.title: Senior Engineering Manager, Exposure Management
job.description:
Join the team turning internet intelligence into real-world security outcomes. Built on the world’s most comprehensive and accurate map of the Internet, the Censys Platform delivers real-time visibility and actionable intelligence needed to accelerate triage, investigate threats, hunt adversaries, and manage Internet exposure. We're trusted by half of the Fortune 500 and government agencies all around the world, and looking for people as passionate about the problems we're solving as we are. 

At Censys, we’re on a mission to provide best in class internet visibility and intelligence to the global security community. Our platform helps security teams uncover hidden threats, gain actionable insights, and build proactive defense strategies. Trusted by organizations worldwide, Censys cuts through the noise to surface the most critical risks, enabling teams to respond faster, and stay ahead of attackers. We’re constantly pushing the boundaries of what’s possible to help our customers see and secure the internet more clearly than ever before.

Role Summary

We’re looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead the Internet Exposure and Attack Surface Management (ASM) team, responsible for building and scaling the systems that help customers continuously discover, attribute, and monitor their internet-facing assets and exposures.

The team builds highly scalable distributed systems that map internet entities - including IP addresses, domains, and services - to organizations, providing accurate, near-real-time visibility into their attack surface. Its work directly impacts the accuracy, freshness, scalability, and reliability of Censys ASM, a key growth product. The team will also drive practical AI/ML capabilities to improve asset attribution, exposure analysis, and customer workflows.

This hands-on technical leader will own the team's people leadership, technical strategy, roadmap, delivery, and operational excellence. You will partner with Product, Research, and Engineering teams to drive architecture and technical decisions, deliver high-impact capabilities, and build a team of engineers who take ownership, grow professionally, and execute with autonomy.

The Job Is a Good Fit If You

  • Enjoy building high-performing teams through coaching, feedback, and delegation.
  • Can set clear direction without needing to make every decision yourself.
  • Balance people leadership, technical strategy, and delivery.
  • Thrive on solving complex distributed systems and Internet-scale challenges.
  • Empower engineers to own decisions and deliver results.
  • Are excited about AI/ML applications in cybersecurity and exposure management.

What You’ll Do

  • Define the Internet Exposure roadmap with Product, UX and other engineering stakeholders.
  • Lead major initiatives from discovery through production delivery, clearly communicating timelines, tradeoffs, and risks.
  • Set clear expectations for ownership, quality, collaboration, delivery, and operational responsibility.
  • Lead, coach, and develop engineering team.
  • Build a healthy, accountable team; identify staffing needs; and maintain a high bar for hiring, onboarding, and performance management.
  • Provide timely feedback, create meaningful growth plans, and delegate ownership of systems, projects, and decisions.
  • Drive improvements in accuracy, freshness, reliability, and AI-powered capabilities.

What You’ll Bring

  • 5+ years of engineering management and 10+ years of software engineering experience.
  • Strong understanding of distributed systems, cloud architectures, and Internet protocols.
  • Proven experience building and operating scalable SaaS platforms.
  • Track record of developing engineers and delivering complex technical initiatives.
  • Demonstrated success developing engineers through coaching, feedback, and delegation, including engineers with different specialties.
  • Strong project-management and communication skills, with the ability to turn broad objectives into clear priorities, milestones, and outcomes.
  • Strong communication, technical judgment, and cross-functional leadership skills.

What Sets You Apart

  • Experience building Attack Surface Management (ASM), asset discovery, or Internet intelligence platforms.
  • Background in cybersecurity, threat intelligence, or exposure management, with an understanding of customer security workflows.
  • Knowledge of DNS, internet protocols, and asset attribution.
  • Delivering product with AI-powered features, including potentially AI Agent experiences.

Identity Verification 

As part of our hiring process, all candidates who receive an offer of employment will be asked to complete an identity verification through CLEAR.

California Privacy Rights Notice

Pursuant to the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), we are providing you with notice that we collect personal information from job applicants for business purposes, including evaluating your candidacy for employment, conducting interviews, and, if applicable, completing the hiring process. The categories of information we may collect include identifiers (such as name and contact information), professional or employment-related information (such as work history, education, and references), and other information you provide in your application. We do not sell or share your personal information. For more information on how we use and protect your personal information, and your rights under the CCPA, please refer to our Privacy Policy.

job.title: Customer Engineering Manager
job.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: Mexico City, Mexico

What you’ll do as a Solutions Engineer Manager

As a SE Manager for Cloudflare for the LATAM Markets  you will be responsible for managing a cross functional, full sales life cycle and technical activities for Cloudflare customers. The role requires someone with strong leadership, interpersonal, and business acumen to work with Sales to grow our account base. The SE Manager will manage a team of SEs that are geographically distributed within the US and Mexico, covering all of the countries that make up LATAM for Cloudflare.  The SE team partners with the Enterprise, Mid-Market, and Public Sector LATAM Sales teams that are also geographically distributed in the US and Mexico, as well as Customer Success and is responsible for providing the value of Cloudflare products to customers and prospects

Examples of desirable skills, knowledge, experience and goals

Our Solutions Engineers come from a wide range of backgrounds: financial consulting, engineering, software development, product management, customer support & project delivery. We're serious about building a diverse team. When hiring we look for diversity of experience combined with genuine curiosity for our technology.

Ultimately, you are passionate about technology and people, and have the ability to explain complex technical concepts in easy-to-understand terms, and you like coaching and teaching. You are naturally curious, and an avid builder who is not afraid to get your hands dirty. On the Solutions Engineering team, you will find a collaborative environment where everyone brings different strengths and jumps in to help each other and you will be an integral part of driving that culture.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of relevant experience with a Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Management Information Systems or another related field or its equivalent.
  • 3+ years of experience with internet technologies / protocols and / or cloud technologies
  • Minimum 1 year of team lead/team management experience
  • Experience managing opportunity sales cycles and identifying technical proof activities 
  • Demonstrated operations and organization skills implementation and driving best practices with cross functional organizations.
  • Strong organizational and analytical skills.
  • Outstanding interpersonal skills with a proven track record of successfully building collaboration around important initiatives.
  • Successful track record of working and influencing matrixed organizations.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to effectively present technical and business related subjects to all audiences.
  • Demonstrated problem solving skills, drive for results, interpersonal savvy, and customer focus.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

job.title: Sr Data Platform Engineer
job.location: France, Remote; Spain, Remote; United Kingdom, Remote
job.description:
Dataiku is the Platform for AI Success, the enterprise orchestration layer for building, deploying, and governing AI. In a single environment, teams design and operate analytics, machine learning, and AI agents with the transparency, collaboration, and control enterprises require. Sitting above data platforms, cloud infrastructure, and AI services, Dataiku connects the full enterprise AI stack - empowering organizations to run AI across multi-vendor environments with centralized governance.

The world’s leading companies rely on Dataiku to operationalize AI and run it as a true business performance engine delivering measurable value. For more, visit the Dataiku blog, LinkedIn, X, and YouTube.

Dataiku is looking for a Sr. Data Platform Engineer to join our Enterprise Data and Analytics (EDA) team. As a member of the EDA Team, you will play a central role in delivering data & GenAI solutions to fuel analytics and data-driven insights to various stakeholders and teams within the company. You will be a key technical member contributing to the Data Platform that fuels centralized analytics, embedded analytics teams, and self-service users across the organization.

At this level of seniority, non-technical skills, learning & teaching, and business acumen are critical, along with the expectation of technical excellence, as you will help drive technical decision-making and solutioning of key technical challenges both within the team and across the Analytics Community. The technical day-to-day will primarily be within the Data Platform built using Snowflake, Dataiku & GitHub. The primary development will focus on GenAI Platform Capabilities, Python & SQL (among other languages), DataOps processes built within GitHub Actions & Dataiku, and data platform processes built within Snowflake & Dataiku. Strong software development lifecycle knowledge and DataOps skills are a must! The ideal candidate is naturally curious, has excellent verbal and written communication skills, has a sharp analytical mind, a positive attitude towards work and thrives when collaborating towards a shared goal. This is an internal and non-client facing role.

How you’ll make an impact

  • Be an expert-level engineer across Dataiku (Platform Automation, GenAI Capabilities, Plugin Development, maintenance & troubleshooting) and Snowflake (data engineering, security/governance), including building & maintaining GenAI Platform solutions with a security/governance focus
  • Build & maintain Python & SQL-based platform automation and DataOps processes for SDLC delivery
  • Build & maintain data quality, observability, monitoring, alerting, access management, and platform transparency systems
  • Assist Data Engineering with Python & SQL data replication & pipelines on large, complex datasets
  • Design data models (short- and long-term) to support data warehouse scalability
  • Collaborate with GenAI Engineering & Analytics Engineering to build scalable Data Platform solutions
  • Perform root cause analysis on complex errors to ensure pipeline availability
  • Help drive technical & architectural decisions on the data platform (architecture, engineering processes, data quality, security/governance frameworks, DataOps, consumption models)
  • Test new Dataiku and partner-tool features, provide feedback, and assess value for internal integration
  • Work closely with stakeholders (Infra, embedded analytics, Product, Engineering) on implementation & requirements gathering, while promoting the Data Platform internally through mentoring, innovation initiatives, and contributions to EDA team standards and best practices

Some expected outcomes for this role 

  • A more secure, well-governed GenAI layer on top of the Data Platform, with clear standards for engineering delivery
  • Measurable improvements in data quality, observability, and platform reliability (fewer/faster-resolved incidents via RCA)
  • Stronger, more automated DataOps/SDLC processes reducing manual overhead across the team
  • Scalable data models that support the platform’s growth across Analytics, GenAI Engineering, and self-service users
  • Closer technical alignment between Data Platforms, GenAI Engineering, and Analytics Engineering on shared solutions

What you’ll need to be successful 

  • Strong understanding of GenAI development, security & governance concepts — a must
  • 5+ years of relevant experience in Data Engineering / Data Platform Engineering / Data Architecture
  • Expert-level SQL & Python; Snowflake experience required
  • Prior experience with DevOps technologies (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins)
  • Strong understanding of data architecture & data modeling concepts
  • Prior experience building and maintaining replication & data pipelines in a cloud data warehouse or data lake environment
  • Experience working with complex stakeholders: dissecting vague asks and defining tangible requirements
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities in a high-trust remote environment, wearing multiple hats as needed
  • Excellent analytical, written, and verbal communication skills, with a passion for continuous learning and teaching, and the ability to produce clear, precise documentation

What will make you stand out

  • Dataiku DSS experience
  • Demonstrated track record of mentoring or upskilling other engineers on new technologies or platform practices
  • Experience delivering GenAI architecture guidance directly to business/senior stakeholders

#LI-Remote

job.title: Customer Success Manager, Go-To-Market
job.description:
The role

Daybreak partners with school districts to connect students to virtual therapy. As the West CSM, you own a portfolio of 50+ school district accounts and a referral target for that book. Your job is to help school district leaders and staff connect students to mental health care through referrals. You’ll also support districts in spreading the word with parents. You will launch new districts, train counselors and social workers, monitor account health, and step in early when a district slows down or needs support. You will work closely with Sales, Account Managers, Marketing, and Care Support.

What you'll do

  • Launch districts on time. Run kickoff and staff training to set goals with district leaders and help staff understand the value of teletherapy, supporting them in referring students to care within 45 days of launch.
  • Drive early adoption and support ongoing utilization. Get enough distinct staff referring by day 90 to hit the floor for the district's size. Then support the account to increase utilization year over year.
  • Support account health through ongoing touch points. Prioritize support and intervention for accounts based on account health and value. Support customers through asynchronous and synchronous plays, documenting interventions and monitoring outcomes. Spend your calls with the staff who refer, not only the admin.
  • Act on health flags. Use data to monitor customer health and intervene proactively to provide personalized support before accounts are at risk.
  • Support renewals and identify upsell opportunities. Conduct renewal and account reviews with district leaders to identify opportunities to expand and minimize churn.
  • Track account activity and outcomes. Document customer interactions, trainings, and interventions in Salesforce and internal tools so the team can see what’s working, learn from results, and grow accounts.
  • Use AI thoughtfully. Use AI to work more efficiently, from creating training materials to reviewing account trends. Apply your own judgment to prioritize interventions, adapt to each district’s context, and recognize when a personal conversation or hands-on support will make the biggest difference.

What success looks like

  • Districts launch on time. New districts are supported through launch to start connecting students to care within the first 45 days.
  • Adoption and utilization grow. More staff refer students, and districts continue to use and find value in the program.
  • Risks are addressed early. You spot changes in account health, prioritize the right interventions, and put plans in place before accounts lapse.
  • Renewal and growth opportunities are identified. Regular reviews with district leaders help surface opportunities to expand and reduce churn.
  • Account activity informs action. Your documentation helps the team see what’s working, learn from outcomes, and grow accounts.
  • AI supports effective, personal service. You use AI to work efficiently while applying your own judgment and providing human support where it matters most.

Required

  • Held a Customer Success Manager role at a healthcare or education, with ownership of accounts after the sale (2+ years)
  • Managed a large portfolio at one time (50+ accounts)
  • Based in the Pacific time zone and able to work Pacific hours
  • Led live trainings for adult learners
  • Comfortable with data: pacing, funnel, and simple models
  • Uses AI tools weekly and applies judgment to the output
  • Works independently in a remote role and documents in shared tools

Nice to have

  • Experience inside a K-12 district or campus, or a background in EdTech
  • Mental health or SEL product experience
  • Salesforce or similar CRM
  • Familiarity with district funding sources such as state programs and grants

Our Commitment to Diversity

Daybreak Health is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We believe that diverse perspectives strengthen our mission to serve students from all backgrounds. We actively encourage applications from people of all races, ethnicities, religions, gender identities, sexual orientations, ages, abilities, and veteran status.

Pay Range

$75,000—$90,000 USD

job.title: ServiceNow Solution Architect - AI
job.description:
Why Us

NewRocket is the AI-first Elite ServiceNow Partner that activates real value on the Now Platform. As a trusted advisor to enterprise leaders, we combine industry expertise, human-centered design, and enterprise-grade AI to help organizations navigate change and scale with confidence.With two decades of experience guiding clients to realize the full potential of the ServiceNow AI Platform, we are one of the largest pure-play ServiceNow partners, uniquely focused on enabling enterprises to adopt AI they trust—AI that delivers lasting business value.

We #GoBeyondWorkflows to create new kinds of experiences for our customers.

Come join our Crew!

The Role

NewRocket is a global team made up of ServiceNow professionals who help our customers run and grow their ServiceNow environments. We are hiring a ServiceNow Solution Architect -AI with strong ServiceNow development & implementation experience. The Solution Architect is responsible for leading, coaching and mentoring a team of Senior Software Engineers/Software Engineers who provide the development of project professional services for customers. The Architect will implement and develop customizations based on functional and technical requirements using leading practices and internal code standards on large-scale more complex professional services projects.

 We will provide support and guidance to get you up to speed on some of the most amazing projects! We provide official ServiceNow training so you can achieve multiple certifications. We will set expectations for what success looks like. Then we will allow you use your skills and experience to come up with innovative solutions to achieve customer goals.

We are #GoingBeyond Come join our crew!

What You Will Be Doing

  • As a ServiceNow Solution Architect AI , you will interface with end-users, IT teams and key stakeholders to gather systems requirements.
  • Design, develop, and deploy AI-driven applications and workflows on the ServiceNow platform.
  • Integrate machine learning, natural language processing (NLP), and predictive analytics solutions into any of the ServiceNow modules (ITSM, ITOM, CSM, HRSD).

  • Remediate any production incidents that arise related to this scope

What You Bring Along

  • 8+ years’ experience supporting the implementation, administration, configuration, and/or development of ServiceNow in 2 or more capabilities (i.e. ITSM,ITOM etc.)
  • Strong experience with ServiceNow AI and automation capabilities, including Virtual Agent, Predictive Intelligence, Performance Analytics, and Now Assist, leveraging AI-driven insights to improve service delivery and operational efficiency.
  • Hands-on experience implementing and optimizing Now Assist features such as AI-powered case summarization, resolution recommendations, and conversational workflows.
  • Experience with integration between ServiceNow and other systems/platforms using both mid servers and cloud to cloud 
  • Experience working with Web Services Integration (SOAP, REST) and any bi-directional, automated integration between two systems.
  • Data Extraction Technologies (e.g. JDBC, ODBC) or ETL integrations
  • Proven experience with implementing ServiceNow CMDB, Discovery, Software Asset Management, ITSM, Service Catalog, and Workflows to meet business requirements
  • Experience in aspects of ServiceNow scripting including Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Builder, Scripted REST APIs, and Scripting.
  • Thrive in strategic planning, resource allocation, production methods, and coordination of people and resources.
  • Adapts quickly in a fast-paced environment

Education: 

  •  Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, AI/ML, or related field.

Certifications & Knowledge 

The candidate must be willing and able to continue their education within the ServiceNow platform and beyond. It is expected that the candidate will be able to complete ServiceNow competency Certifications as well as Module Accreditations. 

Preferred Certifications:

  • ITIL Foundation

We Take Care of Our People
