job.title: Senior Statistical Programming Contractor
job.description:
Iovance Biotherapeutics aims to be the global leader in innovating, developing and delivering tumor infiltrating lymphocyte (TIL) therapy for people with cancer. We are pioneering a transformational approach to treating cancer by harnessing the ability of the human immune system to recognize and attack diverse cancer cells in each patient. The Iovance TIL platform has demonstrated promising clinical data across multiple solid tumors. We are committed to continuous innovation in cell therapy, including gene-edited cell therapy, which may be a promising option for patients with cancer.

Overview

Iovance is seeking a Statistical Programming Contractor to support clinical development programs by developing, validating, and maintaining statistical programming deliverables for clinical studies and regulatory submissions. This role will work closely with statisticians, data management, and other cross-functional teams to ensure high-quality and timely delivery of datasets, tables, listings, and figures in a GxP-compliant environment. The ideal candidate combines strong programming expertise with a solid foundation in statistics or quantitative sciences and thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced biotech setting.


Essential Functions and Responsibilities

  • Develop, validate, and maintain SAS and/or R programs for the creation of SDTM, ADaM datasets, and TLFs in accordance with CDISC standards.
  • Support statistical analyses for periodic safety reports, publications, conference presentations, IDMC/DSMB reviews, clinical study reports (CSRs), regulatory submissions, health authority requests and other ad hoc analyses and reporting needs.
  • Ensure all programming activities comply with FDA 21 CFR Part 11, GxP, and internal SOPs.
  • Collaborate with biostatisticians, data managers, and clinical teams to define analysis specifications and resolve data issues.
  • Perform quality control and detailed review of statistical programs and outputs.
  • Develop and maintain reusable macros, templates, and automation tools to improve programming efficiency.
  • Contribute to the evaluation and implementation of emerging technologies and modern programming approaches, including AI-based tools and agents, to enhance statistical programming workflows.
  • Participate in development and review programming data specifications.
  • Maintain clear, thorough documentation to support audit readiness and regulatory inspection.
  • Must adhere to Iovance Biotherapeutics’ core values, policies, procedures, and business ethics.
  • Perform miscellaneous duties as assigned.

Required Education, Skills, and Knowledge

  • Master’s degree in mathematics, statistics, computer science, biostatistics, data science or a related quantitative field with 5+ years of relevant industry experience; or bachelor’s degree in mathematics, statistics, computer science, biostatistics, data science or a related quantitative field with 8+ years of relevant industry experience
  • Strong proficiency in SAS and/or R for clinical trial data analysis and reporting.
  • Working knowledge of CDISC standards (SDTM, ADaM, Define-XML) and regulatory submission requirements.
  • Experience producing TLFs and SDTM/analysis datasets in a pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or CRO setting.
  • Experience with oncology clinical trials or cell/gene therapy programs.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Familiarity with regulatory guidelines (FDA, ICH) and GxP-compliant programming practices.
  • Excellent attention to detail, problem-solving skills, and the ability to manage multiple priorities independently in a remote environment.

Preferred Education, Skills, and Knowledge

  • Master’s degree in mathematics, statistics, or computer science is strongly preferred.
  • Hands-on experience developing AI agents or applying AI/ML-based automation tools to streamline data analysis, programming workflows, or reporting processes is a significant plus.
  • Experience supporting regulatory submissions (NDA, BLA, MAA, or equivalent)
  • Familiarity with electronic submission standards (eCTD) and health authority interactions.

Physical Demands and Activities Required

The physical demands described here represent those an employee may encounter while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be provided to enable individuals to perform these functions.

  • Ability to remain in a stationary position for extended periods
  • Ability to move about within an office or remote workspace and exert up to 10 pounds of force occasionally
  • Visual acuity sufficient for preparing and analyzing data, viewing computer screens, and extensive reading
  • Repetitive motion involving wrists, hands, and/or fingers

job.title: Principal Engineer, Balance of Plant Auxiliary Systems
job.location: Alameda, CA; Albuquerque, New Mexico; Remote
job.description:
Company Overview

Kairos Power is a new nuclear energy technology and engineering company whose mission is to enable the world’s transition to clean energy, with the ultimate goal to dramatically improve people’s quality of life while protecting the environment. This goal will be accomplished through the commercialization of the fluoride-salt-cooled, high-temperature reactor (FHR) that can be deployed with robust safety, affordable costs, and flexible operation to accommodate the expansion of variable renewables.

Job Summary

Kairos Power is seeking an experienced Principal Engineer to lead the technical deployment of KP-FHR balance of plant (BOP) auxiliary systems engineering, including service water, treated water, chilled water, component cooling water, and compressed air systems.  Reporting to the Balance of Plant (Power Generation System and Turbine Island) Leader, you will develop technical design solutions to enable the rapid deployment and integration of KP-FHR Balance of Plant Structures, Systems and Components (SSCs). This role requires a senior individual contributor with extensive experience in thermal and balance of plant technologies to ensure efficient, safe, and reliable operation of the plant's balance of plant auxiliary systems.

Responsibilities

  • Drive the design and deployment of the balance of plant auxiliary systems, focusing on service water, treated water, chilled water, component cooling water, and compressed air systems including pumps, valves, and related auxiliary systems that meet Kairos Power’s FHR deployment objectives.
  • Manage and coordinate external partners, suppliers, regulators and vendors related to BOP auxiliary systems.
  • Support supplier technical oversight, including review of supplier deliverables, technical deviations, test plans, and component qualification evidence while performing independent verification calculations as necessary.
  • Develop and approve system documentation deliverables as required by the project.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate the balance of plant auxiliary systems with overall plant design and operations.
  • Lead or support formal design reviews, interface reviews, hazard reviews, and technical readiness reviews for balance of plant components and subsystems.
  • Apply engineering principles and engineering codes & standards, such as ASME and ANSI, to the design, analysis, and evaluation of systems.
  • Lead design trade studies, performance analyses and optimization of balance of plant auxiliary systems to meet commercial and regulatory needs.
  • Oversee the preparation of technical specifications, design documents, and system drawings for all balance of plant auxiliary systems components.
  • Perform feasibility studies and risk assessments related to commercial balance of plant auxiliary systems technologies and subsystems.
  • Present findings and recommendations to senior management and stakeholders, ensuring clear communication of technical concepts and strategies.
  • Support commissioning, testing, and troubleshooting of the balance of plant auxiliary systems during the plant's startup phase.
  • Stay abreast of industry advancements, best practices, and emerging balance of plant technologies.
  • Develop and maintain system requirements, interface control documents, design bases, and verification/validation plans for balance of plant components.
  • Perform work within established scope, budgetary and schedule requirements.
  • Resolve complex technical issues and system/interface conflicts affecting BOP auxiliary system design, procurement, installation, testing, or commissioning.
  • Evaluate proposed design changes and technical deviations for impact on system requirements, interfaces, design basis, safety, quality, and configuration control.
  • Establish and maintain technical acceptance criteria for BOP auxiliary system components and subsystems, including criteria used for procurement, testing, and verification.
  • Provide technical disposition and recommendations for nonconforming conditions, test results, or equipment performance issues within assigned BOP systems.
  • Ensure design decisions, analyses, and technical resolutions are documented and traceable to applicable requirements, design inputs, and verification evidence.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

job.title: Assoc Director/Director, Enterprise Technology & AI Strategy
job.description:
Are you ready to join a team committed to making a meaningful impact on cancer treatment through the discovery and development of precision medicines? At Kura Oncology, you have an opportunity to be a part of something bigger, with a lasting impact that you can be proud of.

At Kura Oncology, we are working to change the paradigm and improve the science of cancer treatment. As an organization, we strive to cultivate a diverse and talented professional culture driven to develop precision medicine therapeutics.

As we continue to build a leading biotech organization with a strong culture, a patient-focused mindset and a team focused on relentless execution, we are looking for innovative, passionate professionals to join us and make our vision a reality.

To succeed at Kura, you will need to have a demonstrated ability for excellence in drug discovery and development and a roll-up your sleeves attitude. The ideal candidate will possess a values-driven work style where integrity and grit drive all behaviors, decisions, and actions.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

The Associate Director/Director, Enterprise Technology & AI Strategy leads the development and execution of the organization’s enterprise technology and artificial intelligence strategy in a growing precision medicine environment. This role shapes an integrated portfolio of AI, automation, enterprise applications, and digital capabilities aligned with business priorities, scientific objectives, and operational needs. Partnering with business leaders, IT, Quality Assurance, Information Security, Legal, Privacy, and Data stakeholders, the Director guides investment priorities, platform modernization, responsible AI adoption, and measurable value realization. The position balances innovation with architectural alignment, data readiness, user experience, scalability, quality expectations, and applicable regulatory requirements.

The successful candidate brings strategic leadership and delivery experience across enterprise technology and AI in regulated life sciences environments. This individual translates executive priorities and scientific and operational needs into actionable roadmaps, compelling business cases, and sustainable technology capabilities. The Director leads cross-functional discovery and portfolio governance, guides initiatives from assessment through deployment and optimization, and establishes clear accountability for adoption and business outcomes. The role requires sound judgment, effective vendor and stakeholder leadership, and the ability to communicate investment recommendations, risks, tradeoffs, and realized value to executive audiences.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

Enterprise Technology & AI Strategy, Portfolio, and Value Realization

  • Develop and maintain an integrated enterprise technology and AI strategy and roadmap aligned with business priorities, scientific objectives, operational needs, data capabilities, enterprise architecture, and responsible AI expectations.
  • Lead cross-functional opportunity discovery to identify high-value applications of AI, automation, analytics, and enterprise technologies, defining intended users, workflow improvements, data requirements, measurable outcomes, and expected business value.
  • Develop business cases, prioritization frameworks, investment recommendations, and executive decision materials across Research, Development, Clinical, Technical Operations, Corporate, and enabling functions.
  • Establish and manage an integrated portfolio that provides visibility into strategic alignment, initiative maturity, expected value, cost, risk, data readiness, dependencies, accountable ownership, and adoption.
  • Lead portfolio planning and facilitate executive governance discussions to recommend investment priorities, sequencing, resource allocation, and decisions to scale, redirect, or discontinue initiatives.
  • Establish value realization practices with business sponsors, including baseline measures, benefit ownership, adoption targets, and ongoing assessment of realized outcomes.
  • Anticipate organizational, technical, data, security, quality, regulatory, and change management barriers; drive mitigation planning and escalate decisions to accountable leaders.

AI Solution Discovery, Responsible Governance, and Adoption

  • Lead the enterprise AI initiative lifecycle from opportunity assessment and feasibility through proofs of concept, pilots, scaled deployment, adoption, and continuous improvement.
  • Partner with business, system, data, and technical owners to define intended use, target experiences, data inputs, model and agent behavior, human oversight, acceptance criteria, and success measures.
  • Establish and operationalize a practical, risk-based AI governance framework in partnership with Architecture, Information Security, Privacy, Legal, Quality Assurance, Data, and other accountable functions.
  • Oversee assessments of AI platforms, models, agents, integrations, automations, and vendor capabilities for business fit, technical feasibility, responsible use, operational readiness, and lifecycle support.
  • Establish proportionate governance and documentation standards covering use case assessments, evaluation results, risk and control decisions, data considerations, approvals, accountable ownership, and human oversight.
  • Direct proofs of concept and pilots that evaluate user value, output quality, workflow fit, data suitability, operational constraints, and known limitations; recommend whether to scale, modify, or discontinue solutions.
  • Lead adoption planning with business sponsors, including communications, role-based learning, workflow changes, user feedback, and transition to operational ownership.
  • Monitor utilization, adoption, user experience, realized benefits, quality indicators, and residual risks; use findings to guide portfolio decisions and solution improvements.

Regulated Technology, Quality, and Risk Alignment

  • Embed quality, compliance, data integrity, and risk considerations into enterprise technology and AI planning, delivery, and lifecycle management.
  • Partner with Quality Assurance and accountable system owners to determine whether proposed capabilities affect GxP computerized systems, regulated processes, or electronic records, and identify applicable validation and lifecycle requirements.
  • Ensure initiative plans incorporate applicable intended use definitions, requirements, risk assessments, testing, traceability, approval evidence, records retention, and change controls in accordance with established quality procedures.
  • Align solution plans with applicable regulatory requirements, including FDA 21 CFR Part 11 and EU Annex 11, relevant guidance such as GAMP 5, and internal policies, in partnership with Quality Assurance and designated subject matter experts.
  • Facilitate agreement on regulated use, validation strategy, acceptance criteria, solution limitations, human oversight, approval gates, and post-deployment monitoring, with approval authority retained by accountable functions.
  • Ensure implementations, integrations, model or agent changes, and material configuration updates undergo appropriate AI risk and validation impact assessments, with documented disposition and ownership.
  • Support audit and inspection readiness through organized governance and quality evidence, and coordinate contributions to periodic reviews, data integrity assessments, and system retirement activities where relevant.

Enterprise Platforms, Technology Enablement, and Continuous Improvement

  • Define the strategic direction and evolution of enterprise applications, collaboration platforms, knowledge management capabilities, and automation technologies that enable business outcomes and AI adoption.
  • Guide platform modernization, upgrades, integrations, configuration changes, and workflow improvements, balancing business value, architectural fit, security, compliance, scalability, supportability, and total cost of ownership.
  • Evaluate technology and vendor options, inform sourcing and investment decisions, and oversee partner commitments, delivery outcomes, and alignment with enterprise priorities.
  • Maintain visibility into delivery milestones, cross-platform dependencies, capability gaps, resource constraints, vendor performance, risks, and decisions requiring leadership action.
  • Establish clear operational ownership, support expectations, communications, and readiness criteria for the transition of new capabilities into ongoing service.
  • Translate lessons from AI initiatives and platform enhancements into reusable solution patterns, stronger governance, improved user experiences, and measurable operational improvements.

JOB SPECIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Science, Life Sciences, Business, or a related field
  • 5+ years of progressive experience in AI strategy, digital transformation, emerging technology, enterprise systems, data or analytics, technology consulting, or related Information Technology roles
  • Demonstrated experience shaping AI, automation, analytics, or emerging technology strategies from opportunity discovery through pilots, adoption, measurement, and continuous improvement
  • Experience supporting regulated technology in the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, medical device, or life sciences industry, including familiarity with GxP computerized systems and risk-based validation expectations
  • Working knowledge of responsible AI practices, data governance, FDA 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, GAMP 5, data integrity principles, and Good Documentation Practices
  • Experience building business cases, roadmaps, governance approaches, and executive recommendations for AI, automation, analytics, or emerging technology initiatives
  • Experience with AI platforms, enterprise applications, cloud platforms, collaboration tools, integrations, workflow automation, and data-enabled system enhancement initiatives
  • Experience using AI, portfolio, analytics, ticketing, quality management, document management, collaboration, or workflow platforms
  • Strong strategic thinking, analytical, problem solving, facilitation, business case development, and documentation skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate AI, technical, business, quality, and regulatory considerations for executive, operational, and technical audiences
  • High level of discretion, sound judgment, curiosity, attention to detail, and ability to influence across multiple priorities in a fast paced environment
  • Professional certifications or continuing education in AI, data governance, product management, quality, validation, PMP, PMI ACP, Scrum, or CISA are preferred
  • Makes decisions for assigned programs or functional areas, balancing priorities and resolving routine challenges; escalates high-impact or cross-functional decisions as needed.
  • Facilitates cross-functional coordination for assigned programs or initiatives, ensuring alignment and timely execution of deliverables.

The base range for this role at the Associate Director level is $179,000 - $219,000 and Director level is $185,000 - $233,000. Individual pay may vary based on additional factors, including, and without limitation, job-related skills, experience, work location, and relevant education or training. Kura's compensation package also includes generous benefits, equity, and participation in an annual target bonus.

#LI-RM1

Kura’s Values that are used for candidate selection and performance assessments:

  • We work as one for patients
  • We are goal-focused and deliver with excellence
  • We are science-driven courageous innovators
  • We strive to bring out the best in each other and ourselves

The Kura Package

  • Career advancement/ development opportunities
  • Competitive comp package
  • Bonus
  • 401K + Employer contributions
  • Generous stock options
  • ESPP Plan
  • 20 days of PTO to start
  • 18 Holidays  (Including Summer & Winter Break)
  • Generous Benefits Package with a variety of plans available with a substantial employer match
  • Paid Paternity/Maternity Leave
  • In-Office Catered lunches
  • Home Office Setup
  • Lifestyle Spending Stipend
  • Commuter Stipend (Boston Office)
  • Regular employee social activities, including happy hours, monthly birthday celebrations, Kura Koffee Talks, and much more!

Kura Oncology is a commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company committed to discovering and developing innovative precision medicines to help patients with cancer lead better, longer lives.

Through our deep understanding of cancer biology and decades of experience in precision oncology, we are studying the underlying causes of treatment resistance. This enables us to design smart combination regimens with other cancer therapies to target tumors from multiple directions, with the goal of improving long-term clinical benefit.

Kura developed and is commercializing KOMZIFTI® (ziftomenib), the FDA-approved once-daily, oral menin inhibitor for the treatment of adults with relapsed or refractory NPM1-mutated acute myeloid leukemia, and continues to pioneer advancements in menin inhibition and farnesyl transferase inhibition. For additional information, please visit Kura’s website at www.kuraoncology.com and follow us on X and LinkedIn.

Kura Oncology is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

job.title: Senior Fullstack Engineer, Enterprise Applications Development
job.description:
We have been alerted to the existence of a fraudster impersonating MANSCAPED as a hiring manager or HR representative. This impersonator is utilizing an email address with the domain manscapedjobs.com or manscapedcareers.com and is making fraudulent offers for our open jobs. Contact from MANSCAPED will only ever come from someone with a manscaped.com email address.

This is a scam targeting a number of companies, us included. If you receive any of these types of messages, we recommend that you don’t respond with any information and that you block and report those users.

  • The MANSCAPED Team   


Who We Are - MANSCAPED® is a leading men’s grooming and lifestyle consumer brand on a mission to introduce and elevate a whole new self-care routine for men. What began as the category creator of below-the-waist grooming has quickly evolved into a global omnichannel powerhouse available around the world on manscaped.com, Amazon, and in major retailers including Target®, Walmart, and Best Buy. As a company, we’re more than just ball jokes (though, rest assured, there’s plenty of those). We proudly uphold seven core values – accountability, authenticity, collaboration, fun, humility, inclusivity, and innovation – which define our brand identity and drive our success. As a people-centric employer brand, we are deeply committed to fostering the growth, happiness, and holistic well-being of each individual on our team. 

Who We’re Looking For - Reporting to the Sr. Manager, Enterprise Applications Development, MANSCAPED® is seeking a Sr. Fullstack Engineer, Enterprise Applications Development to drive the execution of MANSCAPED®’s Enterprise Applications Roadmap by enhancing and customizing our Enterprise platform ecosystem, streamlining subscription services, and optimizing API integrations. This role will be instrumental in leading, implementing, and managing technical integrations across our business, particularly with third-party vendors like 3PLs, Amazon, SPS, eBay, NetSuite, etc., as well as backend systems leveraging Azure, MongoDB. Additionally, this role will identify opportunities for improvement, refine technical processes, and cultivate a high-performance environment that fosters innovation and continuous improvement.  

The MANSCAPED® Way - At MANSCAPED®, what we do matters – but how we do it matters more. We take ownership of our work, showing up with accountability and a commitment to quality at every level. We work as one team, guided by a belief to unite, never divide, and to lead with empathy in how we support and challenge one another. The best ideas win, and they come from keeping our egos in check and our standards high. We stay humble, open to learning, and willing to grow. We bring fun to the journey, because great work shouldn’t come at the expense of enjoying what you do. We stay nimble and innovative, always looking for smarter and better ways to get things done. Ball work is honest work, and that mindset shows up in everything we do, including our proud partnership with the Testicular Cancer Society and our commitment to raising awareness of the ball-busting disease.

Responsibilities:  

  • Build and maintain seamless integrations between NetSuite, Shopify and third-party services to ensure reliable data exchange and functionality 
  • Write clean, scalable, and maintainable code that aligns with business goals and technical standards. 
  • Optimize and enhance a custom applications engine using ADF and NetSuite to elevate user experience and data integrations with ERP and Analytics systems 
  • Design algorithms and workflows that power the development of innovative platform features and enhancements 
  • Lead cross-functional initiatives with Product, PMO, and business teams to ensure effective resource utilization and on-time, high-quality delivery

  • Create and present system architecture diagrams to clearly document and communicate project structures and technical designs

  • Partner with team members through code reviews, pair programming, and ongoing knowledge sharing to foster growth and collaboration 
  • Define DevOps and CI/CD pipeline processes 
  • Other duties as required 

Qualifications:  

  • 8+ years of experience writing production-quality code, with a focus on architect, building scalable, high-performance systems 
  • Proven expertise in developing backend architectures, including APIs, microservices, and third-party integrations 
  • Strong background in event-driven architecture and microservices-based design patterns 
  • Experience writing and maintaining Complex Database Queries / Stored Procedures (SQL) 
  • Proficiency in modern JavaScript frameworks like React, with backend development expertise in NestJS 
  • Hands on experience on with Typescript, Nest.js, React.js, SQL, MongoDB, Azure Cloud,  GraphQL, REST, Shopify, Netsuite SuiteScript preferred 
  • Experience interacting with Azure, MongoDB, Snowflake 
  • Deep understanding of cloud platforms, preferably Azure cloud engineer services, with experience in deployment and infrastructure management 
  • Advanced proficiency in TypeScript and Node.js, writing clean, maintainable, and efficient code 
  • Hands-on experience with unit testing frameworks such as Jest to ensure code reliability and robustness 
  • Strong knowledge of monitoring and observability tools to maintain system health and performance 
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail, ensuring high-quality engineering outcomes 
  • Effective communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders 
  • Expertise in DevOps pipeline definitions 

MANSCAPED® Benefits 

  • Take time to find balance and rejuvenate your senses. Enjoy a generous 20 accrued vacation days per year to relax, travel, and spend quality time with your loved ones. We value your need for a healthy work-life balance
  • Health comes first, always. We provide 40 hours of paid sick leave annually, ensuring you can take the time you need to recover

  • We offer 9 paid holidays throughout the year to give you the opportunity to celebrate important moments and take a break from work

  • Our comprehensive life insurance, AD&D and long-term disability coverage provide financial security for you and your family in case of unexpected events

  • We are a remote-first employer. You will receive a monthly utility allowance to help cover the costs of Wifi and phone usage

$165,000—$175,000 USD

job.title: Principal Software Engineer - Developer Tools
job.location: Remote - Bulgaria; Remote - EU; Remote - Poland
job.description:
About MariaDB

MariaDB is making a big impact on the world. Whether you’re checking your bank account, buying a coffee, shopping online, making a phone call, listening to music, taking out a loan or ordering takeout – MariaDB is the backbone of applications used everyday. Companies small and large, including 75% of the Fortune 500, run MariaDB, touching the lives of billions of people. With massive reach through Linux distributions, enterprise deployments and public clouds, MariaDB is uniquely positioned as the leading database for modern application development.

About the Role

MariaDB Plc is seeking a highly experienced and visionary Principal Engineer to develop the next generation of developer tools for MariaDB's entire product range. This role requires a deep understanding of database application development, CI/CD pipelines, and the ability to write high-performance code in C/C++, Rust, Python and TypeScript. Strong experience in using agentic coding tools is highly desirable.

The Mission

At MariaDB, we believe that a database is only as powerful as the hands that build it. We are looking for a Principal Engineer to join our Developer Tools team and help make MariaDB the most developer-friendly ecosystem on the planet.

In this role, you won't just be part of a team; you will be a driving force in delivering an outstanding Developer Experience (DX). You will help bridging the gap between our powerful core engines—including MariaDB Server, and GridGain—and the millions of developers who rely on them to power the next generation of applications.

Key Responsibilities

  • Product Ownership: Take ownership of a core product in the MariaDB developer tools portfolio. Lead its development, testing and build processes using AI coding agents.
  • API & Tooling Excellence: Implement APIs, SDKs and AI agent skills that make building on MariaDB feel like magic.
  • Ecosystem Integration: Ensure seamless integration with modern, AI driven development workflows, including popular frameworks, IDEs, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Management Tooling: Build and refine the interfaces that DBAs and developers use to interact with our products. You will write clean, performant code to evolve our management tools, ensuring technical power is matched by a seamless, intuitive user experience.
  • Cross-Team Cooperation: Work closely with other teams at MariaDB to provide developers and DBAs with the best integrated solution possible.

Who You Are

  • A Seasoned Developer: You have 15+ years of experience in software engineering and product ownership, specifically within the realm of developer tools, database technologies, or infrastructure-as-a-service.
  • Developer-Centric: You know that "good enough" documentation isn't good enough. You have a passion for excellent, production-level code and understand the nuances of what makes a tool indispensable versus a nuisance.
  • Technically Deep: You can hold your own in a deep dive on SQL optimization, distributed systems, or the intricacies of MariaDB. You are a master of C/C++/Rust/Python/TypeScript coding and managing large projects.
  • Strategic & Tactical: You can apply modern development techniques to complex, large-scale codebases, and you know how to use AI agents for major refactoring, implementing features and testing tasks.
  • Community Minded: You understand the unique dynamics of Open Source and how to build tools that the community will love and contribute to.

Required Technical Fluency

  • Core Database Tech: Deep familiarity with MariaDB Server or MySQL ecosystems.
  • Distributed Systems: Experience with high-availability and scaling tools like MaxScale or in-memory computing platforms like GridGain.
  • The Modern Stack: Proficiency in C++, Python and TypeScript and a deep understanding of how they interface with data layers.
  • Cloud Native: Familiarity with Kubernetes, Docker, and cloud-provider DBaaS offerings.

Location

Hybrid in Sofia Bulagria, or Remote - EU

Why You’ll Love It Here

  • A globally distributed team where your code truly matters.
  • Remote or Hybrid work options (location dependent)
  • Projects that stretch your skills and make an impact at scale.
  • Competitive pay, 25 days paid annual leave (plus holidays), and a culture that values creativity and clean engineering.

Compensation

Salary Range: Poland - 300,000 – 395,000 PLN per year (gross)   and     Bulgaria 80,000 - 90,000 Euro per year (gross) 
Please note: The starting salary offered will be commensurate with the candidate's skills, qualifications, and relevant experience, in alignment with our gender-neutral compensation framework.

How to Apply

If you are interested in this position, please submit your application along with your CV/Resume through our ATS Greenhouse on our MariaDB Careers site.

  • At MariaDB we celebrate the diverse experiences and perspectives of our employees because this drives innovation and success. MariaDB is an equal opportunity employer dedicated to creating a welcoming and inclusive workplace for everyone.
  • MariaDB does not sponsor work visas or relocation.
  • MariaDB is committed to providing accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.
  • MariaDB will not accept agency resumes without a prior contractual agreement with HR. Please do not forward resumes to any recruiting alias or employee directly. MariaDB is not responsible for paying any fees associated with any unsolicited submitted CV/Resumes.

job.title: Sr. QA Consultant, Amazon Connect / Contact Center QA
job.location: Remote - India (Bengaluru, Chennai, Gurugram, Hyderabad, Noida, or Pune Only)
job.description:
Why NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture:

At NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture, we are redefining the future of business through the power of AI and groundbreaking technologies like Agentforce. As a trusted leader in AI, AWS, and Salesforce innovation, we craft intelligent solutions—integrating Salesforce Einstein, Service Cloud Voice, Amazon Connect, Agentforce and more—to revolutionize workflows, elevate customer experiences, and deliver tangible results. From conversational AI to predictive analytics, we empower organizations to stay ahead in an ever-evolving digital landscape with cutting-edge, tailored strategies.

We are proud to be creating the future of generative AI and AI agents. Salesforce has launched Agentforce, and NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture, was selected as the only partner for the private beta prior to launch. Post-launch, we’ve earned the distinction of being Salesforce’s #1 partner for Agentforce, reinforcing our role as pioneers in this transformative space.

Be part of the NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture journey and help shape the next wave of AI-powered transformation. Here, you’ll collaborate with trailblazing experts who are passionate about pushing boundaries and leveraging technologies like Agentforce to create impactful customer outcomes. Whether you're developing advanced AI-powered bots, streamlining business operations, or building solutions using the latest generative AI technologies, your work will drive innovation at scale. If you’re ready to make your mark in the AI space, NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture is the place for you.

NeuraFlash is a leading cloud consulting and AI solutions company specializing in Salesforce, AWS, and AI-powered customer experience solutions. Our Quality Assurance practice goes beyond traditional software testing—we combine quality engineering, automation, cloud technologies, and consulting expertise to help clients deliver reliable, scalable, and intelligent solutions.

We are looking for an AWS Amazon Connect QA Consultant / Sr. QA Consultant to support complex cloud contact center implementations involving Amazon Connect, IVR/self-service, omnichannel communications, Salesforce Service Cloud Voice, APIs, and conversational/Generative AI.

This role is ideal for a QA professional with strong hands-on contact center and telephony testing experience who can independently understand complex business flows, translate technical design artifacts into comprehensive test scenarios, coordinate across multiple stakeholders, and drive testing through release readiness.

Key Responsibilities

Amazon Connect, IVR & Telephony Testing

  • Design and execute functional, integration, regression and UAT test scenarios for Amazon Connect contact centers and complex IVRs.
  • Translate Lucidchart/Visio IVR flow diagrams and requirements into detailed test scripts, ensuring complete branch/path coverage.
  • Test DTMF, speech/ASR, Amazon Lex, self-service journeys, authentication, ANI lookup, error/timeout handling, transfer, escalation and callback scenarios.
  • Validate routing profiles, queues, skills, priorities, agent states, hold/transfer/whisper flows, quick connects and supervisor functionality.
  • Test telephony fundamentals including PSTN/DID/toll-free, IVR, ACD, WebRTC, SIP, call recording and transcription.
  • Validate Amazon Connect Agent and Supervisor workspaces and use the Amazon Connect Endpoint Test Utility where applicable.

AWS, API & Salesforce Integration Testing

  • Test integrations across AWS Lambda, DynamoDB, S3, Amazon Lex, Contact Flows, Contact Lens and CloudWatch using the AWS Console and Amazon Connect Admin workspace.
  • Perform end-to-end API testing across Amazon Connect, Salesforce and third-party systems using Postman, SoapUI, REST-assured or similar tools.
  • Validate REST/SOAP requests and responses, schemas, data mapping, authentication, error handling, timeouts and fallback scenarios.
  • Test Salesforce Service Cloud Voice (SCV) integrations including CTI controls, Omni-Channel, screen pops, Voice Call records, agent states and real-time transcription.

Chat, AI & Omnichannel Testing

  • Test Amazon Connect Chat and omnichannel customer journeys.
  • Validate conversational and Generative AI experiences using Amazon Q in Connect, Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Lex, Salesforce Agentforce or similar platforms.
  • Test intent recognition, conversational flows, context, knowledge grounding, agent assist, generated responses, escalation/handoff and fallback scenarios.
  • Evaluate AI responses for accuracy, relevance, hallucinations and appropriate guardrails.

Test Data, Coordination & Delivery

  • Source, prepare and map test data to individual test scenarios and maintain clear scenario-to-data traceability.
  • Coordinate with clients, business teams, developers, architects and multiple vendors to understand E2E business processes and dependencies.
  • Lead defect triage and track issues through closure with clear evidence, logs, recordings and reproduction steps.
  • Prepare test execution reports, quality metrics, test evidence and release/go-no-go recommendations.

Automation & Performance Testing

  • Experience with IVR automation tools such as Cyara, Empirix Hammer, Bespoken, Operata or similar.
  • Support API, voice and chat test automation and CI/CD-based continuous testing.
  • Experience planning and executing load/performance testing using JMeter, LoadRunner, NeoLoad or equivalent tools is desirable.

Must-Have Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years of overall QA/testing experience, including 3+ years in contact center, CTI, IVR, telephony or cloud contact center platforms.
  • Strong hands-on Amazon Connect testing experience, preferably with complex IVR and self-service implementations.
  • Proven ability to read Lucidchart/Visio IVR designs and independently convert them into comprehensive functional test scripts.
  • Strong understanding of IVR, ACD/routing, DTMF, ASR, PSTN, DID/toll-free, call recording and transcription.
  • Hands-on experience with Amazon Connect Admin workspace and AWS Console, including Lambda, DynamoDB, S3, Lex and Contact Flows.
  • Experience testing Amazon Connect Agent/Supervisor workspace and Chat.
  • Experience with Amazon Q in Connect, Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Lex or other conversational/Generative AI platforms.
  • Strong API and integration testing experience using Postman, SoapUI, REST-assured or equivalent.
  • Experience with Salesforce Service Cloud Voice / CTI / Omni-Channel is highly desirable.
  • Strong test planning, test case design, regression testing, defect management and release readiness experience.
  • Experience with Jira, qTest, QMetry, TestRail, Zephyr or equivalent test management tools.

Good-to-Have

  • Experience with Cyara, Empirix Hammer or other IVR automation tools.
  • Load, performance and/or security testing experience.
  • Experience validating Generative AI quality, hallucinations, grounding and guardrails.
  • Salesforce SOQL/reporting, Amazon Connect metrics, Contact Lens and CloudWatch experience.
  • Multi-language IVR/chat testing.
  • Experience with Genesys, Cisco, Avaya, Twilio or other contact center platforms.

What You'll Bring

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a quality engineering mindset.
  • Ability to work independently in complex, multi-vendor consulting environments.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to identify gaps in requirements, test data, integrations and E2E business processes.
  • Ability to clearly communicate quality risks and provide data-driven release readiness recommendations.

job.description:
Why NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture:

At NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture, we are redefining the future of business through the power of AI and groundbreaking technologies like Agentforce. Be part of the NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture journey and help shape the next wave of AI-powered transformation. job.title: Sr Manager, FP&A, Game Development & Publishing
job.description:
Nex is on a mission to help families rediscover the joy of movement. Created by parents for parents, Nex combines technology and play to deliver fun, social, and interactive experiences powered by natural body motion, encouraging kids and adults to move more, play more, and have fun together. Nex Playground, the company’s award-winning active play system, is purpose-built to get families moving year-round, with safety and privacy as core considerations in its intentional design. It is certified kidSAFE+ COPPA compliant and built to support healthy, active play for all ages and abilities.

Nex Playground features a growing library of 50+ experiences, including motion and dance games, fitness and educational experiences, and Nex Originals. Content includes collaborations with partners like Hasbro, Sesame Workshop, and NBCUniversal. Nex has been recognized by Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, TIME’s Best Inventions, and Parents’ Best Entertainment System for Families, and has earned Red Dot, IDEA, and Core77 international design awards. We encourage you to explore Have Fun and Is Motion Gaming Back?, as they offer a deeper look into our culture, values, and explain how our approach to motion gaming differs from previous generations.

Nex employees may be expected to collaborate with colleagues across different time zones. Depending on the role and location, occasional travel may also be required for company events, external meetings, and other business-related activities.

Important Notice: ⚠️ To protect yourself from recruitment scams, please note that Nex communicates through official company emails ending in @nex.inc. If you receive a suspicious email or message, please do not respond and report it immediately to us.

Location: Hybrid - Bay Area (Preferred), Remote - PST/MST only
Annual salary: USD 160,000 - USD 200,000
Final base salary within this range will be determined based on job-related factors, including the candidate’s experience, skills, qualifications, and geographic location.
Type: Full Time
Reports to: Sr. Director, FP&A

The Role

Nex is looking for a Senior Manager, FP&A, Game Development & Publishing to serve as the finance partner to our content and subscription businesses. This role sits at the intersection of two of the company’s most important growth drivers: the games that bring families to Nex Playground and keep them playing, and Play Pass, the subscription service that turns that engagement into recurring revenue. The ideal candidate combines strong modeling and analytical skills with the curiosity and business judgment to influence decisions made by game development, publishing, product, and marketing leaders.

This is a hands-on, high-visibility role with regular exposure to finance leadership and executive stakeholders. The role will own the financial plan for game development and Play Pass, build the models and reporting that guide content investment, and translate data into decisions that grow subscribers, engagement, and recurring revenue.

What You’ll Do

  • Game development investment and portfolio planning
    • You will be the finance partner to our game development and publishing teams, building the budgets, forecasts, and financial models behind our content roadmap. This includes tracking development spend by title and team (internal studios and external partners), modeling project-level economics and ROI, and helping leadership prioritize the portfolio based on expected engagement, retention, and return. You’ll partner with producers to monitor budget-to-actual performance across milestones and flag risks early.
  • Play Pass subscription performance
    • You will own the financial analysis and forecasting for Play Pass, our subscription service, across the full subscriber lifecycle: acquisition, trial-to-paid conversion, renewal, churn, and reactivation. You’ll build cohort-based forecasts, maintain the subscription revenue model, track ARPU and LTV, and translate subscriber behavior into recommendations on pricing, bundling, promotions, and retention initiatives.
  • Content engagement and monetization analytics
    • You will connect game-level engagement data to subscription outcomes, helping the business understand which titles and content drive conversion, retention, and reactivation. You’ll partner with product, data, and marketing teams to define KPIs, build dashboards, and quantify the impact of content releases, pricing tests, and lifecycle campaigns on Play Pass revenue.
  • Licensing, partnerships, and publishing economics
    • You will evaluate the economics of licensed and third-party content, including IP partnerships, co-development deals, minimum guarantees, royalty structures, and revenue shares. You’ll build the deal models used to evaluate and approve new partnerships, and track royalty obligations and partner performance once titles launch.
  • Planning, reporting, and business partnership
    • You will support the annual operating plan and monthly/quarterly forecasts for the game development and Play Pass businesses, and prepare variance analyses, business reviews, and executive-ready materials. You will be expected to bring an independent, data-driven point of view to the table — not just report the numbers, but help shape the decisions behind them.

What You Bring

  • 7–10 years of experience in FP&A, strategic finance, investment banking, consulting, or a related field, with meaningful exposure to video games, digital media/entertainment, or a subscription business
  • Demonstrated experience partnering with product, content, or creative teams on financial decision-making — not just reporting results after the fact
  • Strong financial modeling skills, including cohort analysis, project-level P&Ls, and budget-to-actual tracking
  • Hands-on experience with subscription metrics (conversion, churn, retention, ARPU, LTV) and subscription revenue forecasting
  • Familiarity with game development budgeting, publishing economics, or licensing/royalty structures is a strong plus
  • Comfort working with large engagement or product datasets; SQL experience is a plus
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and operate independently in a fast-paced, evolving environment
  • Excellent communication skills, with experience presenting to finance leadership and executive audiences
  • Advanced Excel/financial modeling required; experience with BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker) and planning systems (e.g., Abacum, Anaplan, Adaptive) preferred
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, or related field; MBA or equivalent experience a plus

We Offer

  • Competitive compensation package.
  • Flexible working hours and vacation policy.
  • Product-driven culture that treasures talents and individual growth.
  • Front-row seat and hands-on experience with cutting edge technologies in the evolving gaming field

Nex is located in San Jose, California, USA and Hong Kong. Learn more about us at https://www.nexplayground.com/about. 

We encourage applications even if you don’t meet more than 50% of the requirements — we believe that experience comes in many forms!

Nex is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. This policy applies to all individuals at every stage of the employment relationship, including all current and prospective employees, and covers all employment decisions including recruitment, hiring, job assignment, promotion, compensation, benefits, training, discipline and termination.

We are committed to providing a workplace free from discrimination and harassment and to fostering an inclusive environment for all employees.

job.title: Associate Product Manager, Data Governance
job.description:
Omada Health is on a mission to bend the curve of chronic disease.

Job overview:

Omada is reimagining virtual-first care for pre-diabetes, diabetes, hypertension, and musculoskeletal conditions, taking into account personal context and comorbid health conditions. As the Associate Product Manager for Data Enablement & Governance, you will help build the shared data foundation that Omada’s analytics teams rely on. You will run governance processes and shared definitions, help build Omada’s semantic layer and data ontology and deliver analytics data products that let analysts answer critical business and clinical questions faster and with more confidence. You will work across Product, Clinical, Commercial, Operations and Finance in close partnership with Data Engineering, Data Science and the analytics teams.

The primary mandate of this role is to support the product strategy and roadmap for Omada’s enterprise analytics foundation: data governance, the semantic layer and ontology, analytics data products and enablement tooling. You are accountable for making sure teams can find, understand and trust the data they use. This means defining how key concepts are governed, how they are modeled and related to one another, how approved definitions become reusable calculations and how analysts and business users engage with the data platform.

You will act as a product owner for Omada’s shared analytics assets, setting clear standards and driving adoption across the company. In practice, this includes:

Data governance and shared definitions

  • Establishing and maintaining authoritative definitions for core business and clinical concepts and resolving conflicts between local and enterprise views
  • Designing and evolving governance processes, SOPs and engagement models so analysts and business users can work efficiently within a coherent, well-understood framework
  • Managing the lifecycle of governed metrics and definitions, including ownership, review, certification, versioning and retirement
  • Keeping business glossary and data catalog content current, including owners, lineage and quality status, so data assets are easy to find and understand

Semantic layer and data ontology

  • Defining and maintaining Omada’s data ontology: the core business and clinical entities (such as member, program, enrollment, engagement, client and outcome), their attributes and how they relate to one another
  • Translating approved definitions into semantic layer requirements for metrics, dimensions, joins, time grains and approved breakdowns, and partnering with Data Engineering to implement them
  • Establishing shared dimensions so a concept is reported the same way across dashboards, models and AI-assisted tools
  • Writing acceptance criteria and test cases that confirm semantic layer outputs match governed definitions before release
  • Preparing governed business context that AI-assisted analytics tools can use reliably, with clear limits on the questions those tools should answer

Analytics data products

  • Partnering with analytics teams to find recurring questions and duplicated work that a shared data product could replace
  • Defining requirements, data contracts, quality expectations and service levels for curated analytics datasets and models
  • Managing the backlog and roadmap for analytics data products, prioritizing by decision impact, reuse and effort
  • Coordinating releases with Data Engineering, including documentation, change communication and impact assessment for downstream users
  • Tracking adoption, data quality and user feedback, and using that evidence to improve, consolidate or retire products

Enablement

  • Creating documentation, onboarding materials and training that help analysts and business users find and correctly use governed data
  • Collaborating with other product managers to incorporate data science and analytics concepts into their features and experiences

About you:

  • 5+ years of relevant experience with a Bachelor’s degree or additional equivalent/relevant years of experience in lieu of a Bachelor’s (or generally 3+ with an advanced degree)
  • Subject matter expertise in enterprise analytics governance, data product management, analytics engineering or analytics enablement
  • Experience establishing governance processes and associated tool implementation for data definitions, metrics or analytics across multiple business functions
  • Working knowledge of data modeling concepts, including dimensional modeling, entity relationships, grain and slowly changing dimensions
  • SQL proficiency sufficient to profile data, validate metric logic and review analytical models
  • Familiarity with semantic or metrics layers, data catalogs and cloud data platforms (such as Databricks, dbt or OpenMetadata)
  • Experience defining requirements for and launching data products or curated datasets used by analysts
  • Track record of working on problems that are not clearly defined, using advanced knowledge and conceptual thinking to develop solutions
  • Experience with healthcare data standards and regulatory requirements (such as HIPAA and HL7 FHIR) is strongly preferred

Essential Competencies:

Strategic & Analytical:

  • Able to think beyond constraints to imagine new ways to use data to impact members and customers
  • Excellent organizational and analytical skills with strong technical understanding
  • Systems thinker who can model how business concepts relate and see where inconsistent definitions create downstream risk
  • Comfortable analyzing data and leading research/discovery efforts to understand problem spaces, identify opportunities and propose solutions

Communication & Influence:

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to create formal networks with key decision makers and influence stakeholders across multiple functions
  • Skilled at adapting communication style for different audiences, from technical teams to senior executives
  • Able to explain technical data concepts such as grain, lineage and metric logic in plain business language

Collaboration & Problem Solving:

  • Comfortable with ambiguity and adept at solving problems with limited resources and information
  • Great listener who asks insightful questions and doesn’t accept “It’s how we’ve always done it” as an answer
  • Proven ability to reconcile various and opposing stakeholder views to drive results

Execution & Delivery:

  • History of consistently delivering results against target metrics and commitments
  • Writes clear requirements and acceptance criteria and works effectively in agile delivery with engineering partners
  • Ability to exercise autonomous decision making with limited input on methods and techniques to obtain results

Your impact:

In this role, you will directly contribute to transforming how Omada uses data to serve members, customers and internal stakeholders. Your work will:

  • Eliminate fragmentation: Establish single sources of truth for critical business and clinical metrics, reducing confusion and speeding up decisions
  • Increase trust: Build confidence in analytics across the organization through governed definitions and transparent processes
  • Accelerate analysis: Give analytics teams governed, reusable data products and semantic definitions so they spend less time rebuilding logic and reconciling numbers
  • Prepare for AI-assisted analytics: Provide the structured meaning and context AI tools need to answer questions consistently with governed definitions
  • Scale effectively: Create governance frameworks, a shared semantic foundation and enablement systems that scale as Omada’s product portfolio and customer base expand

You will immerse yourself in how teams across Omada learn, make decisions and use data to improve member experiences. Your impact will touch Product, Clinical, Commercial, Operations, Finance and more.

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary with generous annual cash bonus
  • Equity grants
  • Employee stock purchasing plan (ESPP)
  • Remote first work from home culture
  • Flexible Time Off to help you rest, recharge, and connect with loved ones
  • Generous parental leave
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance (and above market employer contributions)
  • 401k retirement savings plan
  • Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA)
  • Mental Health Support Solutions
  • ...and more!

It takes a village to change health care. As we build together toward our mission, we strive to embody the following values in our day-to-day work. We hope these hold meaning for you as well as you consider Omada!

  • Cultivate Trust. We listen closely and we operate with kindness. We provide respectful and candid feedback to each other.
  • Seek Context. We ask to understand and we build connections. We do our research up front to move faster down the road.
  • Act Boldly. We innovate daily to solve problems, improve processes, and find new opportunities for our members and customers.
  • Deliver Results. We reward impact above output. We set a high bar, we’re not afraid to fail, and we take pride in our work.
  • Succeed Together. We prioritize Omada’s progress above team or individual. We have fun as we get stuff done, and we celebrate together. 
  • Remember Why We’re Here. We push through the challenges of changing health care because we know the destination is worth it.

About Omada Health: Omada Health (Nasdaq: OMDA) is reverse engineering the way healthcare is delivered in America, putting the space between doctor visits–where health is won or lost–at the center of care. Today's healthcare system poorly serves chronic conditions that require ongoing support outside of the exam room, like obesity, diabetes, hypertension, cholesterol, and musculoskeletal conditions. Omada’s virtual-first model combines human-led care teams, connected devices, and AI-enabled technology to deliver personalized care at scale, including support for GLP-1 therapy. Omada has served more than two million members since launch across 2,000+ employers, health plans, pharmacy benefit managers, and health systems. Learn more at omadahealth.com.

Omada is thrilled to share that we’ve been certified as a Great Place to Work! Please click here for more information.

We carefully hire the best talent we can find, which means actively seeking diversity of beliefs, backgrounds, education, and ways of thinking. We strive to build an inclusive culture where differences are celebrated and leveraged to inform better design and business decisions. Omada is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, legally protected medical condition, family care status, military or veteran status, marital status, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, or any other basis protected by local, state, or federal laws. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Below is a summary of salary ranges, by geographic zone, for this role*. These ranges represent a good faith estimate of the minimum and maximum base salary for the position in that zone at the time of posting. Please refer to this resource for detail on zone designations.

*The actual offer, including the compensation package, will be within the posted range for the relevant zone and will be determined based on multiple factors, such as the candidate's skills and experience, and other business considerations such as internal equity.

job.title: Associate Test Automation Engineer
job.description:
This is a temporary, 13-month position starting in January 2027 through February 2028 with the potential for extension depending on business needs.

Working at NT Concepts means that you are part of an innovative, agile company dedicated to solving the most critical challenges in National Security. We’re looking for the best and the brightest to join us in supporting this mission. If meaningful work, initiative, creativity, and continuous self-improvement are important to your career, join our growing team and discover What's Next for you.

Mission Focus: NT Concepts is seeking an Associate Test Automation Engineer to support the DoD enterprise Military Housing system. This complex system of 34 web-based modules is used by over 10,000 active users to meet the housing needs of over 2.5 million service members, DoD civilians, and their families.

Clearance: Active DoD Secret clearance required to start

Location/Flexibility: Remote with occasional travel to the DC metro area.

Position Type: Temporary, January 2027 through February 2028.

The Associate Test Automation Engineer will design, develop, execute, and maintain automated tests for enterprise software applications. This role requires at least three years of experience in software test automation, with a strong focus on Selenium and Java.

The engineer will support test planning, requirements analysis, functional and regression testing, defect management, test-result reporting, and release validation. The role will work closely with developers, business analysts, senior test engineers, and other stakeholders to identify issues early and support delivery of high-quality software solutions.

The position supports testing in a Navy on-premises environment that includes development, QAE, staging, and authorized production-validation environments. Preferred experience includes JBoss, Oracle, Java/J2EE, Red Hat Linux, GWT, Checkmarx, and Splunk.

Responsibilities

  • Analyze requirements and acceptance criteria to identify test conditions, risks, automation opportunities, and coverage gaps.
  • Design, develop, execute, and maintain Selenium WebDriver and Java automation for functional, smoke, regression, integration, and system testing.
  • Create and maintain test plans, test cases, test scripts, reusable automation components, test data, logs, reports, and supporting documentation.
  • Maintain traceability among requirements, test cases, automated scripts, test results, defects, and release documentation.
  • Execute testing across development, QAE, and staging environments, including authorized production smoke or validation testing.
  • Support API, performance, and security testing activities as assigned.
  • Support existing CI/CD test integrations, including automated test execution, result reporting, failure analysis, and troubleshooting.
  • Review test failures and distinguish application defects from environment, configuration, data, or automation issues.
  • Document, reproduce, track, prioritize, and verify software defects using Jira, including appropriate test evidence and retest results.
  • Use GitHub to maintain and collaborate on test automation assets.
  • Analyze test results and communicate test status, quality risks, unresolved defects, and release-readiness recommendations.
  • Collaborate with developers, business analysts, senior test engineers, and stakeholders throughout Agile planning, refinement, reviews, retrospectives, defect triage, and release activities.
  • Follow applicable DoD, Navy, organizational quality-assurance, configuration-management, security, and change-control procedures.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience, with at least 3 years of experience in software quality assurance or test automation.
  • Experience designing, developing, maintaining, and executing automated functional and regression tests using Selenium WebDriver and Java.
  • Working knowledge of test planning, test-case development, test execution, defect management, test reporting, and Agile software development practices.
  • Familiarity with JUnit or TestNG, Maven or Gradle, and Jenkins or comparable CI/CD tools used to support automated testing.
  • Experience using Jira for test management, defect tracking, and project documentation, and GitHub or comparable Git-based tools for source control and collaboration.
  • Ability to analyze requirements, maintain test traceability, identify coverage gaps, investigate test failures, document defects, and communicate quality risks and test status.
