job.title: AI Engineer
job.description:
Newsweek is the global media organization that has earned audience time and trust for more than 90 years. Newsweek reaches 100 million people each month with thought-provoking news, opinion, images, graphics, and video delivered across a dozen print and digital platforms. Headquartered in New York City, Newsweek also publishes international editions in EMEA and Asia. 

AI Engineer 

Applied AI & Data Platforms | Newsweek 

About the Role 

Newsweek is seeking an AI Engineer to design, build, and operate practical AI-powered applications, intelligent data tools, and automation that support our business teams, editorial workflows, and digital products. This is a hands-on engineering role focused on turning emerging AI capabilities into reliable, measurable solutions-not primarily a research position. 

You will work across large language models (LLMs), retrieval and search, Python services, data platforms, and cloud infrastructure. An important opportunity is to extend Newsweek’s rankings data platform, enabling business users to explore data, develop and test ranking methodologies, calculate scores, and produce explainable ranking outputs through Jupyter notebooks and reusable workflows. 

The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering and data skills with good judgment about when to use LLMs, deterministic computation, traditional analytics, or a combination of these approaches. You should be comfortable taking an idea from a prototype through evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and iteration. 

What You’ll Do 

Applied AI Products & Intelligent Workflows 

  • Design and build AI-powered applications, assistants, research tools, and workflow automations for internal teams and customer-facing experiences. 
  • Develop LLM-based capabilities such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), semantic search, grounded question answering, summarization, and structured information extraction. 
  • Build tool-using AI agents and multi-step workflows where they deliver clear value, with appropriate permissions, human approval, and safeguards. 
  • Integrate models and AI services through well-designed APIs; use prompt engineering, structured outputs, tool/function calling, and orchestration patterns as appropriate. 
  • Prototype rapidly, validate with real users, and productionize successful ideas with robust error handling, observability, testing, and documentation. 

Rankings, Analytics & Data Platforms 

  • Contribute to the evolution of Newsweek’s rankings data warehouse and its ingestion, normalization, validation, and publication workflows. 
  • Build and maintain Python/Jupyter notebook templates, libraries, and repeatable workflows that empower business teams to explore datasets and develop ranking methodologies with engineering support. 
  • Implement reproducible scoring, weighting, normalization, segmentation, and ranking calculations; document methodology, assumptions, versions, and data provenance. 
  • Work with BigQuery, SQL, structured and semi-structured datasets, and cloud-based pipelines to prepare trustworthy inputs and publish validated outputs to downstream systems. 
  • Create data-quality checks, anomaly detection, result comparisons, audit trails, and human review steps to support defensible rankings. 
  • Explore AI-assisted data exploration and natural-language querying while ensuring that numeric results come from verifiable data and deterministic calculations. 

Engineering, Reliability & Collaboration 

  • Develop production-quality Python services, APIs, batch jobs, and integrations; collaborate on architecture, code reviews, automated tests, CI/CD, and deployment. 
  • Evaluate AI solution quality using task-specific metrics, curated test sets, human feedback, and regression tests; monitor accuracy, latency, reliability, and cost. 
  • Apply security and privacy controls, access permissions, prompt-injection defenses, sensitive data handling, and responsible AI practices. 
  • Partner with business, editorial, product, data, and engineering stakeholders to translate ambiguous problems into scoped solutions and measurable outcomes. 
  • Use AI-assisted development tools effectively while independently verifying generated code and technical decisions. 

Required Qualifications 

  • Strong professional software engineering experience, including hands-on development with Python and SQL, APIs, testing, and maintainable production systems. 
  • Practical experience building and deploying LLM-powered applications using model APIs and modern AI application patterns. 
  • Experience with RAG, embeddings, vector or hybrid retrieval, prompt/tool design, and techniques for grounding and evaluating model outputs. 
  • Experience with data processing, analytical workflows, and notebooks (Jupyter or equivalent); ability to translate analytical requirements into reproducible code. 
  • Working knowledge of relational or analytical databases and data modeling, including experience with a cloud data warehouse or equivalent platform. 
  • Experience with a major cloud platform (preferably Google Cloud), Gihub, and CI/CD pipelines. 
  • Understanding AI system tradeoffs: hallucinations, evaluation, model selection, latency, security, privacy, and inference cost. 
  • Ability to communicate clearly with nontechnical stakeholders, challenge assumptions constructively, and own solutions from design to production. 

Nice to Have 

  • Hands-on experience with Google Cloud services such as BigQuery, Vertex AI/Gemini, Cloud Run, Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub, or Cloud Functions. 
  • Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or equivalent orchestration frameworks; familiarity with MCP and tool integrations. 
  • Knowledge of ranking and scoring models, statistical methods, entity resolution, data-quality tooling, or explainable analytical methodologies. 
  • Experience building governed self-service analytics workflows for business users, including reusable Jupyter notebooks and controlled publication pipelines. 
  • Experience with Terraform, data pipeline orchestration, event-driven services, and monitoring/observability. 
  • Familiarity with search and answer-engine experiences, information retrieval, knowledge graphs, or structured data-enhanced search. 
  • Experience in digital publishing, media, research, analytics, or data-rich consumer platforms. 

What Success Looks Like 

  • You deliver AI tools that solve real business problems and are actively adopted by their intended users. 
  • You turn experiments into dependable production systems with measurable quality, performance, and operating cost. 
  • Business teams can use documented, reusable notebook workflows to develop and validate rankings without relying on engineering for every iteration. 
  • Ranking calculations and AI-generated insights are transparent, reproducible, reviewable, and grounded in trusted data. 
  • You improve Newsweek’s ability to deliver multiple AI initiatives in parallel through reusable components, sound engineering standards, and close cross-functional collaboration. 

Newsweek is an equal opportunity employer. We seek employees of diverse backgrounds and are committed to providing an inclusive, equitable and respectful workplace.

job.title: Backend Software Engineer
job.description:
Newsweek is the global media organization that has earned audience time and trust for more than 90 years. Newsweek reaches 100 million people each month with thought-provoking news, opinion, images, graphics, and video delivered across a dozen print and digital platforms. Headquartered in New York City, Newsweek also publishes international editions in EMEA and Asia. 

Backend Software Engineer (PHP/WordPress & Python) 

Company: Newsweek 

About the Role 

Newsweek is looking for a Backend Software Engineer to help develop, maintain, and enhance the technology powering our digital publishing platforms. 

In this role, you will focus primarily on WordPress development, PHP backend engineering, and content management systems (CMS), building reliable, scalable solutions that support newsroom operations and content delivery across Newsweek's digital products. 

You will work on custom WordPress functionality, editorial tools, content APIs, and integrations that enable our teams to create, manage, and publish content efficiently. You will also contribute to backend services built with Python and cloud technologies. 

We are looking for an engineer who combines strong technical fundamentals with a modern, AI-assisted approach to software development. You should be comfortable leveraging AI tools to accelerate development, improve code quality, solve problems, and streamline engineering workflows while maintaining ownership of the solutions you deliver. 

The ideal candidate has strong experience with WordPress architecture and PHP development, understands modern API-driven applications, and is comfortable working across multiple backend technologies. 

What You'll Do 

WordPress & CMS Development 

  • Design, develop, and maintain custom WordPress functionality, including custom post types, taxonomies, metadata, plugins, and editorial workflows. 
  • Build and enhance Gutenberg blocks and editor tools to improve the content creation and publishing experience. 
  • Develop and maintain REST APIs that support content delivery to web applications and other digital platforms. 
  • Optimize WordPress performance, scalability, security, and maintainability, following WordPress VIP best practices. 
  • Collaborate with editorial, product, and engineering teams to translate publishing requirements into effective technical solutions. 

Backend Services & Integrations 

  • Develop, maintain, and improve backend services and APIs using PHP and Python. 
  • Support asynchronous processing, background jobs, and integrations between internal and external systems. 
  • Work with relational databases, caching technologies, and cloud-based services to ensure reliable application performance. 
  • Integrate third-party platforms and services, including media, analytics, and content distribution tools. 
  • Investigate and resolve production issues, improve system reliability, and contribute to ongoing technical improvements. 

AI-Assisted Development & Engineering Productivity 

  • Effectively leverage AI-powered development tools to accelerate coding, debugging, testing, documentation, and code reviews. 
  • Use AI to support problem-solving, code refactoring, technical research, and implementation of new features. 
  • Critically evaluate, test, and validate AI-generated code to ensure correctness, security, performance, and maintainability. 
  • Identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity through AI-assisted workflows and automation. 
  • Continuously explore emerging AI development capabilities and adopt practical approaches that improve software delivery without compromising engineering standards. 
  • Follow company security and data privacy policies when using AI tools, ensuring sensitive information and proprietary code are handled appropriately. 

Engineering & Collaboration 

  • Write clean, maintainable, well-documented, and testable code. 
  • Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and architectural decisions. 
  • Develop automated tests and follow established CI/CD and deployment practices. 
  • Collaborate with frontend engineers, product managers, and other stakeholders to deliver high-quality solutions. 
  • Take ownership of assigned features and technical improvements from design through deployment. 
  • Identify opportunities to improve developer workflows, application performance, and code quality. 

Required Qualifications 

  • Strong professional experience developing and maintaining production WordPress applications. 
  • Advanced knowledge of PHP 8+, object-oriented programming, and modern PHP development practices, including Composer and dependency management. 
  • Experience building custom WordPress plugins, post types, taxonomies, metadata, and REST APIs. 
  • Hands-on experience developing custom Gutenberg blocks and working with the WordPress block editor. 
  • Understanding of WordPress security, performance optimization, caching, and coding standards. 
  • Experience designing, building, and maintaining RESTful APIs. 
  • Working knowledge of Python, including experience developing backend applications, APIs, or background processing services. 
  • Experience with relational databases such as MySQL or PostgreSQL. 
  • Familiarity with Docker, Git, automated testing, and CI/CD workflows. 
  • Ability to understand and modify React and JavaScript code, particularly in Gutenberg-based interfaces. 
  • Practical experience using AI-assisted development tools, such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, or equivalent solutions, to improve development efficiency and code quality. 
  • Demonstrated ability to critically review, validate, and improve AI-generated code rather than relying on it without verification. 
  • Understanding of responsible AI usage in software development, including security, intellectual property, and data privacy considerations. 
  • Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, and communication skills. 
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced development environment. 

Nice to Have 

  • Experience developing or maintaining applications on WordPress VIP or other enterprise WordPress hosting platforms. 
  • Experience with asynchronous Python frameworks such as FastAPI or Quart. 
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms, particularly Google Cloud Platform (GCP). 
  • Experience with Redis, distributed caching, message queues, or event-driven systems. 
  • Knowledge of cloud-native applications, containerized services, and background workers. 
  • Experience with search technologies such as Elasticsearch. 
  • Familiarity with CDN technologies, cache invalidation, and content delivery optimization. 
  • Experience integrating third-party publishing, analytics, media, or audience engagement platforms. 
  • Experience with automated testing frameworks such as PHPUnit and pytest. 
  • Familiarity with monitoring, logging, and application performance management tools. 
  • Understanding of modern frontend development practices, including React, CSS, and SCSS. 
  • Experience improving engineering processes through AI-assisted automation, testing, or development workflows. 
  • Previous experience working with digital publishing, media, or content-heavy platforms. 

What Success Looks Like 

  • You deliver reliable, maintainable WordPress functionality that improves editorial workflows and publishing capabilities. 
  • You build efficient APIs and backend services that support Newsweek's digital products. 
  • You help improve application performance, stability, scalability, and security. 
  • You effectively use AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity, accelerate delivery, and maintain high code quality. 
  • You demonstrate sound engineering judgment, including the ability to recognize when AI-generated solutions require modification or should not be used. 
  • You take ownership of your work and collaborate effectively with engineering, editorial, and product teams. 
  • You contribute to a high-quality codebase through testing, documentation, code reviews, and thoughtful engineering practices. 

Newsweek is an equal opportunity employer. We seek employees of diverse backgrounds and are committed to providing an inclusive, equitable and respectful workplace.

job.title: Data Scientist
job.description:
Data Scientist

About the company:

Hi, we're Ondo Finance. Our mission is to provide institutional-grade, blockchain-enabled investment products and services. We have both a technology arm that develops decentralized finance technology, and an asset management arm that creates and manages tokenized funds. We were the first company to tokenize exposure to US Treasuries, and have since expanded into several other assets. We are also focused on incubating protocols that can support both tokenized real-world assets and traditional crypto.

Founded by folks from Goldman Sachs Digital Assets Team, we’re backed by some of the best investors in the world including Founders Fund, Coinbase Ventures, Pantera Capital, Tiger Global, and more. We are currently the leaders in the space in terms of AUM and are well capitalized to continue growing the firm. We're fully remote, with team members across the U.S.

About the role:

We are seeking a Data Scientist to drive data and analytics initiatives at Ondo Finance. This role will act as a force multiplier across product, engineering, and business teams, enabling better decision-making through high-impact analytics, insights, and data systems.

Rather than operating in isolation, you will partner closely with multiple teams across Ondo’s product suite (tokenized treasuries, equities, ETFs, Ondo Perps, and Ondo Chain) to identify opportunities, prioritize data work, and deliver insights that shape product strategy, risk management, and growth.

You will work with blockchain data tools like Dune and Allium to analyze on-chain activity, monitor market trends, and support key initiatives across trading, ecosystem growth, and product development. Success in this role requires not only technical proficiency in Python, SQL, and R, but also the ability to communicate complex findings effectively to stakeholders.

Responsibilities:

  • Be our first data scientist - lead all efforts to track and measure Ondo on-chain and off-chain data and and analytics across products like Ondo tokenized equities & ETFs, USDY, OUSG and Ondo Chain
  • Be an onchain data wizard - you should already be deep in Dune, Flipside, block explorers, Birdeye/Dexscreener APIs, CEX APIs
  • Monitor and analyze relevant competitive and industry data
  • Develop and maintain client-side analytics Ondo web products
  • Have strong opinions on data infrastructure stack including BI tools/data visualizations, event tracking, ETL, data warehousing and feature flags/AB tests.
  • Support onchain accounting processes and operations automation
  • Generate data-driven insights for marketing, external presentations, and strategic planning

Requirements:

  • 3-4 years of experience as a Data Scientist and/or Data Analyst
  • 1+ year(s) as a Data Scientist at a web3/crypto company or demonstrated experience working with blockchain data and web3 technologies
  • Strong proficiency in writing complex queries, statistical analysis and programming languages such as Python, SQL and R
  • Familiarity with A/B testing methodologies
  • Web3 product sense - you are a active user
  • Experience with and knowledge of DeFi
  • Strong proficiency in data visualization tools and BI platforms
  • Experience with ETL processes and data pipeline development
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate complex findings into actionable insights for non-technical stakeholders

Nice to haves:

  • Public dashboards on Dune, Flipside or other open-source web3 data visualization platforms
  • Understands concepts at the intersection of on-chain data and DeFi like risk modeling, collateral ratios, MEV, oracle data feeds
  • Familiarity with market making and trading systems

What we offer:

  • Competitive compensation including salary, future token rights, and/or equity (according to your preferences) — we're well-funded and believe that great talent deserves great compensation
  • Full benefits (medical, vision, and dental) and flexible vacation policy (PTO)
  • Small remote-first team across many countries — you'll be an early team member helping shape our vision, culture, and design practices
  • A+ colleagues — our team includes alumni from: Goldman Sachs, Blackrock, Two Sigma, Bridgewater, SpaceX, AWS, Meta, Google, Pinterest, McKinsey, Circle, Uniswap, Phantom
  • Best-in-class investors — we are proud to be backed by leading crypto experts and VCs, including Pantera Capital, Founders Fund and Coinbase Ventures

job.title: Senior Product Designer, Consumer Mobile
job.description:
About the company

Hi, we're Ondo Finance. Our mission is to provide institutional-grade, blockchain-enabled investment products and services. We have both a technology arm that develops decentralized finance technology, and an asset management arm that creates and manages tokenized funds. We are the global leader in tokenized treasuries, tokenized stocks and ETFs, and are building the future of institutional-grade financial services onchain.

Founded by folks from Goldman Sachs Digital Assets Team, we’re backed by some of the best investors in the world including Founders Fund, Coinbase Ventures, Pantera Capital, Tiger Global, and more. We are currently the leaders in the space in terms of AUM and are well capitalized to continue growing the firm. We're fully remote, with team members across the U.S.

About the role

Ondo Finance is looking for a visually driven Mid to Senior Product Designer to shape consumer mobile that help people interact with and trade sophisticated financial products. Your primary focus will be native iOS and Android experiences that make complex financial actions feel clear, intuitive, and easy to use.

This is a hands-on role for a designer who has a track record shipping consumer apps and cares deeply about how a product looks, feels and responds. You'll work from early product definition through detailed interaction design and launch, creating polished interfaces, thoughtful motion, and mobile interactions that help users understand what is happening at every step. You'll partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Research to influence product direction and raise the quality bar for Ondo's consumer experiences on mobile.

Target Outcomes

  • Create iOS and Android experiences that make complex financial products approachable, intuitive, and trustworthy for consumers.
  • A distinctive and polished visual experience across mobile, with strong typography, hierarchy, layout, and attention to detail.
  • Purposeful motion, animation, transitions, and feedback that clarify state changes, guide users through important actions, and make the product feel responsive.
  • Consistent mobile patterns and reusable components that respect iOS and Android conventions while creating a coherent Ondo experience.
  • Consumer journeys improved through user research, product analytics, and clear design KPIs.
  • Close collaboration between Design, Product, and mobile Engineering from concept through shipped implementation.

Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end design of consumer experiences for iOS and Android apps, from early flows and concepts through polished production interfaces.
  • Turn complex financial workflows into simple, understandable mobile journeys for consumers.
  • Define mobile navigation, information architecture, interaction models, gestures, transitions, loading states, and feedback.
  • Create high-fidelity visual designs, interactive prototypes, motion studies, and clear implementation guidance.
  • Set a high bar for visual craft across typography, color, hierarchy, composition, iconography, and interface detail.
  • Use motion and animation intentionally to communicate relationships, reinforce actions, and help users understand changes in state.
  • Build and evolve scalable mobile patterns and components while accounting for the conventions and strengths of both iOS and Android.
  • Partner closely with mobile engineers throughout development to refine interactions, resolve implementation details, and ensure the shipped experience matches the design intent.
  • Plan and participate in qualitative and quantitative user research, then use product analytics and design KPIs to guide iteration.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of mobile product design experience, preferably in consumer technology, fintech, or similarly complex digital products.
  • A proven track record of shipping consumer-facing native apps for iOS and Android.
  • Experience with Web3, DeFi, or financial products, whether onchain or offchain.
  • A portfolio that shows live mobile products, end-to-end product thinking, strong interaction design, exceptional visual craft, and the outcomes of your work.
  • Deep understanding of mobile interaction design, touch and gesture patterns, platform conventions, navigation models, and responsive interface behavior.
  • Fluent in mobile design patterns including iOS Human Interface Guidelines and Android Material Design
  • Strong visual design skills across typography, color, hierarchy, layout, iconography, and detailed UI execution.
  • Experience designing motion, transitions, microinteractions, and animation for mobile products, with the judgment to use them purposefully.
  • Expert proficiency in Figma or equivalent product design and prototyping tools.
  • Strong command of information architecture, accessibility, and user-centered design fundamentals.
  • Experience owning work from problem definition and prototyping through engineering collaboration, launch, and iteration.
  • Examples of simplifying complex consumer problems through strong product thinking and design craft.
  • Clear communication skills and the ability to explain design decisions and influence product discussions.

Nice to Have

  • Experience designing transactional, data-rich, or trust-sensitive consumer apps.
  • Familiarity with user research methods and analytics platforms.

What we offer

  • Competitive compensation including but not limited to salary, future token rights, and/or equity (according to your preferences) — We are well-funded and believe that great talent deserves great compensation.
  • Full benefits (medical, vision, and dental) and flexible vacation policy (PTO).
  • Remote-first team across many countries — You will be an early team member helping shape our vision, culture, and design practices.
  • A+ colleagues — Our team includes alumni from: Goldman Sachs, Blackrock, Two Sigma, Bridgewater, SpaceX, AWS, Meta, Google, McKinsey, Circle, Uniswap.
  • Best-in-class investors — We are proud to be backed by leading crypto experts and VCs, including Pantera Capital, Founders Fund and Coinbase Ventures.

job.title: Staff Site Reliability Engineer
job.description:
PathAI's mission is to improve patient outcomes with AI-powered pathology. 

PathAI is transforming traditional pathology methods into powerful, new technologies. These innovations in pathology can help accelerate drug development, improve confidence in the accuracy of diagnosis, and get life-saving therapies to patients more quickly. At PathAI, you'll work with a diverse and talented team of people, who are dedicated to solving complex problems and making a huge impact. 

We're looking for a skilled staff level Site Reliability Engineer focused on designing, architecting, and operating our cloud-native and multi-cloud deployment substrates, environment configurations, and delivery and deployment infrastructure across diverse environments - including connected and air-gapped on-premises setups, as well as customer-managed and PathAI-managed cloud environments.

  • Designing, building, and owning our deployment substrates, including core environment definitions, delivery plumbing, and infrastructure configuration management across multi-cloud, on-premises (both connected and air-gapped), and customer-managed cloud environments.
  • Architecting secure, compliant, multi-account cloud environments adhering to NIST, ISO, and SOC2 standards.
  • Integrating cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines with internal developer platforms, connected/air-gapped on-premises customer environments, and hybrid cloud targets.

This is a hybrid position based in Boston (preferred), NYC, Indianapolis. (A remote option may be considered for an exceptional candidate.)

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location Boston, MA is $146,250 - $225,000.  Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law.  

PathAI is an equal opportunity employer. job.title: Software Engineer II (BotStopper)
job.description:
Who We Are

Pindrop is a cybersecurity company delivering continuous identity verification across voice, video, and digital interactions. Powered by the Pindrop Intelligence Network, our unified trust platform helps enterprises answer three critical questions:

Is this identity synthetic? Detect AI-generated and manipulated voice and video.
Is this identity risky? Identify fraud, suspicious behavior, and other risk signals.
Is this identity known? Authenticate identities using voice, device, behavioral, and other signals.

Pindrop brings this intelligence together across purpose-built trust engines to help organizations make informed decisions in real time — protecting customers, workforce interactions, and emerging AI-driven interactions.

Pindrop protects billions of high-risk interactions for enterprises, including leading financial institutions, insurers, and healthcare organizations. Its technology is informed by more than 8 billion real-world interactions annually and protected by 300+ patents.

Recognized by TIME as one of the 10 Most Influential Software Companies of 2026 and by Inc. for Best in Business for Innovation, Pindrop is backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz, IVP, and CapitalG.

What you’ll do

As a Software Engineer II on the BotStopper team, you will help build the cloud-native services and machine learning inference infrastructure powering Pindrop BotStopper™- our real-time AI voice detection solution that helps enterprises distinguish human callers from automated interactions and recognize known registered AI voices.

Built on Pindrop Pulse detection technology and supported by intelligence from the AI Voice Consortium (AIVC), BotStopper helps enterprises identify automated interactions, protect customer experiences, and respond to emerging AI-driven challenges across contact centers.

As a mid-level individual contributor, you'll bring solid backend engineering experience, take end-to-end ownership of assigned features and components, and collaborate closely with Engineering, Research, Product, and SRE to transform emerging technologies into secure, scalable, production-ready systems.

More specifically, you will:

  • Develop, test, deploy, and monitor backend services and APIs supporting BotStopper's real-time detection and scoring capabilities, ensuring low latency, scalability, and reliability.
  • Own the end-to-end delivery of assigned features and components from implementation and testing through production rollout and operational support.
  • Help develop backend capabilities supporting known-AI-voice identification, including integration with the AI Voice Consortium (AIVC) infrastructure.
  • Collaborate with Research to integrate detection models and ML-driven signals into production workflows.
  • Actively participate in code reviews, sharing knowledge with peers and incorporating constructive feedback to improve code quality and maintainability.
  • Design and develop backend services and APIs that support integrations with IVR, Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS), telephony, and conversational AI platforms.
  • Support production operations through incident response, troubleshooting, and applying fixes to maintain system reliability. After an initial onboarding period of approximately three months, participate in the team's established on-call rotation.
  • Utilize AI-assisted development tools to accelerate engineering workflows, while responsibly validating generated code for correctness, security, and performance.

Who you are

  • You maintain momentum when navigating partial requirements or production issues, recovering quickly from setbacks to continue delivering independently.
  • You share context, raise concerns constructively, and participate meaningfully in design and code review discussions with your peers.
  • You consistently deliver production-ready services and APIs from start to finish, making sound engineering decisions based on available metrics and requirements.
  • You build trust by being transparent about progress, risks, and blockers, accurately representing work status and system behavior.
  • You use AI tools to accelerate development while thoughtfully reviewing and validating the output for correctness and security.

Your skill-set

Must Have:

  • 2–5 years of professional software development experience, with a proven track record of shipping stable, secure code to production.
  • Deep proficiency in Go, Python, or comparable backend programming languages, with a strong grasp of data structures, algorithms, and concurrency patterns.
  • Strong Linux/Unix fundamentals and proficiency with Docker and container orchestration frameworks like Kubernetes.
  • Experience developing and operating cloud-native applications using AWS, GCP, or comparable platforms.
  • Hands-on experience with production data or messaging technologies such as PostgreSQL/Aurora, Redis, Kinesis, or similar systems.
  • Ability to participate in an on-call rotation to support low-latency production pipelines.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience working with machine learning inference infrastructure, real-time scoring pipelines, or production ML model integrations.
  • Experience with real-time voice processing, telephony, WebRTC, SIP/RTP, audio signal analysis, or integrations with IVR, CCaaS, and conversational AI platforms.
  • Familiarity with additional cloud and data technologies such as Redshift, DynamoDB, S3, Elasticsearch, IAM, and Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform or AWS CDK.
  • Experience in AI-agent detection, synthetic speech or deepfake detection, identity verification, cybersecurity, or other security-sensitive enterprise systems.

What’s in it for you

The rise of AI voice agents is fundamentally changing how consumers and enterprises communicate. As automated callers become increasingly sophisticated, organizations need reliable ways to recognize machine-driven interactions and respond appropriately without disrupting legitimate customer experiences.

BotStopper represents an important step in Pindrop's broader AI-agent identity and trust strategy. This is an opportunity to help shape an evolving product at a pivotal moment in AI and cybersecurity. You'll tackle challenging problems involving distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and production machine learning while working alongside talented engineers, researchers, and product leaders.

  • Your work will help enterprises identify automated voice interactions, protect contact-center capacity, and respond to emerging AI-driven risks while supporting legitimate customer experiences.
  • Work on low-latency processing, distributed systems, cloud scalability, ML inference infrastructure, and reliable operation under high-volume production conditions.
  • Collaborate with experienced software engineers, research scientists, ML engineers, and product leaders who value thoughtful debate, technical depth, and continuous improvement.
  • Grow your career by learning to independently design solutions for complex problems and contributing to operational excellence, preparing you for the Senior Software Engineer level.
  • AI is changing both what we build and how we build it. You'll be encouraged to incorporate AI responsibly into your development workflow, experiment with emerging tools, and identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity and quality.

What we offer 

As a part of Pindrop, you’ll have a direct impact on our growing list of products and the future of security in the voice-driven economy. We hire great people and take care of them. Here’s a snapshot of the benefits we offer:

  • Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Flexibility to work remotely from outside your country of residence for up to four weeks per year, subject to manager approval and applicable company policies.
  • Flexibility to work remotely from outside your country of residence for up to four weeks per year
  • Competitive compensation package, including RSUs (Restricted Stock Units) for all employees, so everyone shares in our long-term success.
  • While we work flexibly, we prioritize meaningful in-person moments through regular team on-sites, company-wide events, and intentional gatherings that foster connection, collaboration, and shared success.
  • Generous health and welfare plans to choose from - including one employer-paid “employee-only” plan!
  • Best-in-class Health Savings Account (HSA) employer contribution
  • Low-cost vision and dental plans for you and your family, providing comprehensive coverage and peace of mind.
  • Paid Parental Leave - Including birth, adoptive & foster parents
    • One year of diaper delivery for your newest addition to the family! It’s our way of welcoming new Pindroplets to the family!
  • Recurring monthly phone and internet allowance to help cover essential connectivity costs and support flexible work.
  • Enhanced fertility and GLP-1 benefits to support family-building journeys and personalized health needs.
  • Annual Learning & Development stipend to support your professional growth, skill-building, certifications, and continued education.

#LI-Remote #LI-HB1

Please note that the base pay range is a general guideline only. Pindrop considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, a candidate's work experience, education/training, and key skills, as well as market and business considerations, when extending an offer.

US Base Pay Range

$110,000—$140,000 USD

Not sure if this is you?

We want a diverse, global team, with a broad range of experience and perspectives. If this job sounds great, but you’re not sure if you qualify, apply anyway! We carefully consider every application and will either move forward with you, find another team that might be a better fit, keep in touch for future opportunities, or thank you for your time.

AI - A Transformative Force

At Pindrop, we view artificial intelligence as a transformative force that, when harnessed responsibly, can unlock unprecedented value for our customers, partners and society and enable and empower us to continue to deliver cutting-edge technology to combat fraud and unblur the lines between what it means to be human versus machine.

Pindrop may use AI tools to help prioritize job applications for human review. The AI tool may analyze your work experience and skills to assess fit for the role, but does not consider your name or contact details. Applications with the strongest match to job requirements are prioritized for human review; not all applications may be individually reviewed.

Pindrop is an Equal Opportunity Employer

Here at Pindrop, it is our mission to create and maintain a diverse and inclusive work environment. As an equal opportunity employer, all qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetic information, disability, marital and/or veteran status.

job.title: Senior Manager, Data Center Technology & Architecture Programs
job.description:
Job Summary

The Senior Manager, Data Center Technology & Architecture Programs turns customer roadmaps and emerging Data Center architectures into scalable, profitable growth. The role leads application portfolio and technology strategy, develops customer value propositions, builds qualified pipeline, influences specifications, and directs commercial programs from discovery through delivery. The position leads Technical Industry Development and Application Domain professionals and partners with Strategic Accounts, Core Business Development, regional sales, and product teams to accelerate pursuits and expand share of wallet.

Responsibilities 

  • Lead Technical Industry Development and Application Domain teams with clear priorities and measurable goals for customer impact, pipeline, solution adoption, and execution.
  • Own the Data Center application portfolio, technology roadmap, and solution-development priorities.
  • Build business development value streams from market intelligence and customer discovery through specification, pursuit, and post-win replication.
  • Engage hyperscalers, colocation providers, engineering firms, contractors, integrators, OEMs, and partners to identify needs and shape opportunities.
  • Partner with Strategic Accounts, Core Business Development, and regional sales to develop account strategies, executive relationships, qualified pipeline, and revenue.
  • Define value propositions and reference architectures that connect technical differentiation to deployment speed, reliability, efficiency, lifecycle cost, and risk reduction.
  • Manage opportunity development through CRM, account plans, design-in milestones, pursuit stages, forecasts, and conversion metrics.
  • Develop business cases and evaluate opportunities for customer value, market potential, price, margin, scalability, investment, and execution risk.
  • Lead commercial programs with clear scope, milestones, decision gates, ownership, and success measures.
  • Coordinate technical, product, marketing, operations, supply chain, sales, and external partners to deliver customer commitments.
  • Close portfolio, capability, and competitive gaps that limit priority opportunities or speed to revenue.
  • Create sales enablement, coaching, and reusable playbooks that improve qualification, value selling, and replication across regions.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Industrial Technology, Business, Finance, Supply Chain, Operations, or a related field.
  • 12 (+) years of progressive experience in business development, strategic accounts, application engineering, solution architecture, industry development, commercial operations, or technical program management preferred.
  • 5 (+) years of formal people-leadership experience preferred.
  • Experience with hyperscalers, colocation providers, Data Center operators, or other critical-infrastructure customers preferred.
  • Demonstrated success leading teams and cross-functional programs in global, matrixed organizations.
  • Strong knowledge of Data Center applications, customer ecosystems, solution architecture, and specification-driven selling.
  • Proven ability to convert customer roadmaps and market needs into account strategies, qualified opportunities, commercial programs, and revenue.
  • Strong commercial judgment in opportunity qualification, value selling, business cases, pricing, margin, negotiation, and investment prioritization.
  • Executive-level customer engagement, communication, storytelling, negotiation, and presentation skills.
  • Proficiency with CRM, account planning, pipeline management, forecasting, design-in tracking, and business reporting.
  • Proven ability to influence stakeholders, develop ecosystem relationships, coach customer-facing teams, and drive decisions across functions and regions.

Essential Job Functions

  • Must be able to travel domestically and internationally by airplane.
  • Must have a valid driver’s license and be able to operate an automobile.
  • Must be able to travel overnight as dictated by customer and program requirements.
  • Must be able to work across global time zones and participate in customer or supplier meetings outside standard local business hours when required.
  • Must be able to regularly use a computer and communication technology for extended periods.
  • Regular and on-time attendance.
  • Must comply with company safety, information-security, confidentiality, attendance, travel, and other applicable workplace requirements.

Phoenix Contact offers a generous benefits package that includes medical, dental, and vision coverage, 401k matching, bonus plan and a generous time off package. There are also a wide variety of additional benefits available including 16 weeks fully paid maternity leave & 10 weeks fully paid paternity leave, auto allowance, life insurance, short & long-term disability, tuition assistance, and more!

job.title: Senior Data Product Engineer
job.description:
Who We Are:

Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology. We help leading and emerging brands grow by combining deep vertical expertise, strategic thinking, and enterprise intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes.

For more than a decade, we have built our business around one belief: the best technology makes great people better. Our teams of strategists, creatives, analysts, and technologists use Omega, our AI operating system, to surface opportunities faster, investigate what is driving performance, and execute approved work with greater speed and precision. Behind Omega is Iris, our proprietary intelligence layer, built on years of real performance data, strategic frameworks, testing, and learnings from across our client portfolio. AI expands the capacity of our people to think, create, solve harder problems, and make better decisions. Human judgment, creativity, and accountability remain central to how we work. 

As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. We partner closely with our clients as an extension of their teams, working across strategy, execution, and measurement to identify what is truly blocking growth and determine what to do next. Our culture is built on people who are curious, ambitious, accountable, and committed to delivering meaningful results for our clients and for one another.

At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today.

***Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.

A day in the life:

You’ll join novaX, Power Digital’s innovation team, which builds internal and external products that help our teams and clients make decisions and get work done, such as Signal, Omega and Iris. You’ll sit in the AI/ML squad, which focuses on statistical modeling. This is a full-stack data role: you build the data systems our products run on, build predictive models on top of them, like scores that show which clients are ready to grow, and put both in front of the people who use them. One day you might trace why a number doesn’t match its source, fix the pipeline and add a test so it can’t drift again. The next you might sit with the people who use a model, learn how they make the decision, and ship a better version where they work. AI is how we build: you’ll use AI coding tools for most of what you ship, so you can take an idea from raw data to a production feature on your own. As an innovation team we move fast: we try ideas, keep what works, drop what doesn’t, and priorities can shift quickly. We’re looking for someone hungry to learn and grow with us along the way.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, build and own the data systems our products and models run on: pipelines, services and APIs that bring together our warehouse, app databases, spreadsheets and third-party APIs.
  • Build predictive models and take them all the way to production: frame the question with users, build features, test against a baseline, ship the results where people work and keep them healthy.
  • Build with AI every day: use AI coding tools to move faster across the whole stack, and review and test what they produce before it reaches production.
  • Hold what you build to production standards (tests, code review, CI/CD, monitoring and alerts) so bad or late data is caught before a user sees it, and fix the root cause.
  • Turn vague asks into a clear problem, ship a first version fast and improve it from feedback.
  • Share what works (patterns, prompts, tools) so the whole team builds faster.
  • Work with sensitive data, including finance and people data, under strict access rules.
  • Employ AI technologies to enhance and optimize business processes
  • Utilize and leverage Power Digital's Nova ecosystem as it relates to your department
  • Design, build and own the data systems our products and models run on: dbt models, pipelines, services and APIs that bring together our warehouse, app databases, spreadsheets and third-party APIs.
  • Other applicable or related duties as assigned.

Role Requirements:

  • You have 5+ years in data engineering, data science or software roles, with hands-on work that ran in production.
  • You’re full-stack across data: you’ve built pipelines or data services, built predictive models, and connected them to something people use. You don’t need to be the deepest expert in each, but you’re comfortable in all of them.
  • You build with AI every day (Claude Code, Cursor or similar) and can show how it changed what you ship. You review, test and own what it writes.
  • You’ve built and experimented with predictive models, and you’re comfortable with work that needs modeling: framing the problem, building features and evaluating against a baseline.
  • You understand statistics well enough to set up a fair test, spot leakage and tell a real effect from noise.
  • You write strong SQL and Python, and you know good engineering basics: version control, testing and code review.
  • You can walk us through one thing you built end to end: the problem, the data, what you shipped, who used it, what failed along the way, and which parts AI wrote.
  • You start from the decision the user is trying to make, not from the data, and you ask until you understand it.
  • You’re a problem solver who learns fast and fails fast: you’d rather ship something small this week and learn from it than plan for a month, and you keep picking up new tools and methods.
  • You write clearly in English and work well async.
  • Nice to have: Snowflake (our warehouse); cloud deployment and orchestration (for example AWS); some Terraform or other infrastructure as code; marketing or client analytics such as churn or expansion; LLM apps or agents.
  • You have hands-on dbt experience in production: you've built and maintained models, tests, documentation and incremental builds. Most of our transformation work runs on dbt.
  • This is a remote role open to candidates in [the US or Latin America], at [senior, IC4–IC5].

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Reliability: the systems you own meet their agreed freshness and uptime targets, most issues are caught by your checks before a user reports them, and any that slip are resolved within a week.
  • Models in production: every model you ship is monitored, and a change ships only when it beats the current version on held-out data.
  • Adoption: everything you ship has a named user and a usage target agreed with your manager, and at the monthly review you’ve hit it or can explain why.
  • Engineering bar: what you build is tested, documented and reviewable, and a teammate can run it without you.

Most Important Things (MITs)

  • In your first 30 days, ship a fix to a production data flow or model.
  • By 90 days, be the go-to owner for one product’s data layer: you review its changes and resolve its issues without escalation. Put one model change into production with a measured before/after.
  • By 6 months, own the production path for a model end to end (data, deployment, monitoring) and have improved how the team builds and ships, with a pattern, test or tool others use.

Benefits & Perks (Colombia):

  • Salary, Annual Executive Bonus & Equity (Executive only - remove for all others)
  • Base salary + commission opportunities
  • Prepaid Medicine Plan
  • 15 paid vacation days (PTO) per year
  • Up to 4 hours per quarter for paid Volunteer Time Off (VTO) towards philanthropic endeavors
  • Fully flex work environment: full-remote, in-office, or hybrid 
  • A one time 320.000 COP Work From Home (WFH) stipend automatically added to your first paycheck
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • 17 observed Colombian national holidays + 2 mental health recharge days per year
  • Legal benefits like Prima, Cesantias
  • Paid Social Security
  • Unlimited opportunities for growth & leadership within a rapidly growing firm
  • Ongoing employee development programs for personal and professional growth (Hedgehog and Vital 5s)
  • Quarterly awards including prize money and recognition for outstanding performance
  • Opportunities to be involved in company DEI initiatives

Power Digital’s people and culture are at the core of our success, which is why diversity in our team’s backgrounds and experiences are paramount. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds, who strive to make an impact inside and outside of the workplace. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees' points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

Please be aware of fictitious job openings, consulting engagements, solicitations, or employment offers from suspicious sources. These engagements may be an attempt to obtain private information, or to induce you to pay a fee for services related to recruitment or training. Power Digital does NOT charge any application, processing, or training fee at any stage of the recruitment or hiring process. All genuine job openings will be posted on our careers page at https://powerdigitalmarketing.com/company/careers/. If you have any doubts about the authenticity of any messaging behalf of Power Digital, please send us an email at [email removed] before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

    • Offices in Buenos Aires, Medellin, San Diego, New York, Atlanta
  • Healthcare stipend: $50/month to support your healthcare or insurance costs

job.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
job.description:
Radicle Health is a collection of human services software products designed to foster collaboration and innovation, helping organizations better serve their communities. We believe technology plays a crucial role in the success of the human services sector, but no single system can meet the diverse needs of every agency. That’s why we’ve built Radicle Health as a home for mission-driven products that support organizations in delivering essential services. Under one roof, our teams learn from each other, test ideas faster, and think holistically about the individuals and communities we serve.

At Radicle Health, you'll do meaningful work alongside people who genuinely care about our mission, our customers, and each other. Here, you're free to show up as your full self, celebrating wins, having fun, and knowing you're truly part of something bigger. You will have real ownership of your work and your contributions will have a direct impact on our success. We're invested in your growth because when you grow, so do we.

About the Job: 

Join the Radicle Health shared SRE team to help build and evolve a unified platform supporting multiple social service Software-as-a-Service products. We are looking for an energetic self-starter who wants to grow and improve systems under their purview. Our environment spans AWS, Azure, and GCP; this role will focus primarily on AWS (commercial and some GovCloud) initially, while contributing patterns and tooling usable across all clouds. You'll partner closely with individual product teams while shaping shared standards, automation, and platform capabilities.

Who you are: 

  • 5+ years in SRE / DeOps / Platform / Infrastructure Engineering.
  • Eligibility for (or prior possession of) a PIV credential (Tier 1 background investigation).
  • Strong AWS foundations (networking, IAM, compute, storage, managed databases, VPC design); exposure to multi-cloud concepts.
  • Linux systems administration and production troubleshooting proficiency.
  • Production container experience (Docker plus ECS, Fargate, EKS, or Kubernetes).
  • Hands-on IaC (Terraform, Pulumi, or CloudFormation) with willingness to adopt Pulumi.
  • Scripting or programming in at least one of: Python, Bash, TypeScript, Go, Ruby, or similar.
  • CI/CD pipeline design and maintenance (GitLab CI or equivalent).
  • Practical observability (metrics, logs, tracing, alert strategy design -- we're invested in DataDog here).
  • Incident response/on‑call participation with follow‑through on remediation.
  • Clear written and verbal communication; able to tailor depth to audience.
  • Availability during core US Eastern collaboration hours.

Preferred Experience:

  • Pulumi (via Cloud or Self-Hosted).
  • AWS GovCloud experience; familiarity with compliance frameworks (HIPAA, FedRAMP, SOC 2).
  • GCP services (GKE, Cloud SQL, IAM, networking) and foundational Azure awareness.
  • Advanced container orchestration (autoscaling strategies, service mesh, workload isolation).
  • Performance tuning & optimization for PostgreSQL or other relational databases.
  • Application ecosystem familiarity: Ruby and/or .NET.
  • Disaster recovery strategy, resilience / chaos engineering practice.
  • AI-assisted DevOps / AIOps tooling: e.g., GitHub Copilot, incident automation, AI-driven runbook generation, etc.
  • Experience applying LLMs or automation to infra workflows (e.g., generating IaC modules, intelligent alert tuning, predictive scaling).
  • Familiarity with AI transformation initiatives: governance, data sensitivity considerations, and secure integration of AI into engineering workflows.

What you’ll be responsible for: 

1. Infrastructure as Code & Cloud Engineering  

  • Design, build, and evolve AWS (and GCP initial scope) infrastructure using IaC (Pulumi preferred; Terraform/CloudFormation experience transferable).  

2. Container & Runtime Platform  

  • Advance containerization (ECS/Fargate, EKS/Kubernetes, or equivalent) and establish secure, observable runtime patterns.  

3. Microsoft Stack

  • Working knowledge of Windows Server, Microsoft SQL, Active Directory, and .NET. Proven ability to manage and maintain systems running these components. 

4. CI/CD & Release Engineering

  • Enhance pipelines (GitLab CI or similar) for reliable builds, automated testing, artifact/version management, and progressive delivery.

4. Collaboration & Enablement  

  • Partner with engineering pods on hands-on implementation, architecture, incident response readiness, and post‑incident improvement.  

5. Observability & Operational Excellence  

  • Implement actionable metrics, tracing, structured logging, and intelligent alerting; refine SLOs and reduce MTTR.  

6. Reliability & Performance  

  • Lead capacity planning, resilience reviews, failover / DR exercises, and performance tuning aligned to SLIs/SLOs.  

7. Security & Compliance  

  • Embed least‑privilege IAM, secrets management, hardened configurations, and support compliance needs (e.g., GovCloud, healthcare).  

8. Automation & Tooling  

  • Eliminate toil via scripting, reusable service templates, policy-as-code, and self‑service operational workflows.  

9. Documentation & Runbooks  

  • Maintain clear architecture diagrams, decision records, playbooks, and onboarding guides.  

10. Incident & On‑Call  

  • Participate in a humane rotation; drive blameless retros and ensure remediation actions are implemented.

What we offer: 

  • Unlimited PTO policy 
  • Competitive medical, dental, and vision healthcare coverage  
  • 401k matching 
  • Paid holidays 
  • Volunteer time off 
  • Paid parental leave 
  • Remote work stipend  
  • Compensation: $140,000 - $150,000
  • Location: Remote 

Salary ranges are dependent on a variety of factors, including qualifications, experience and geographic location. More information about the salary range specific to your working location and other factors will be shared during the hiring process. 

Please note that all official communication regarding opportunities at Radicle Health will only come from an @radicle-health.com email address. Some fraudulent domains may look very similar at a glance, so if anything feels off, please proceed with caution. 

Radicle Health is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer that proudly pursues and hires a diverse workforce. job.title: AI Engineer — Federal Health IT
job.description:
AI Engineer — Federal Health IT
Location: Remote — United States
Security Requirement: Eligibility for a Tier 3 investigation

About the Role

Build AI-powered applications that help federal healthcare IT teams resolve issues faster, access trusted information, and deliver more effective technical support.

Rackner is seeking an AI Engineer to bring large language models (LLMs) and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) into real-world service desk operations. In this hands-on engineering role, you'll create practical tools that enhance human decision-making while embedding security, reliability, and responsible AI practices.

What You'll Do

  • Build LLM-powered applications that streamline ticket triage and help service desk teams resolve technical issues more efficiently.
  • Develop RAG-based capabilities that make authorized enterprise knowledge easier to discover and use.
  • Evaluate and refine model-generated outputs to strengthen accuracy, relevance, and reliability.
  • Create workflows that enable AI to draft recommendations and suggest actions for human review before use.
  • Embed security controls, monitoring, and human oversight throughout AI-enabled applications.
  • Integrate intelligent automation into existing service desk processes using government-licensed or authorized tools.
  • Partner with technical and operational teams to advance responsible AI adoption while adhering to applicable federal AI governance requirements.

Required Qualifications

  • 4+ years of software engineering experience, including building applications using large language models (LLMs).
  • Experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and evaluating model output.
  • Eligibility for a Tier 3 investigation.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with the ServiceNow platform, including its AI capabilities.
  • Experience delivering AI solutions in federal or other regulated environments.

Why Rackner?

Apply your engineering expertise to meaningful federal healthcare IT challenges. At Rackner, you'll collaborate with technical and operational professionals, tackle real-world problems, and help translate emerging technologies into practical, secure applications while continuing to grow professionally.

Benefits & Perks

  • Company-supported certifications and professional development opportunities.
  • Career growth and leadership development opportunities.
  • 401(k) with 100% company match up to 6%.
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance.
  • Life and disability insurance.
  • Paid time off and paid holidays.
  • Home-office equipment and remote-work support.
  • Fitness and wellness reimbursement.
  • Weekly pay and team events.

Work Arrangement

This position is remote within the United States.

Equal Employment Opportunity

job.title: Business / Data Analyst
job.description:
Join us at Sparksoft, where we're not just another tech company—we're a catalyst for change. Our mission isn't just to offer IT solutions; it's to revolutionize the way you work. Here, passion isn't just a buzzword; it's the fuel behind groundbreaking ideas and transformative technologies. We serve a wide range of government clients, delivering impact that's felt across the nation.

Our true strength lies in our people. They're the problem-solvers and innovators consistently delivering extraordinary outcomes. With Sparksoft, you're not stepping into a routine job; you're joining a team committed to innovation and excellence. Our innovation extends beyond just delivering projects. Through our specialized Innovation Centers, we continuously refine our methods, ensuring we remain industry leaders.

We are Sparksoft!

We are seeking a motivated Business/Data Analyst Intern to support data analysis, reporting, business process analysis, and data-driven decision-making initiatives. This internship provides an opportunity for a student or recent graduate to apply academic knowledge to real-world business and data challenges while gaining practical experience working with business stakeholders, analysts, and technical teams.

ROLE & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Collect, organize, review, and analyze business and operational data.
  • Assist with identifying data trends, patterns, anomalies, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Support the development of reports, dashboards, metrics, and key performance indicators (KPIs).
  • Perform basic data profiling, cleansing, validation, and reconciliation.
  • Assist in translating business questions into analytical requirements.
  • Use spreadsheets, visualization tools, and analytical techniques to communicate findings.
  • Document data sources, business rules, definitions, processes, and analytical results.
  • Prepare presentations and summaries that explain analytical findings to technical and non-technical audiences.

REQUIRED EXPEREINCE:

  • Currently in the senior year of a bachelor's degree program, or recently completed a bachelor's degree, in Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Data Science, Information Systems or Management Information Systems, Business Administration, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related analytical discipline.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to organize and analyze data using Microsoft Excel or similar tools.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to summarize analytical findings clearly and concisely.
  • Attention to detail and willingness to investigate data quality or consistency issues.
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance.
  • Must have lived in the United States 3 out of the past 5 years.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

  • Data visualization with Microsoft Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools.
  • Writing basic SQL queries.

EDUCATION & CERTIFICATIONS:

  • The ideal candidate is pursuing or has completed a degree in Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Business, or a related analytical discipline and enjoys using data to understand problems, identify trends, and communicate actionable insights.

WHAT WE OFFER: 

At Sparksoft, we know that people do their best work when they feel supported, inspired, and connected. That’s why we’ve built a workplace that balances comprehensive benefits with a culture of collaboration and innovation. From flexible time off to professional growth opportunities, we’re committed to helping you thrive both inside and outside of work. When you join Sparksoft, you’ll enjoy:

•    Competitive compensation and a 401(k) with employer contributions to help you plan for the future
•    Flexible paid time off and hybrid ways of working that support true work-life balance
•    Comprehensive health coverage—including medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance
•    A curated in-office experience designed to foster community, team connections, and innovation
•    Opportunities to give back through Sparksoft Cares, including annual company-wide fundraising events
•    Training and development programs that build new skills and prepare you for leadership roles
•    A collaborative, transparent, and fun culture—recognized as a Great Place to Work®

Accessibility and Accommodations: Sparksoft Corporation is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals. If you require accommodations during the application or interview process, please contact us at [email removed] or call [phone removed]. Requests are reviewed and fulfilled on a case-by-case basis.

Security Notice: Your privacy and data security are important to us. Sparksoft Corporation will never request sensitive personal information via email. If you receive any suspicious communication claiming to be from Sparksoft, please report it immediately to our security team at [email removed].

Unless expressly permitted by Sparksoft, the use of AI during interviews and assessments is strictly prohibited. Violations may result in disqualification. job.title: Data Platform Enablement Lead
job.description:
At Rush Street Interactive (NYSE: RSI), we’re reimagining play, together. Through BetRivers.com, PlaySugarHouse.com and RushBet.co, we create digital entertainment experiences that are rewarding, responsible and built with players in mind. While fun and games are our product, you’ll join a group of industry leaders dedicated to driving a differentiated, sophisticated iGaming experience.  

Interested? Game on.  

RSI's data platform runs on Snowflake, dbt, Sigma, Looker, Cowork, StatSig, Fullstory, and Optimove tools used every day across engineering, analytics, data science, and the business. What we don't yet have is a single person responsible for how that platform is used — ensuring access is provisioned correctly, costs are tracked and attributed, standards are enforced, and the teams depending on it can actually get value from it.

The Data Platform Enablement Lead fills that gap. This is a hands-on, senior individual contributor role focused on keeping the analytics platform healthy, well-governed, and easy to use so the teams building on it can move faster. You'll keep a close eye on how the platform is performing and how well people are using it, resolve known issues before they become escalations, and make platform health and adoption visible to leadership. The role starts as an individual contributor and is expected to grow as the platform and team scale.

What You'll Do:

Platform Adoption, Enablement & Governance

  • Build and maintain onboarding and documentation so teams can find answers without filing a ticket
  • Triage user requests towards the appropriate Engineering team when required
  • Track and report enablement metrics, tool adoption, platform health, and access request volume to keep the platform's value visible to leadership
  • Surface platform friction and gaps to the Infrastructure Product Manager and partner with internal infrastructure teams on the handoff between IT-owned infrastructure and data platform operations
  • Support the governance and rollout of AI-assisted workflows — including Snowflake Cortex agents and Cowork — ensuring access controls, documentation, and usage standards are in place so teams can adopt them reliably

Platform Administration

  • Manage day-to-day administration across the stack — Snowflake (RBAC, provisioning, license management) and Sigma/Looker (user management, content governance, permissions)
  • Maintain a documented access matrix and support a clear approval process for who gets access to what

DataOps & Platform Reliability

  • Monitor platform-level observability and cost governance for Snowflake — usage tracking, compute attribution, and monthly cost reviews with team leads
  • Provide runbook-driven DataOps coverage during US hours (working-hours support) - triaging incidents, restarting failed jobs, and resolving known issues while the core engineering team is offline
  • Maintain and expand the DataOps runbook library so coverage is systematic and repeatable

Vendor & License Management

  • Track license utilization across Snowflake, Sigma, Looker, StatSig, Fullstory, Cowork, and Optimove, flagging cost anomalies and under/over-utilization
  • Serve as the day-to-day point of contact for platform vendors on operational and access issues

What You'll Bring:

  • Direct experience administering Snowflake including RBAC design, access provisioning, cost monitoring, and warehouse management
  • BI tool administration experience with Sigma, Looker, or equivalent
  • A track record of documenting, communicating, and driving user adoption of data tools and best practices
  • Strong written communication to produce documentation and operational guides others depend on
  • Comfort operating independently, and with runbook-driven operational support or follow-the-sun coverage models
  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Science or related field, or equivalent relevant work experience.
  • 8+ years of relevant experience across data platforms, analytics, or enablement, including at least 3 years in platform operations, DataOps, analytics engineering, or data infrastructure
  • Able to travel occasionally both domestically and internationally 10%
  • Experience in a regulated industry like gaming, finance, or healthcare, preferred.
  • Familiarity with Cowork, StatSig, Fullstory, or Optimove administration, preferred.
  • Demonstrated use of AI-assisted workflows for data analytics, preferred.
  • Experience building usage and cost attribution dashboards in Snowflake or Sigma, preferred.
  • A background spanning both analytics and data evangelization, preferred. #LI-REMOTE

This role spans a wide breadth of experience at Rush Street Interactive, welcoming candidates with diverse experiences, backgrounds, and locations. The pay range reflects potential variations in experience, skills, and location. The pay range does not reflect total compensation, which includes base pay, benefits, and/or bonuses. For candidates outside the US (Canada, Europe, Latin America), we take a locally informed approach to compensation and will share specific ranges based on your country of residence.

Location Eligibility (for nationwide roles): Open to candidates in eligible locations in the Continental US or Canada.

Location Eligibility (for other roles): Location requirements may vary and will be specified in the job posting.

Canada Benefits:

  • Comprehensive health coverage (medical, prescription drugs, vision, and paramedical services)
  • Competitive dental plan with strong coverage for basic, major, and orthodontic services
  • Annual Health Care Spending Account (HCSA) to support your personalized wellness needs
  • 24/7 virtual healthcare access for you and your eligible dependents
  • Life, disability, and AD&D insurance for financial peace of mind
  • Wellness-focused perks including mental health support and rewards programs
  • RRSP and company DPSP contribution, up to 100% of the first 4%
  • Parental leave top up policy
  • Paid vacation and sick time

Pay Range for candidates in Canada:

$110,000—$150,000 CAD

What You Can Expect From Us  

  • Trust, support and room to make an impact. You’ll have the autonomy to make good decisions, supported by people who care about the work we’re building together.  
  • Cross-functional collaboration: Own and shape meaningful work + outcomes with teammates across multiple time zones and jurisdictions.  
  • Growth through new challenges. We believe people grow by solving new problems, stretching their thinking and having the opportunity to contribute beyond the boundaries of a job description.  
  • Flexibility with accountability. We respect life outside of work and offer flexible ways of working, while staying accountable to one another and the outcomes that matter.  
  • Competitive compensation and benefits. You’ll receive a comprehensive package designed to support you at work and beyond.  

Rush Street Interactive is an equal opportunity employer and committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, sexual identity, and expression, marital status, family status, lifestyle, age, culture, religion, military, and veteran status, citizenship, or disability.  

If this sounds like the kind of place where you’d do your best work, we’d like to hear from you.
