job.title: Senior Data Integration Engineer
job.description:
About the Role

Join a Series A logistics software team building data infrastructure for temperature-sensitive and high-value shipments. You will own the integrations that bring shipment, device, and customer-system data into a reliable model, helping logistics teams identify and respond to risk.

What You'll Do

  • Build and own ingestion pipelines for device telemetry, carrier milestones, and customer order data through APIs, webhooks, polling, SFTP files, and queues.

  • Map and normalize source data into shared shipment and telemetry models, with validation and data quality checks.

  • Monitor and support production pipelines with alerts, dashboards, replay, and backfill capabilities.

  • Use partner API specifications and sample data to deliver new integrations.

  • Turn one-off integrations into reusable, configuration-driven pipelines.

What We're Looking For

  • At least 5 years of experience building and operating production data pipelines or backend data systems.

  • Strong Python skills, plus TypeScript/Node.js or another typed backend language, and proficiency with SQL and data modeling.

  • Experience with batch and incremental ETL/ELT, schema mapping, external REST or GraphQL APIs, and production data quality checks.

  • Hands-on cloud experience with Azure or AWS, including relevant data services, and experience monitoring and alerting on pipelines.

  • Ability to own partner data flows end to end, from ingestion and normalization through observability and production support.

  • Experience with IoT, telemetry, logistics, regulated data, event-driven systems, or integration platforms is beneficial.

Compensation & Benefits

Base salary is $140,000 to $180,000 annually, with equity and a cash bonus. Visa sponsorship is available.

Location

Fully remote in the United States.

job.title: Lead Data Engineer
job.description:
Application closing date: Monday, 07 December 2026 • 11:59pm, Canberra time

Estimated start date: Monday, 18 January 2027

Location of work: ACT

Working arrangements: The work is to be undertaken at the Commission’s Office located in Canberra ACT. The expectation is 5 days a week (8 hours per day) Monday to Friday (excluding public holidays). Flexible working arrangements can be negotiated.

Length of contract: 6 months

Contract extensions: Dependant on project requirements

Security clearance: Must have an active Negative Vetting 1 clearance

Rates: $110 - $140 per hour (inc. super)

The National Anti-Corruption Commission (NACC) is seeking an experienced Data Engineer to mainly support delivery of the Enterprise Data Platform (EDP). Ad-hoc support for the broader team’s data processes may also be required.

The EDP is a multi-year program to establish a secure and governed enterprise data platform using Azure Databricks to support data integration, analytics, reporting and data sharing across the Commission. The platform is being delivered by an external System Integrator (SI), while architecture, governance, assurance and acceptance responsibilities remain with NACC.

Reporting to the Data Solutions Architect, the Data Engineer will provide technical support to assist NACC in preparing datasets, validating technical deliverables and assuring implementation outcomes. The role will work closely with internal teams across business stakeholders, ICT, data and the System Integrator.

The role is a hands-on technical position focused on data engineering, data analysis, dataset preparation, testing and validation. For the EDP, the role is not responsible for architecture decisions, platform design, platform implementation, environment management or acceptance decision-making, and will not own production ingestion pipelines delivered by the System Integrator. For other ad-hoc support, the role may develop, maintain or support production data pipelines where needed.

Key duties and responsibilities:

  • Support the Data Solutions Architect by analysing source systems and datasets to identify data structures, business rules, data quality issues, transformation requirements and implementation risks.
  • Prepare datasets for onboarding to the EDP, including profiling, source analysis, mapping, readiness assessments and supporting documentation.
  • Develop and maintain dataset readiness artefacts, including source-to-target mappings, data dictionaries, business rules, validation rules, dataset specifications and test datasets.
  • Review and validate technical artefacts delivered by the System Integrator, including data mappings, transformation logic, data models, semantic models, testing outputs and implementation documentation.
  • Perform testing, reconciliation and data validation activities to verify that delivered solutions meet approved requirements and support investigation of data-related issues identified during implementation.
  • Support with the phase 1 implementation project handover and the internal team capability uplift.


Essential criteria

  1. Demonstrated experience as a Data Engineer working with Azure Databricks, including strong practical experience with Data Factory, PySpark and Delta Lake.
  2. Strong experience developing and supporting data pipelines, analytical datasets and data transformations, with a sound understanding of dimensional modelling, medallion architecture, semantic models and reporting datasets.
  3. Demonstrated experience preparing datasets for implementation projects, including data profiling, mapping, documentation, test data preparation, reconciliation, testing and validation activities.
  4. Experience reviewing and validating work delivered by external vendors or delivery partners against documented requirements, including experience working with sensitive or regulated datasets and applying data governance practices such as metadata management, lineage and access controls.
  5. Demonstrated experience in complex data and digital projects in the Commonwealth Government environment.

Desirable criteria

  1. Experience working within government, law enforcement, intelligence, regulatory or other highly governed environments.
  2. Experience with automated data testing, data quality frameworks, entity resolution, master data management or cross-dataset integration.

HOW TO APPLY

Please provide an updated CV (a maximum of 3-5 pages) to reflect your suitability to the role based on the job description. You will also need to complete responses to the essential and desirable criteria which is no more than 5000 characters for each response. Your application will be reviewed based on ability to demonstrate, or potential to develop, the capabilities required.

job.title: Data Analyst | Clearing
job.description:
About Marex

Marex Group plc (NASDAQ: MRX) is a diversified global financial services platform providing essential liquidity, market access and infrastructure services to clients across energy, commodities and financial markets. The group provides comprehensive breadth and depth of coverage across four core services: clearing, agency and execution, market making, and hedging and investment solutions. It has a leading franchise in many major metals, energy and agricultural products, with access to 60 exchanges. The group provides access to the world’s major commodity markets, covering a broad range of clients that include some of the largest commodity producers, consumers and traders, banks, hedge funds and asset managers. With more than 40 offices worldwide, the group has over 3,000 employees across Europe, Asia and the Americas.

For more information visit https://www.marex.com/

Vacancy Number: VN3408

Department description

Marex has unique access across markets with significant share globally both on and off exchange. The depth of knowledge amongst its teams and divisions provides its customers with clear advantage, and its technology-led service provides access to all major exchanges, order-flow management via screen, voice and DMA, plus award-winning data, insights and analytics.

The Chief Data Office supports the use of data to improve productivity and decision-making and to meet data compliance requirements. Its capabilities span Data Analysis, Data Architecture and Data Intelligence. CDO sets data governance standards, while business data owners and stewards are responsible for applying them to the data they oversee. The firm’s Data Lakehouse architecture serves multiple departments. Technology is a delivery partner to CDO and the Clearing business.

Marex’s data strategy aims to make data easier for business teams and citizen developers to discover and use through governed access, including to explore new products and services. It also aims to give clients better insight into their own data, build communities of practice around data management, and align Data Intelligence capabilities and tools with each business’s goals and ways of working. Commercial data should be used efficiently and in line with commercial licence terms, with auditable usage and fair allocation of associated costs. This role contributes to those aims through its work with Clearing data.

Role Summary

As a Data Analyst within the Data team, you will be working closely with the Clearing business stream. You will act as a bridge between Clearing, Technology and the Chief Data Office for all things data, cultivating relationships with data creators, data owners and data consumers and helping to ensure that data assets are properly defined and maintained within a central data catalogue.

Through your work you will develop a deep understanding of data and dataflows pertinent to Clearing. You will help to identify datasets for ingestion into Marex’s Enterprise Data Platform and will work closely with other members of the Data Team to ensure the data is efficiently ingested and correctly modelled. You will also be expected to assist with data-related requirements gathering for Technology project work related to Clearing.

Responsibilities

Role specific:

  • Identify and analyse structured and unstructured data within the Clearing business stream. Document how it relates to other datasets, how it flows through the organisation, how it is stored and how it is used.
  • Identify datasets for ingestion into Marex’s Enterprise Data Platform and work closely with other members of the Data Team to ensure the data is efficiently ingested and correctly modelled to deliver insights to the business, technology and CDO office.
  • Identify and cultivate relationships with key data creators, data owners and data consumers.
  • Ensure data assets are properly defined and maintained within a central data catalogue.
  • Work with the business and Technology to identify and resolve data issues.
  • Identify potential data quality improvements.
  • Assist the business with Power BI visualisation/dashboard creation.

All staff:

  • Ensuring compliance with the company’s regulatory requirements under the FCA, NFA, AMF, AFM, MAS. 
  • Adhere to the operational risk framework for your role ensuring that all regulatory or company determined parameters are complied with. 
  • Role model for demonstrating highest level standards of integrity and conduct and reflecting Company Values. 
  • At all times complying with the FCA’s Code of Conduct 
  • To ensure that you are fully aware of and adhere to internal policies that relate to you, your role or any other activities for which you have any level of responsibility 
  • To report any breaches of policy to Compliance and/ or your supervisor as required 
  • To escalate risk events immediately  
  • To provide input to risk management processes, as required. 

Competencies, Skills, Experience & Qualifications:

Skills and Experience:
Essential:

  • Experience of working in a data role, aligned to or within a Clearing business stream in the Financial Services sector.
  • Experience of working at a Futures Commission Merchant (FCM).
  • Data modelling, cleansing and enrichment, with experience in conceptual, logical, and physical data modelling.
  • Familiarity with data warehouses and analytical data structures.
  • Experience of data quality assurance, validation, and lineage.
  • Knowledge of software development methodologies (Sprints/Agile) and project management software (Jira).
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Technical Skills:

  • Relational and dimensional (Kimball) data modelling.
  • Familiarity with SQL and NoSQL databases.
  • Advanced SQL scripting.
  • Familiarity with ETL/ELT tools and experience navigating data pipelines.
  • Familiarity with Power BI and experience creating BI models and dashboards.
  • Experience using scripting languages (e.g. Python, PowerShell etc.) to extract insights from file-based storage.
  • Familiarity with Git or other source control software.

Desirable:

  • Knowledge of broker dealer/Prime Brokerage.
  • Experience working in a regulated environment and knowledge of the risk and compliance requirements associated with this.

Competencies:

  • An analytical problem solver, expert in spotting patterns and inferring connections in data.
  • A collaborative team player, approachable, self-efficient and influences a positive work environment.
  • Demonstrates curiosity.
  • Resilient in a challenging, fast-paced environment.
  • Excels at building relationships, networking and influencing others.
  • Strategic collaborator with insight and agility, able to anticipate future challenges, ensuring operational effectiveness.

Conduct Rules, You must:

  • Act with integrity
  • Act with due skill, care and diligence
  • Be open and cooperative with the FCA, the PRA and other regulators
  • Pay due regard to the interests of customers and treat them fairly
  • Observe proper standard of market conduct
  • Act to deliver good outcomes for retail customers

Company Values

Be collaborative - by working together across the organisation, we foster teamwork, can better respond to challenges and successfully deliver for our clients

Act with integrity - we pride ourselves on our honesty and high ethical standards. We apply these values when working with all our clients, colleagues and other stakeholders

Be adaptable and entrepreneurial - we embrace change as markets evolve to constantly increase our efficiency and create innovative solutions for our clients. We are interested in the world around us and inquisitive about understanding the challenges and opportunities our clients face.

Be respectful – how we treat each other, and our clients says everything about who we are. We always act respectfully and treat people fairly in everything we do.

Nurture talent – we aim to grow our own talent and make Marex the place ambitious, hardworking and talented people choose to build their career. This means giving and taking stretch opportunities, taking risks, and committing to career development and support – for ourselves, and our teams.

Marex is fully committed to being an inclusive employer and providing an inclusive and accessible recruitment process for all. We will provide reasonable adjustments to remove any disadvantage to you being considered for this role. We value the differences that a diverse workforce brings to the company.  We welcome applications from candidates returning to the workforce.  Also, Marex is committed to avoiding circumstances in which the appearance or possibility of conflicts of interest may exist within the hiring process.

If you would like to receive any information in a different way or would like us to do anything differently to help you, please include it in your application.

job.title: Resident Solution Architect
job.description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role

Fivetran + dbt is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies.

We’re seeking an experienced Resident Solution Architect with a passion for solving challenging problems with dbt to join our Professional Services team. RSAs are billable to dbt Platform Enterprise customers and help achieve our mission to empower data developers to create and disseminate organizational knowledge.

This is a full-time remote position.

Technologies You’ll Use

  • dbt Platform and dbt Core for data modeling, testing, documentation, development workflows, and jobs
  • SQL and Jinja for building and maintaining data transformations; Python for scripting and integrations as needed
  • Cloud data platforms, such as Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, or Redshift
  • Git and GitHub, including branching, pull requests, and CI/CD workflows
  • Data ingestion and integration tools, including Fivetran, plus APIs and connectors
  • Cloud and orchestration tools used in customer environments; the specific tools will vary by engagement

What You’ll Do

  • Work on a variety of impactful customer technical projects — inclusive of implementation, troubleshooting configurations, instilling best practices, and solutioning MVPs and long term solutions to customer specific requirements
  • Consult on architecture and design
  • Ensure our most strategic dbt platform customers are adopting the product
  • Collaborate with other internal customer facing teams at dbt Labs - Sales, Solution Architects, Training, Support
  • Provide critical feedback to dbt Labs product and engineering teams to improve and prioritize customer requests and ensure rapid resolution for engagement specific issues
  • Become a product expert with dbt in the context of the modern data stack (if you aren't already)

Skills We’re Looking For

  • You have deep experience working with enterprise customers across a variety of use cases, ideally in a customer-facing post-sales, technical architect, or consulting role
  • You have deep expertise in at least one data platform (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift)
  • You have at least 2 years of experience with dbt, ideally including 1 year with dbt platform
  • You are proficient in writing SQL and have some python experience
  • You look forward to building skills in technical areas that support deployment and integration of dbt platform solutions to complete customer projects
  • You are customer focused - embracing one of our core values that users are our best advocates
  • You are highly organized. Comfort with technical project delivery - managing scope, timelines, and deliverables - this role will be staffed on multiple engagements at once
  • You communicate clearly and concisely with internal and external stakeholders - demonstrating a capacity to clearly and concisely communicate about complex technical, architectural, and/or organizational problems and propose thorough iterative solutions
  • You thrive in a remote organization that highly values transparency and cross-collaboration
  • ~10% travel should be expected (occasional customer visits, company retreat and offsites)

Bonus Skills

  • You have obtained the dbt Analytics Engineering Certification
  • You have the ability to advise on dbt Platform recommendations, and build direction/consensus with the customer to move forward
  • Experience with traditional Enterprise ETL tooling (Informatica, Datastage, Talend)

#LI-REMOTE

The compensation range displayed on this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire compensation for the target position and level, and may include sales incentives or target bonuses depending on the role.  Our compensation ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Our job titles may span more than one career level. Within the range, individual compensation is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, relevant education or training, business need, market demands. The compensation range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. Your recruiter can share more about the specific compensation range for your location during the hiring process.

Pay Range

$167,983—$192,000 USD

Perks and Benefits

  • 100% employer-paid medical insurance*
  • Generous paid time away from work, including paid vacation or flexible/unlimited vacation depending on role and country, plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave, paid holidays, including a year-end Global Week of Rest, and volunteer days off.
  • RSU stock grants*
  • Professional development and training opportunities
  • Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team-building activities
  • Monthly cell phone stipend
  • Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents.

*May vary by country and worker type - please reach out to your recruiter for more information

Click here to learn more about Fivetran's Benefits by Region.

We’re honored to be valued at over $5.6 billion, but more importantly, we’re proud of our core values of Get Stuck In, Do the Right Thing, and One Team, One Dream. Read about us in Forbes.     

Fivetran brings together high-quality talent across the globe to make data access as easy and reliable as electricity for our customers. We value and recognize that our customers benefit from having innovative teams made of people from many backgrounds, experiences, and identities. Fivetran promotes diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging through attracting, recruiting, developing, and retaining a diverse workforce, not only because it is the right thing to do, but because it helps us build a world-class company to better serve our customers, our people and our communities.

To learn more about Fivetran’s culture and what it’s like to be part of the team, click here and enjoy our video.

To learn more about our candidate privacy policy, you can read our statement here.

job.title: Azure Cloud Architect
job.description:
Since 2016, T-Rex Solutions (T-Rex) has been supporting large scale hybrid-cloud migrations and systems modernization, to include the successful deployment of the first-ever online U.S. Census in 2020. T-Rex is actively expanding its IT Modernization services within the Federal Civilian market, specifically supporting the Department of Education’s strategic priorities.

T-Rex is seeking an Azure Cloud Architect to design, deploy, operate, and maintain resilient secure Cloud environments as the Department of Education looks to transition from an on-premise infrastructure to the cloud.

Responsibilities:

  • Design Cloud-based system architectures that include Public and private Cloud technologies and services, software, hardware, and communications solutions to support the total requirements, as well as provide for present and future cross-functional requirements and interfaces.
  • Ensure architectures are in compliance with open systems standards as they apply to the client’s environment.
  • Evaluate compatibility of information system development efforts with agency architectures and recommends adjustments, as appropriate
  • Evaluates problems of Cloud connectivity, Cloud platform architecture, workflow, organization, and planning and develops appropriate corrective action

Requirements:

  • Must be a US Citizen with the ability to obtain a Public Trust clearance
  • Strong experience in one or more architecture domains (e.g. business architecture, solutions architecture, application architecture)
  • Familiar with standard concepts, practices, and procedures of cloud technology, including Software as Service (SaaS), Platform as Service (PaaS), or Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS).
  • Experience working in the public cloud.
  • Proven background working in cloud environments with experience and knowledge in 4 or more of the following areas:
    • Agile methodologies including Scrum or Kanban
    • Agile collaboration tools such as Atlassian Jira, Confluence
    • CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitLab, Bitbucket, Artifactory)
    • Containerization and container management with Kubernetes and Helm
    • Security automation with tools such as Static Application Security Testing (SAST) and Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST)
    • Cyber tools - Aviatrix, Orca, Splunk, Amulous, STIG scanner
    • Terraform, Ansible
    • Git, branching strategies, GitFlow and/or GitHub Flow
    • Cloud high availability and scalability best practices and architectures
  • Ability to meet with customers to gather and understand business requirements
  • Ability to quickly adapt to new situations and changing priorities
  • Ability to work under pressure, meet deadlines, and handle multiple projects simultaneously
  • Must be punctual, reliable, and accountable for themselves, with ability to follow through with tasks to completion

Desired Education & Experience:

  • 10+ years of progressive experience engineering and architecting public cloud environments
  • Azure Cloud Certifications
  • Experience working in an agile environment preferred

T-Rex Overview

Established in 1999, T-Rex Solutions, LLC is a proven mid-tier business providing data-centric mission services to the Federal government as it increasingly tries to secure and leverage the power of data. We design, integrate, secure, and deploy advanced technical solutions for our customers so they can efficiently fulfill their critical objectives. T-Rex offers both IT and professional services to numerous Federal agencies and is a leader in providing high quality and innovative solutions in the areas of Cloud and Infrastructure Services, Cyber Security, and Big Data Engineering.

T-Rex is constantly seeking qualified people to join our growing team. We have built a broad client base through our devotion to delivering quality products and customer service, and to do that we need quality individuals. But more than that, we at T-Rex are committed to creating a culture that supports the development of every employee's personal and professional lives. T-Rex has made a commitment to maintain the status of an industry leader in compensation packages and benefits which includes competitive salaries, performance bonuses, training and educational reimbursement, Transamerica 401(k) and Cigna healthcare benefits.

T-Rex is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex (including pregnancy and sexual orientation), parental status, national origin, age, disability, family medical history or genetic information, political affiliation, military service, or other non-merit based factors.

In compliance with pay transparency guidelines, the annual base salary range for this position is $145,000 - $180,000. Please note that the salary information is a general guideline only. T-Rex considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate’s work experience, education/training, key skills, internal peer equity, as well as market and business considerations when extending an offer.

T-Rex offers a diverse and collaborative work environment, exciting opportunities for professional growth, and generous benefits, including: PTO available to use immediately upon joining (prorated based on start date), paid parental leave, individual and family health, vision, and dental benefits, annual budget for training, professional development and tuition reimbursement, and a 401(k) plan with company match fully vested after 60 days of employment among other benefits.

job.title: Dynatrace Senior Consultant – Application Development
job.description:
Company Overview:

Arctiq is a leader in professional IT services and managed services across three core Centers of Excellence: Enterprise Security, Modern Infrastructure, and Platform Engineering. Renowned for our ability to architect intelligence, we connect, protect, and transform organizations, empowering them to thrive in today's digital landscape. Arctiq builds on decades of industry expertise and a customer-centric ethos to deliver exceptional value to clients across diverse industries.

Position Overview:

We are looking for a Dynatrace Senior Consultant with an application development background to deliver observability engagements for Arctiq customers. Working under the direction of our Delivery Architects, you will instrument applications, build custom extensions and integrations, and help development teams get real value from Dynatrace. You are a developer first, comfortable reading customer code, and able to translate application behavior into actionable telemetry.

Responsibilities:

  • Deliver application-level Dynatrace implementations across SaaS and Managed environments, following designs set by the Delivery Architect.
  • Instrument applications using OneAgent, OpenTelemetry SDKs, and custom instrumentation across languages such as Java, .NET, Node.js, Python, and Go.
  • Build custom Dynatrace extensions, API integrations, and apps using the Dynatrace APIs, SDKs, and AppEngine tooling.
  • Configure distributed tracing, service flow, request attributes, and business events to expose application and business performance.
  • Implement Real User Monitoring and synthetic monitoring for web and mobile applications.
  • Configure log ingestion and analysis for application workloads, using DQL to build queries, dashboards, and alerts.
  • Implement configuration as code for Dynatrace using Terraform and the Dynatrace Configuration APIs and tooling.
  • Support Gen2 to Gen3 migration workstreams, including dashboards, alerting, and custom integrations.
  • Work with customer development teams to troubleshoot performance issues and demonstrate how to use Dynatrace in day-to-day development and release work.
  • Document solutions and run knowledge-transfer sessions so customer teams can operate independently.
  • Keep delivery work on scope, schedule, and budget, and flag risks early to the Delivery Architect and engagement lead.
  • Travel up to 25% for project kick-offs, workshops, and close-outs.
  • Pursue continued education through training and industry certifications.

Qualifications:

    • 5+ years of software development experience, including 2+ years delivering on the Dynatrace platform or a comparable APM tool.
    • Strong proficiency in at least one major application language (Java, C#/.NET, Python, Node.js, or Go).
    • Hands-on experience with application instrumentation, distributed tracing, and performance troubleshooting.
    • Working knowledge of Dynatrace Managed and SaaS deployments.
    • Experience with Dynatrace APIs and DQL.
    • Familiarity with core observability practices: tagging, synthetics, RUM, logging, and dashboards.
    • Active Dynatrace Associate certification, or willingness to obtain it within the first 90 days.
    • Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to work directly with customer developers.
    • Ability to travel up to 25%.

    Technical Requirements:

    • Hands-on experience with OpenTelemetry (OTel) instrumentation and collectors.
    • Experience with AWS or Azure.
    • Experience with Kubernetes and containerized applications.
    • Working knowledge of Terraform and Git-based workflows.
    • Understanding of microservices and API-based architectures.

    Nice to have:

    • Experience building Dynatrace extensions or AppEngine apps.
    • Exposure to Gen2 to Gen3 Dynatrace migration.
    • Active higher-level Dynatrace certification, such as Dynatrace Implementation or Dynatrace Professional.
    • Experience with competing APM platforms such as Datadog, New Relic, AppDynamics, and Splunk.
    • Prior consulting or professional services experience.

job.title: Solution Sales Executive - Supply Chain Management (SCM) - AI Expertise
job.description:
Company Description

Job Description

Most companies talk about AI. The harder thing is knowing what to do with it. Customers today don't need an introduction to the technology. They need someone who can look at how their business actually works, understand where the pressure is, and tell them honestly what AI can change and what it can't. That's the conversation at the heart of these roles. At SAP, you'll be working across 25 industries with some of the most complex organisations in the world, including 97 of the world's 100 most sustainable companies. If AI is what gets you out of bed, this is where that goes somewhere real.  

What you'll bring 

You currently lead AI and cloud solution selling through structured discovery, value engineering, and consultative commercial engagement — building buying commitment across complex, multi-stakeholder environments. 

You will have/be: 

  • Proven ability to lead outcome-based discovery and value-engineering engagements — facilitating workshops that map AI and cloud priorities to measurable business outcomes and co-build the commercial case for change 

  • Strong command of AI-era solution selling, including consumption-based commercial structuring and the ability to guide customers to committed cloud investment through quantified outcome narratives 

  • Expert at applying AI value selling using outcome modelling, demand signal data, and agentic AI tools to personalize engagement and accelerate decision timelines across extended sales cycles 

  • Skilled in multi-stakeholder influence and change management selling — mapping sponsor networks, adapting commercial narratives to stakeholder priorities, and sustaining momentum through extended approval structures 

What you'll build 

  • Lead discovery and value-engineering sessions — facilitating multi-stakeholder workshops that quantify the cost of inaction and establish the commercial foundation for SAP AI and cloud investment decisions 

  • Drive AI and cloud deals from qualification to commercial close — co-designing solutions, managing outcomes-based commercial terms, and orchestrating partner and specialist support 

  • Apply AI value selling through scenario analysis and AI-generated insights to place SAP's capabilities at the center of customer technology investment decisions 

  • Use competitive positioning to articulate SAP's AI differentiation against alternative vendors and internal build approaches with precision across complex buying environments 

  • Use strategic AI synthesis to continuously refresh account intelligence, surface unrecognized opportunities, and refine deal positioning in real time 

  • Apply data-driven stakeholder engagement to identify stall risk, prioritize interventions, and sustain pipeline progression to close 

Where you belong 

Part of the Customer Value Group, a global community of solution sales professionals driving cloud revenue growth through deep domain expertise. At this level you operate with real independence — owning your solution domain, running discovery-to-close cycles, and delivering the AI-transformation outcomes that define SAP's cloud success. 

As we transform into the autonomous enterprise, we are proactively engaging with talent who will play a key role in building the capabilities required to deliver on our 2027 priorities.    

 

#SAPCVGCareers 

Qualifications

Additional Information

About SAP
With a global network of customers, partners, employees, and thought leaders, SAP helps the world run better and improves people’s lives.
As a leader in enterprise applications and business AI, SAP stands at the nexus of business and technology. For over 50 years, organizations have trusted SAP to bring out their best by uniting business-critical operations spanning finance, procurement, HR, supply chain, and customer experience.

We win with inclusion
SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone – regardless of background – feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better world.
SAP is committed to the values of Equal Employment Opportunity and provides accessibility accommodations to applicants with physical and/or mental disabilities. If you are interested in applying for employment with SAP and are in need of accommodation or special assistance to navigate our website or to complete your application, please send an e-mail with your request to Recruiting Operations Team: [email removed].
For SAP employees: Only permanent roles are eligible for the SAP Employee Referral Program, according to the eligibility rules set in the SAP Referral Policy. Specific conditions may apply for roles in Vocational Training.
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their age, race, religion, national origin, ethnicity, age, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, et al), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or disability.

Compensation Range Transparency
SAP believes pay transparency is essential to fostering an honest, supportive, and inclusive culture and is an important part of our commitment to pay equity. The salary range for this position is included in the job posting. The actual compensation offered to the successful candidate will fall within that range and will depend on factors such as education, skills, experience, location, and scope of the role, as determined through the selection process. Where applicable, SAP may also provide variable incentive opportunities and additional benefits, subject to the terms of the relevant plans and policies. Any variable incentive amount is target-based, with actual payouts dependent on company and individual performance. Please reference this link for a summary of SAP benefits and eligibility requirements: SAP North America Benefits.

AI Usage in the Recruitment Process
For information on the responsible use of AI in our recruitment process, please refer to our Guidelines for Ethical Usage of AI in the Recruiting Process.
Please note that any violation of these guidelines may result in disqualification from the hiring process.

job.title: Web Development & SEO/GEO Manager
job.description:
When someone searches "apartments near downtown Austin" or asks an AI assistant where to live in Dallas, we want Smart City to be the answer. Smart City is looking for a GEO, SEO & Web Development Manager who understands how renters search, on Google and in AI tools like ChatGPT and Perplexity, and who builds the content and technical foundation that puts us in front of them in every market we serve. This is a hands-on role: you will write first drafts of our search content, from neighborhood guides to market pages, for our Content Manager to edit and publish, run technical SEO across our sites, and build and maintain the website itself, shipping pages and fixes directly. You will also have room to grow this into a full function, with the roadmap, measurement, and playbooks to match. This role reports to the Senior Director of Performance & Growth, Marketing, and works closely with the brand and creative team, our web agency, our paid media and growth and conversion teams, and our local market teams.

What You'll Do

  • Own development on our WordPress websites: build and update templates for market, neighborhood, landing, and listing pages, and keep the site fast, accessible, and secureBuild and own the SEO and GEO strategy across our websites and every market we serve, tied to leads and leases
  • Research how renters search by market, neighborhood, and moment, and turn what you learn into a content plan
  • Write first drafts of search content: neighborhood and market guides, apartment and deal pages, and answers to the questions renters ask. Our Content Manager edits and publishes them, and the creative team adds visuals
  • Run technical SEO: site audits, crawling and indexing, page speed and Core Web Vitals, structured data, and site architecture, shipping the fixes yourself and bringing in our web agency for larger builds
  • Ship market pages for every new city launch with the Growth & Conversion Manager, so each market goes live indexed, tracked, and ready to convert
  • Build and maintain site forms and integrations with the Growth & Conversion Manager, who owns measurement, so tracking stays clean and every lead reaches our CRM
  • Manage our web agency's development hours: scope the work, set priorities with the Senior Director, review and test every release, and keep code, plugins, and admin access clean and documented
  • Work with the brand and creative team so every page you build meets our brand and design standards
  • Optimize for AI search, so assistants and answer engines understand, trust, and cite Smart City
  • Manage local search: Google Business Profiles and local listings for each market. Work with the reputation team so review volume and ratings support local rankings
  • Earn links and citations through local partnerships, PR, and content worth sharing
  • Track rankings, organic traffic, AI visibility, and organic leads and leases, and report results to the Senior Director
  • Build the function over time: the roadmap, playbooks, tools, and the case for future headcount
  • Keep all content within Fair Housing guidelines

Who We're Looking For

  • 7 to 10 years of WordPress web development experience, in-house or agency
  • Strong technical SEO skills: audits, indexing, structured data, Core Web Vitals, and site migrations, with a track record of growing organic traffic and leads
  • Experience owning a production website: page templates, site speed, accessibility, security updates and plugins, and managing an outside web agency
  • A strong writer, with samples of search content you have written
  • Hands-on experience with GEO or AI search optimization, and real curiosity about where search is heading
  • Local SEO experience across multiple markets or locations, including Google Business Profile
  • Fluency with GA4, Google Search Console, and SEO tools such as Semrush, Ahrefs, or Screaming Frog
  • Hands-on web development skills in WordPress, PHP, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, plus Git and a staging-to-production release process
  • Analytical: you tie organic work to leads and revenue, and build clear reporting
  • Bachelor's degree required, ideally in marketing, communications, journalism, or a related field
  • Self-directed and comfortable owning a channel and a website end to end

Nice to Have

  • Experience building an SEO function from the ground up
  • Experience in real estate, rentals, proptech, or a multi-location services business
  • Programmatic SEO for location or listing pages
  • Experience with Fair Housing or other regulated content
  • Schema markup for listings, local businesses, and reviews
  • WordPress performance and security hardening, Cloudflare, and Core Web Vitals tooling
  • React, which runs some of our site's forms

Physical Requirements

  • Travel to and touring properties around the city may periodically be required.
  • Travel to other markets may periodically be required.
  • Assures that safety regulations are followed at all times.
  • Adherence to compliance measures implemented by governing bodies such as but not limited to OSHA & the CDC. Follows policies and procedures including infection control, universal precautions, and exposure control plans when performing daily tasks.
  • Reports hazardous conditions, accidents, and incidents to the immediate supervisor.
  • Must be able to lift up to 25 lbs.
  • Requires standing, walking, bending, kneeling, stooping and crouching.

Expected Hours of Work

  • Typical business hours: 8:30am - 5:30pm Monday - Friday, availability for escalations may be needed outside of normal business hours.
  • Hybrid: in office 3 days a week at our Southwest Austin office.

Travel

  • Up to 10% of the time.
  • Minimal travel may be required for business functions, team training, and culture events.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Eligibility for Bonus(es), dependent on role/department.
  • Eligibility for medical, dental, and vision coverage as well as a 401(k) plan subject to plan terms.
  • Eligibility for company-paid benefits such as company-paid and voluntary life insurance, short & long-term disability, and parental leave subject to applicable waiting periods.
  • Flexible PTO
  • Company-Recognized Paid Holidays
  • Monthly cell phone stipend

All offers of employment are conditioned upon the candidate’s completion of a Form I-9 and delivery of appropriate documentation to establish the candidate’s identity and legal authorization to work in the United States. This document in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by the individual occupying this position. This is a representative list of the general duties, and it is not intended to be all-inclusive. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.

We Take Equality Seriously: Smart City is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and does not discriminate based on race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, gender, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law, in connection with any aspect of employment at Smart City Locating.

Who We Are: We are more than just an apartment locating company. We love what we do, and we work all the time because to us, it doesn’t feel like work. We believe that professionalism is doing what you say you’re going to do. We pride ourselves on teamwork, and we live for helping others. We get excited when faced with a tough challenge and go the extra mile to achieve our goals. We believe in quick communication, accessibility, transparency, and having fun while putting in good old fashioned hard work. We go above and beyond, we are hyper-personalized, and we make friends, not clients. You are not just another email address, and we are not just another real estate service. WE ARE SMART CITY!

Our values (H.O.N.O.R) need to resonate hardcore with you:

  • Honor Bound – We do what we say we’re going to do, and we don’t need to wear a suit and tie to do it.
  • Overachievers – We always go the extra mile.
  • Never Settle – We are constantly striving for growth, both personally and professionally.
  • Optimistic – We are a genuine force of positivity, not like rainbows and butterflies, but like, life is good.
  • Real People – We treat everyone like friends, and we’re real human beings who make mistakes sometimes. Let’s learn from it and move forward.

Perks - you know you want ‘em:

  • Comprehensive and flexible health benefits plan including EAP
  • Life and Disability Insurance
  • Flex PTO, minimum of 10 days required each calendar year
  • 12 Paid Holidays + 1 floating holiday!
  • Monthly cell phone stipend
  • Casual dress code
  • A wide variety of office snacks and drinks provided complimentary
  • Dog-friendly office with yummy treats
  • Professional development and training opportunities

Our team is extremely important to us and we’re excited to have been recognized as one of Dallas Business Journal’s ‘2019 Best Places to Work’. Check out our LinkedIn page to see what #SmartCityLife is all about!

job.title: Account Development Representative - France
job.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role

As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Samsara, you will be trained — both on the job and through formal programs led by a world-class Sales team — to take on your next role as a closing Account Executive. On a daily basis, you will build and work a portfolio of target accounts for our EMEA business in France: researching each account for commercial signal, prioritising which contacts to approach and in what order, and running a connected, multi-touch outbound motion that generates qualified pipeline rather than one-off meetings.

This is a fully remote position open to candidates based in France and requires working hours in CET. Relocation assistance or visa sponsorship will not be provided for this role. 

You should apply if

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: your efforts will result in real-world impact — helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: if you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. Successful ADRs can see promotion to a closing role in two years or less.
  • You’re excited by AI: you’ll use cutting-edge AI tools every day and sell some of the most advanced AI in the physical operations space.
  • You think several moves ahead: you'd rather build a real relationship across an account than force a single contact to a decision they're not ready to make.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: one day you'll be researching a transport operator, the next a food distribution centre. Our best reps dig into the businesses they support to make a sharper case for why Samsara matters to them specifically.
  • You treat rejection as a learning experience: in this role you will get hung up on and told no. You need the resilience to prepare, call again, and adjust.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go further than you have before.

In this role, you will

  • Research target accounts before outreach — pulling commercial signal out of public information (financials, news, hiring activity, compliance or safety pressure) to build a specific, defensible point of view on where Samsara adds value.
  • Build and prioritise an account-level contact plan, identifying who to approach first across a range of stakeholders (e.g. MD, Operations/Transport Manager, Compliance/H&S, Finance) and being able to justify that choice.
  • Run a connected, multi-touch outbound motion across phone, email and LinkedIn — using early conversations to gather information and multi-thread the account, not just to book a meeting at any cost.
  • Write personalised, researched outreach (including cold emails) that carries a specific point of view into every call, rather than working from a generic script.
  • Read what a contact gives you on the call and adapt in real time — including recognising when the right move is to gather information and position a follow-up with someone else, rather than push for a meeting the contact can't actually commit to.
  • Keep meticulous account and contact records in Salesforce.
  • Become a product expert and represent the Samsara brand at trade shows and events.

Minimum requirements for the role

  • 1–3 years professional experience, ideally in customer-facing roles
  • 6–12 months experience in a sales or equivalent target driven role 
  • Highly motivated and committed, with a strong desire to work in target-driven sales
  • Proven track record of consistently meeting or exceeding targets in previous roles
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written
  • Curious, and able to ask insightful questions
  • A champion of a Growth Mindset
  • AI Literacy and ability to showcase examples of leveraging AI in your work 
  • Highly proficient in English and fluent in German

An ideal candidate also has

  • Comfort turning unstructured information (an annual report, a website, a news article) into a clear commercial argument
  • Experience multi-threading or navigating multiple stakeholders within a single sale
  • A genuine willingness to prepare — to research and write — before a call, rather than relying on improvising well under pressure
  • Experience in closing-sales roles or similar target driven environment 
  • A proven track record of achievement beyond work (e.g. academics, sports, charity)
  • Willingness to collaborate and influence in a "win as a team" environment
  • Excitement about solving new problems in innovative ways
  • Motivation to help build a fast-growing business in the IoT and SaaS space.

ADR pathways

Through Samsara's ADR program, there are always opportunities to move to the next level and take on more responsibility. With emphasis on continued professional development, training doesn't stop after onboarding — we provide opportunities to expand ADRs' understanding of the market and competitors, develop hard skills, and work with mentors to progress through three levels:

  • ADR I — focus on inbound leads: a high volume of conversations, sharing the ins and outs of our products, and fostering relationships with interested prospects. Learning opportunities include call sessions with senior Sales team members, tool training (Salesforce, Salesloft, Lusha), product knowledge, and objection handling.
  • ADR II — work on top-of-funnel movement, creating high-quality sales engagements, and supporting Account Executives. Enrolled in specialised training including professional writing, persona-based messaging, cold calling 2.0, and AE collaboration.
  • ADR III — work hand-in-hand with field Account Executives and Enterprise Regional Sales Managers. Partner on large accounts, implement territory plans, join weekly strategy meetings, and schedule/attend customer demos, alongside a mentorship program ahead of an AE interview.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email [email removed] or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

job.title: Director of Software Engineering
job.description:
About SANS

Founded in 1989, SANS Institute (SANS) began as a cooperative research and education organization. Over the next 25 years, it grew to become the most trusted and widely recognized provider of information security training and certification in the world. Today, SANS has served more than 300,000 cybersecurity professionals around the world, with more than 60,000 earning Global Information Assurance Certification (GIAC) security certifications—the leading certification that provides assurance to employers that their people and prospective hires can do the job.

At the heart of SANS is a community of practitioners, from auditors and network administrators to CISOs, who share their lessons learned and collaborate on solutions to the challenges they face. These experts, working across corporations, government agencies, and universities, come together to support and strengthen the global information security community.

Why SANS?

At SANS, our culture is defined by three pillars: Mission, Brand, and People.

  • Our Mission is to hire people who understand the importance fighting against cybersecurity threats.
  • Our Brand reflects a commitment to delivering the highest quality training.
  • Our People are grounded in a culture of fairness, honesty, customer focus, and a pragmatic approach.

What You’ll Achieve at SANS

We are seeking a Director of Software Engineering to join our Product Development team. This role plays a key part in providing senior technical and organizational leadership for SANS’ Cloud Platform Engineering organization — spanning platform core services (identity, product administration, and entitlements), DevOps tools and services, website engineering, and courseware & platform orchestration — while serving as the engineering executive for Project CORE, SANS’ enrollment and entitlement modernization program. This role leads individual contributors and engineering teams through their managers and leads; owns shared engineering platforms, standards, tooling, and vendor relationships; and drives the architecture, delivery, and cross-functional coordination required to modernize SANS’ enrollment, entitlement, and administrative systems. The Director partners closely with Product, Operations, Sales, Finance, and fellow engineering directors to translate business strategy into secure, scalable, and maintainable systems.

As a Director of Software Engineering, you will:

  • Lead, manage, and mentor individual contributors and engineering teams through managers and leads.
  • Own engineering standards and best practices — CI/CD, code quality, secure development — and facilitate architecture governance across teams.
  • Plan and balance engineering capacity against shifting business priorities, communicating trade-offs to stakeholders.
  • Lead strategic modernization programs end to end: architecture, cross-team commitments, delivery planning, and executive reporting.
  • Direct modernization of core product platforms — enrollment, entitlement, identity, and product services — including integration with enterprise systems and retirement of legacy tooling.
  • Measure engineering effectiveness and drive continuous improvement across teams.
  • Champion incident management discipline and publish regular engineering communications to stakeholders.
  • Other duties as assigned.

What We’re Looking For

Every SANS employee brings something unique. For this role, we’re looking for candidates with:

  • BS or MS in Computer Science, related technical field, or equivalent industry experience.
  • At least 10 years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years leading engineering teams and 3+ years managing through engineering managers or leads.
  • Demonstrated success leading a large, multi-team modernization or systems-integration program from design through delivery.
  • Strong technical acumen with prior hands-on development experience and the ability to guide architectural decisions across services, integrations, and data flows.
  • Experience with modern AI development techniques and best practices.
  • Experience with enterprise business systems and integrations (e.g., Salesforce/Service Cloud, identity providers, payment/order management).
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure and DevOps practices, including AWS, CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and infrastructure as code.
  • Experience managing vendor relationships, software procurement, licensing, and budgets.
  • Experience with Agile, SDLC, and modern development standards and best practices.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including executive-level reporting and cross-functional coordination.
  • Unrestricted authorization to work in the USA; visa sponsorship is not available.

Preferred qualifications include:

  • Experience in education technology, training delivery platforms, or certification systems.
  • Experience facilitating architecture governance (architecture councils, RFC processes, engineering standards).
  • Familiarity with identity and access management platforms (PingIdentity, Entra ID) and entitlement modeling.
  • Experience integrating AI-assisted development tooling and governing its safe, cost-effective adoption.
  • Interest in a security-first mindset and secure coding practices.
  • Ability and passion for developing both individuals and teams.

Benefits and Perks of Working at SANS

We’re committed to fair and equitable compensation. The expected salary range for this position is $200,000 to $240,000 OTE (comprised of base salary and bonus), depending on geographic location, skills, and experience. At SANS, pay equity and transparency are priorities.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package that supports your total well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:

  • Financial Benefits: Competitive base salary, bonus opportunities, and a 401(k) plan with company match.
  • Health & Wellness: Robust medical, dental, and vision plans; company-provided short term disability; optional long-term disability, supplemental life and AD&D insurance for employees and dependents; voluntary benefits including accident insurance and identity theft protection; fitness and wellness programs; and a company paid employee assistance program (EAP).
  • Time Off & Flexibility: Generous paid time off, including volunteer time.
  • Learning & Development: Access to professional development and SANS training opportunities.

Flexibility and Balance at SANS

We support our colleagues with the tools and flexibility they need to thrive, both professionally and personally. As a primarily remote work environment, we are committed to maintaining strong connections, collaboration, and a vibrant culture across virtual teams. While most roles operate remotely, some positions may require occasional in-person presence depending on role-specific or business needs.

SANS is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer

SANS is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, disability, or any other federal, state, or local protected class.

If, because of a medical condition or disability, you require a reasonable accommodation during the application process, or to perform the essential functions of a position, please contact SANS Human Resources.

US Job Seekers: Click here to view the “Know Your Rights” poster.

SANS complies with all applicable state and local laws regarding the consideration of applicants with arrest or conviction records. For positions governed by federal and/or state banking regulations, SANS will adhere to relevant requirements when evaluating candidates with criminal histories.

Employment eligibility in the United States is required. SANS does not provide visa sponsorship for this position.

job.title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
job.location: Mexico | Brazil | India | Costa Rica | Honduras | Peru
job.description:
About Sift

Sift is the data infrastructure platform for hardware engineering teams. Sift turns high-frequency telemetry into engineering insights for mission-critical systems. Teams use Sift to build and operate rockets, satellites, autonomous vehicles, energy systems, defense platforms, and more.

Founded by former SpaceX engineers who built the tools behind Dragon and Starlink, Sift is building the data infrastructure to herald the AI era for physical systems.

About the Role

Engineers rely on real-time alerts to know the moment something goes wrong.

You will own correctness test coverage for real-time alerting, from launch through every later release: proving that alerts fire when they should, and only then. That runs from the screens where users configure and review alerts to the backend services that evaluate them. Later, you will also cover our integration products: an edge database and viewer that runs on customer machines, our SDKs, command-line tool and data import pipelines. You will work with the Head of Quality Engineering and partner closely with the engineering teams that build these products.

In This Role, You'll:

  • Own alert correctness. Build tests that prove alerts fire when they should, and only then, across conditions, thresholds, rolling windows and severities.

  • Build independent test data. Generate realistic data and alert scenarios that do not depend on the code under test.

  • Own end-to-end UI testing. Build and maintain browser tests for alert configuration, alert history and status views. Keep them fast, stable and trusted.

  • Validate what users see. Add visual regression checks for status indicators, severity levels, previews and dashboards where they add signal without flakiness.

  • Test the APIs underneath. Write integration tests for backend services against a real database, covering the main paths and the edge cases a design implies but does not spell out.

  • Test authorization thoroughly. Verify who can view, create and change data under role-based, attribute-based and resource-scoped permissions, including the negative cases.

  • Test time-series evaluation. Verify alert logic on real-time data, including late, missing and out-of-order data, backfill, and recovery after a backlog.

  • Compare old and new systems. Validate a new system's results against the one it replaces using generated or anonymized data, and test outbound integrations such as webhooks.

  • Gate alert releases. Define what correctness results block an alerts release, sign off on it, and report risks to the team.

  • Cover our integration products. Map coverage gaps and build regression tests for an offline-first edge database and viewer, our SDKs, command-line tool and data imports, including install and upgrade testing in Sift test environments.

  • Train and guide a QE in another time zone. Onboard a QE who runs regression overnight, and review their results.

  • Shape quality before code merges. Review designs and test plans with engineers, find gaps by reading the code, and raise risks early in plain language.

Required Skills:

  • 5+ years in QA automation or SDET roles, covering both UI and backend testing.

  • Strong Playwright and TypeScript skills. You have designed suites, not only written tests.

  • Experience writing integration tests for backend services, ideally in Go, against a real database.

  • Python for test data generation and scripting.

  • Experience testing authorization and access control: roles, attributes and resource-level permissions (RBAC, ABAC).

  • Experience testing time-series or event data, including late, missing and out-of-order data.

  • Strong SQL skills, including setting up test data and reasoning about data access rules.

  • Ability to read production code and design documents to find untested paths.

  • Experience testing SDKs, CLIs or APIs that customers integrate with, ideally in Python or Rust.

  • Professional working proficiency in written and spoken English (CEFR B2 or above), used daily for design reviews, test plans, risk reports, working with and training teammates.

  • At least 4 hours a day of overlap with US Pacific time.

Bonus Points:

  • Visual regression testing with a review tool such as Chromatic, or with Playwright screenshots.

  • Testing Kafka-compatible streaming systems.

  • Familiarity with monitoring, alerting or time-series data products.

  • Using AI agents to write and maintain tests.

  • Reading Rust.

  • Testing software that runs on customer hardware or offline.

Engineering At Sift:

  • E2E and browser: Playwright, TypeScript

  • Frontend: React, TypeScript, Vitest, Testing Library

  • Backend and API: Go, gRPC, PostgreSQL

  • Integrations and edge: Rust, Python, Protobuf

  • Test data and scripting: Python

  • Streaming: Kafka-compatible event streaming

  • CI: GitHub Actions

Location:

This is a remote, full-time-equivalent independent contractor engagement for candidates based in Latin America or the Caribbean. You will work at least 4 hours a day overlapping with US Pacific time and collaborate closely with engineering teams in California.

Compensation range: $4,000 - $4,500 USD per month (Latin America and the Caribbean)

Candidates who advance will complete a standardized English assessment administered by a third-party provider. We will share how your results are used and stored, and request your consent, before the assessment.

Job Posting ID: KT_278_JOB

Position: Senior Software Developer

Clearance: Must be able to obtain a Public Trust. Active Secret clearance preferred. US Citizens only.

FT/PT Status: Full-Time

Location: Remote

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related scientific or technical discipline.


Overview:
Kreative Technologies is in search of a motivated Senior Software Developer experienced in .NET and web application development to help support health applications for the federal government (DoD, VA). The ideal candidate must possess working knowledge in a variety of Information Technology (IT) and enterprise system technologies supporting a virtual operating environment, including 508-compliance and full-stack coding.

Duties/Responsibilities:

•  Design, develop, test and maintain software for federal health applications supporting DoD and VA.

•        Modify and enhance existing application code to add features, fix defects and improve performance.

•        Build and enhance applications that integrate with EHR and 3M/Solventum 360 Encompass.

•        Write and maintain code in C#, Java, .NET, T-SQL, PowerShell and JavaScript, plus front-end work in HTML, CSS, jQuery and Angular.

•        Apply 508-compliance updates

•        Develop and optimize SQL Server databases, queries, stored procedures and XSLT data transformations.

•        Build and maintain reports and dashboards in Power BI.

•        Make sure applications meet Section 508 accessibility standards.

•        Deploy, configure and troubleshoot applications on Windows Server, IIS and Apache.

•        Diagnose and resolve application, integration and server-to-server communication issues across the network.

•        Follow government information security and assurance requirements throughout development and deployment.

•        Take part in code reviews, testing and release activities to make sure code is high quality and stable.

•        Write and maintain technical documentation, including system designs, configurations and procedures.

•        Work with project managers, analysts, testers and government stakeholders to define requirements and deliver solutions.

•        Mentor junior developers and share best practices with the team.

Minimum Qualifications:

•        5 years of experience in Software Development.

•        1+ year of experience working with EHR.

•        1+ year of experience working with 3M/Solventum 360 Encompass.

•        5 years of experience working in a Windows environment.

•        Hands-on development experience required, including modifying and maintaining existing code.

•        Experience with C#, Java, Microsoft .NET, T-SQL, PowerShell, HTML, JavaScript, CSS, XSLT, jQuery, Angular, Power BI.

•        Experience with Visual Studio, WebStorm, Eclipse, IIS 8.5, Windows Server 2022, SQL Server 2022.

•        Familiarity with network architectures to include inter-communications between servers/systems required by applications.

Preferred Qualifications:

•        Section 508 experience. The selected candidate must pass Section 508 certification exams.

•        Familiarity with government Information Security & Assurance policies and practices.

Compensation: $95,000 - $100,000 yearly


Kreative Technologies is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing a workplace free from harassment and discrimination.
